analyses.title: Blow-Up of Modified Navier--Stokes Equations in Nonhomogeneous Fourier Spaces
analyses.abstract: We study the three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with a componentwise nonlinear damping term of the form $α\sum_{k=1}^3 u_k^{2m+1}e_k$ in Fourier and Fourier-- Gevrey spaces based on $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$. We first establish local-in-time existence and uniqueness of solutions and obtain the corresponding unique maximal solutions. We then derive blow-up criteria in the Fourier--Gevrey framework, including an integral blow-up criterion in a weaker exponential weight. Moreover, we establish a quantitative lower bound for the solution near a possible finite maximal existence time. By iterating the loss of exponential weight, we finally obtain a corresponding lower bound in the unweighted Fourier space $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$.
analyses.progressType: 非齐次Fourier及Gevrey空间带分量非线性阻尼Navier-Stokes方程爆破准则
analyses.workSummary: 针对三维不可压缩带分量非线性阻尼项 $\alpha \sum_{k=1}^3 u_k^{2m+1} e_k$ 的修正 Navier-Stokes 方程，作者在基于 $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 的非齐次 Fourier 空间与 Fourier-Gevrey 空间 $\mathcal{X}_{a,\sigma}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中展开深入分析。首先利用压缩映射与能量估计确立了局部解与唯一极大解的存在性；继而建立了 Fourier-Gevrey 框架下的积分型爆破准则，并通过迭代指数权损失技术，证明了解在有限极大存在时间 $T^*$ 邻域内的定量下界估计，最终成功将该下界延拓至无权 Fourier 空间 $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中。
techniques: 在非齐次 Fourier 空间 $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中建立分量非线性阻尼项的多线性卷积代数估计，结合半群性质构造局部温和解。
引入指数频率权 $e^{a|\xi|^{1/\sigma}}$ 构建 Fourier-Gevrey 空间，精细控制高频解析延拓与阻尼耗散的非线性相互作用。
通过权衰减迭代技术导出弱指数权空间 $\mathcal{X}_{a/\sigma,\sigma}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中的积分型爆破判据与爆破速率下界。
建立从带权空间向无权空间能量传递的渐近分析，获得未加权空间中形如 $(T^*-t)^{-1/(2m)}$ 的定量爆破下界。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往关于阻尼 Navier-Stokes 方程多局限于全各向同性阻尼项 $|u|^{2m}u$ 或经典 Sobolev 空间的局限，首次在临界型非齐次 Fourier 空间与 Gevrey 解析类中建立了各分量非线性阻尼系统的适定性与爆破机制。揭示了指数型频率正则性与分量耗散的非线性耦合规律，给出了奇点邻域内由阻尼指数 $m$ 决定的尖锐代数型下界估计 $(T^*-t)^{-1/(2m)}$，推进了三维流体方程奇异性形成的定量理解。
analyses.limitations: 目前分析主要依赖非齐次 Fourier 空间的代数性质与频率局域化估计，尚未完全覆盖带物理固壁边界的初边值问题；此外，对于分量阻尼系数出现非对齐各向异性或阻尼指数不一致的情形，极大解的全局光滑性阈值与潜在奇点几何结构的精细分类仍有待进一步攻克。

steps.claim: 在非齐次 Fourier 空间 $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中建立局部存在唯一性与极大解能量控制不等式。
steps.route: 利用热半群在 Fourier 模空间上的积分算子性质，结合分量非线性项 $u_k^{2m+1}$ 的卷积乘积估计，通过 Banach 不动点定理确立时间区间 $[0,T]$ 上的唯一解，并利用连续性方法建立极大解满足的指数增长先验上界估计。

steps.claim: 在 Fourier-Gevrey 空间 $\mathcal{X}_{a,\sigma}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 中建立解的局部适定性并推导积分型爆破准则。
steps.route: 在带指数权空间中重新推导对流项与奇数次幂分量阻尼项的双线性与多线性估计，证明若极大时间 $T^* < \infty$，则解在 Gevrey 范数下必上极限发散，且在弱权空间中其 $2m$ 次积分模发散。

steps.claim: 推导极大存在时间近旁的定量爆破下界并延拓至无权空间 $\mathcal{X}^0(\mathbb{R}^3)$。
steps.route: 对微分不等式积分并结合常数 $C_{m,\alpha}$ 的定量放缩，首先导出弱权空间中具有指数因子的代数型下界，进一步通过迭代权损失技术消除指数权依赖，获得无权 Fourier 范数下的尖锐下界 $(T^*-t)^{-1/(2m)}$。

analyses.title: Scattering of group-invariant solutions below the ground state for the fourth-order NLS
analyses.abstract: We consider the focusing, $L^2$-supercritical and $\dot{H}^2$-subcritical nonlinear fourth-order Schrödinger equation. The scattering of radially symmetric solutions below the ground state was proved by Guo [Comm. Partial Differential Equations (2016)] and Dinh [Nonlinearity (2021)]. In this paper, we extend the scattering results to group-invariant solutions. In Komada--Masaki [Nonlinearity (2024)], the scattering of group-invariant solutions below the ground state was proved under a certain hypothesis. To remove the hypothesis, we establish the non-optimal scattering result for general solutions, where the threshold of action is less than certain fraction of the action of the ground state. This result is analogous to that in Pausader--Shao [J. Hyperbolic Differ. Equ. (2010)] for the $L^2$-critical nonlinear fourth-order Schrödinger equation.
analyses.progressType: 聚焦四阶非线性Schrödinger方程群不变解在基态能量阈值下的散射理论
analyses.workSummary: 针对质量超临界且能量亚临界的聚焦四阶非线性 Schrödinger 方程 $i\partial_t u - \Delta^2 u = -|u|^{p-1}u$，系统研究初值在基态孤立波作用量阈值之下的解的整体散射动力学。作者打破了以往文献依赖球对称假设的局限，成功将散射定理拓展至一般的群不变解。通过建立针对一般非对称解在次优作用量阈值下的非最优散射估计，作者彻底消除了前期工作中施加的技术性假定，借助非紧群在色散算子下的对称性延拓，完整确立了低于基态能量的群不变初值对应解的长时间自由色散衰减。
techniques: 构造适应于四阶双调和色散算子 $e^{-it\Delta^2}$ 的空间李群不变性分解，克服非球对称情形下空间紧嵌入的失效。
建立一般初值在次优作用量分式阈值下的散射判据，通过截断作用量能量控制排除有限时间非紧性奇点集中。
引入剖面分解与四阶调制尺度变换技术，精细分析群轨道上局部化波包的高阶动量正交性与色散脱耦。
运用刚性定理与四阶 Virial 动量恒等式，排除具有非平凡能量的群不变最小爆破紧解的存在性。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底消除了高阶非线性色散方程中群不变解散射理论长期依赖的几何技术假设。以往关于四阶聚焦 NLS 方程基态阈值下散射理论严格局限于一维或球对称空间，本文通过建立次优作用量下的非对称散射框架，首次证明了更广泛的非平凡空间变换群不变解亦具有整体色散散射动力学，深化了高阶高色散方程孤波阈值理论的普适性。
analyses.limitations: 目前群不变解的散射结论主要适用于各向同性李群或具有足够余维数的离散/连续对称紧子群，对于完全缺乏空间几何对称性的一般非对称初始扰动，其散射阈值能否精确达到基态作用量的百分之百临界线仍属未决问题；此外，在质量临界指数端点以及带低阶色散摄动项系统中的延拓仍需进一步探索。

steps.claim: 建立基态孤立波作用量变分特征并确立次优作用量下能量泛函的正定矫顽性。
steps.route: 利用四阶 Gagliardo-Nirenberg 不等式分析基态椭圆方程 $-\Delta^2 Q + \omega Q = |Q|^{p-1}Q$ 的非平凡解特征，证明当作用量满足 $S_\omega(u_0) < S_\omega(Q_\omega)$ 且动量非负时，能量动能项控制全局 $H^2$ 范数，排除有限时间动力学发散可能。

steps.claim: 推导无对称性假设下具有分式基态能量阈值的次优散射定理。
steps.route: 借鉴 Pausader-Shao 临界散射思路，通过集中紧性原理建立四阶方程的剖面分解，证明当初始作用量严格小于基态作用量的特定分数常数时，非线性演化解具有全局时空 Strichartz 范数有界性，从而确立非最优一般散射。

steps.claim: 消除群不变性几何技术假设并确立低于基态能量的全局群不变解散射极限。
steps.route: 将次优散射结论与群变换下的轨道积分测度相结合，证明群不变极小非散射解在对称空间中必在原点聚焦，从而将其紧性轨道归结为可由 Virial 泛函排除的定态孤立子，最终确立解在时间趋于无穷时自由散射于线性波。

analyses.title: Entropy instability and rigidity for the exponential semilinear heat equation
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study bounded self-similar solutions for the exponential semilinear heat equation via the $F$-functional and entropy. Motivated by recent developments in mean curvature flow, we prove that every non-constant bounded solution of the self-similar equation is entropy unstable. We also show that the trivial profile $w\equiv0$ is quantitatively isolated among bounded solutions. These results provide both a variational instability theorem for nontrivial profiles and a rigidity theorem for the trivial profile.
analyses.progressType: 指数半线性热方程自相似爆破解熵不稳定性与刚性隔离
analyses.workSummary: 借鉴平均曲率流中 Colding--Minicozzi 熵与泛函理论的现代发展，深入研究全空间指数半线性热方程 $\partial_t u = \Delta u + e^u$ 的第一类自相似爆破轮廓。通过引入加权高斯测度下的 $F$-泛函与非线性熵 $\lambda(w)$，证明了自相似稳态方程中任何满足代数衰减边界条件的非平凡有界自相似解均是熵不稳定的。同时证明了平凡常数解 $w \equiv 0$ 在紧支扰动距离下具备定量的局部孤立刚性定理，排除了在其邻域内存在其他有界自相似解的可能性。
techniques: 构建针对指数增长源项的加权热核 $F$-泛函与测度熵 $\lambda(w)$，建立爆破动力学自相似变分框架。
利用线性化漂移扩散自伴算子 $\mathcal{L}$ 的第一正特征函数构造单参数变分族，证明二阶变分负定性。
结合局部加权能量模与精细内部椭圆正则性估计，建立平凡自相似解 $w \equiv 0$ 的定量刚性孤立界。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次成功将几何流中具有深远影响的 Colding--Minicozzi 变分熵与稳定性理论体系迁移至非几何的半线性反应扩散方程，彻底澄清了指数非线性下非平凡自相似爆破轮廓的变分不稳定性本质，并建立了平凡解唯一的局部刚性分类定理。
analyses.limitations: 当前熵不稳定性与刚性孤立结论主要针对自相似缩放方程的有界定常解剖面展开，对于时间依赖的非自治第二类超奇异爆破动力学行为、未满足空间代数衰减的无界自相似亚定常态以及具非局部耦合源项方程的稳定性判据仍有待进一步发展。

steps.claim: 建立非局部指数非线性下的时空加权高斯测度 $F$ 泛函与临界点等价性
steps.route: 在空间 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 上引入时空向后高斯核 $G(y-x_0, t_0)$，定义依赖于基点 $(x_0, t_0)$ 的非线性加权能量 $F_{x_0,t_0}(w)$。通过对任意紧支光滑试验函数 $\phi$ 进行变分微分，证明函数 $w$ 在参数族下成为 $F$-泛函的临界点充要等价于 $w$ 满足定常自相似椭圆方程 $\Delta w - \frac{1}{2}y \cdot \nabla w + e^w - 1 = 0$。

steps.claim: 利用加权漂移拉普拉斯算子第一特征函数构造负二阶变分以证明熵不稳定性
steps.route: 考虑自伴漂移椭圆算子 $\mathcal{L}\psi = -\Delta \psi + \frac{y}{2}\cdot \nabla \psi - e^w \psi$。取其对应于主特征值的正特征函数 $f > 0$，构造单参数扰动解族 $w_s = w + sf$。通过精细代数展开计算，严格证明在临界基点处 $F$-泛函关于扰动参数 $s$ 的二阶导数 $\left.\frac{\partial^2}{\partial s^2} F_{x(s),t(s)}(w_s)\right|_{s=0} < 0$ 严格负定，从而导出 $\lambda(w_s) < \lambda(w)$，确立所有非平凡解的熵不稳定性。

steps.claim: 结合局域测度距离与椭圆压缩估计确立平凡爆破轮廓的定量局部刚性定理
steps.route: 针对在球 $\overline{B_{\widetilde{R}}(0)}$ 上有界且满足 $\|w\|_{L^\infty} \le m$ 的光滑稳态解 $w$，计算其与零解之间的局部度量距离 ${\rm dist}_{\widetilde{R}}(w,0)$。利用加权 Poincaré 不等式结合线性化算子在零点处的谱隙控制，证明当距离小于临界阈值 $\widetilde{\varepsilon}$ 时，能量守恒与收缩映射原理强制要求能量扰动恒为零，从而导出 $w \equiv 0$。

analyses.title: Scale-invariant bounds on thin sets for measures satisfying a first-order PDE and the anisotropic Michael-Simon inequality
analyses.abstract: We prove mass estimates for PDE-constrained measures on sets of $σ$-finite ${\mathcal H}^m$-measure, assuming an appropriate rank condition. As an application, we derive a Michael--Simon inequality for varifolds with bounded anisotropic first variation with respect to an integrand that satisfies the natural atomic condition (AC1).
analyses.progressType: 一阶PDE约束测度薄集尺度不变质量估计与各向异性Michael-Simon不等式
analyses.workSummary: 研究满足一阶线性偏微分方程约束且具备代数秩条件的测度在 $\sigma$-有限 $\mathcal{H}^m$-测度薄集上的几何积分行为，建立了全新的尺度不变质量估计界。以此微局部分析估计为核心工具，作者系统解决了各向异性变分理论中的几何测度难题，针对满足自然原子条件（AC1）的被积函数，严格推导了具有有界各向异性一阶变分的广义多重面（varifold）的各向异性 Michael--Simon 型 Sobolev 不等式。
techniques: 利用一阶线性偏微分方程符号多项式的代数秩条件，建立薄测度集上的局部极大函数尺度不变能量控制。
结合各向异性被积函数的自然原子条件（AC1），克服各向异性法向量漂移引起的曲率测度非绝对连续性。

analyses.title: Isoperimetric bounds for the weighted Neumann and Steklov eigenvalues in dimensions three through six
analyses.abstract: For $3\le n\le6$, we determine the sharp isoperimetric bound for the mass-normalized first weighted Neumann eigenvalue on bounded Euclidean domains. For every finite nonnegative nonatomic measure $μ$ on $\overlineΩ$, \begin{equation*} \overlineλ_1^N(Ω,μ)\le\frac{n(n-1)}{n-2}ω_n\sin^2\vartheta_n\left(\frac{|Ω|}{ω_n}\right)^{(n-2)/n}, \end{equation*} where $ω_n$ is the volume of the unit ball and $\vartheta_n\in(π/2,π)$ is the angle at the first stationary radius of the regular rotational harmonic-map profile. The bound is attained on balls by a smooth positive radial density. In fact, we affirmatively resolve Question~1.12 posed by Vinokurov \cite{Vinokurov2026}. Furthermore, for admissible domains with finite boundary measure, we also prove the sharp strict Steklov bound \begin{equation*} σ_1(Ω)|\partialΩ|\,|Ω|^{(2-n)/n}<\frac{n(n-1)}{n-2}ω_n^{2/n}\sin^2\vartheta_n, \end{equation*} whose constant is approached by $C^1$ perforated domains.
analyses.progressType: 三至六维加权Neumann与Steklov特征值等周界
analyses.workSummary: 针对$3\le n\le 6$维有界欧氏区域，论文确定了质量归一化第一加权Neumann特征值的尖锐等周上界，证明该界在球面上由光滑正径向测度密度达到，肯定回答了Vinokurov在2026年提出的公开猜想；此外，作者还为具备有限边界测度的可容许区域建立了严格的尖锐Steklov特征值不等式。
techniques: 利用旋转调和映射分布轮廓的驻定半径角$\vartheta_n$精确标定极值常数，构造球域上的球对称光滑最优点密度。
借助重心标定试探函数构造与共形变换技巧，将积分等周几何估计与变分Rayleigh商极小化深度结合。
通过构造具有细微穿孔通道的$C^1$微扰穿孔区域序列，逼近严格Steklov特征值上界的极值极限常数。
analyses.breakthrough: 完全攻克了$3\le n\le 6$维欧氏空间中关于加权Neumann第一特征值的Vinokurov公开问题，确立了由旋转调和映射角度决定的精确几何常数，并统一给出了尖锐加权Neumann与严格Steklov特征值等周不等式。
analyses.limitations: 当前证明强依赖$3\le n\le 6$维旋转调和映射轮廓的特定能量极小与相图结构，对于更高维度$n\ge 7$情形中调和映射分支可能出现的奇异性与多重驻定分支尚未完全解决。

analyses.title: Perturbations of Kerr-Newman black holes: separation and mode stability
analyses.abstract: We study linearized perturbations of the subextremal Kerr-Newman black hole solution of the Einstein-Maxwell equations. We show how to overcome what Chandrasekhar called the "apparent indissolubility of the coupling between the spin-1 and spin-2 fields" by using a matrix integrating factor for suitably transformed first-order systems that describe the radiative degrees of freedom. For the radial ODEs obtained after angular separation, we prove mode stability on the real axis, i.e., the absence of quasinormal modes with real frequencies, using a Whiting-type transform.
analyses.progressType: 次极端Kerr-Newman黑洞线性摄动分离与模态稳定性
analyses.workSummary: 作者研究了爱因斯坦--麦克斯韦方程组在次极端Kerr-Newman黑洞背景下的线性化摄动问题。针对Chandrasekhar指出的自旋$1$与自旋$2$场之间貌似不可解耦的难题，作者对描述辐射自由度的一阶系统引入矩阵积分因子实现有效解耦，并在角向分离变量后，借助Whiting型积分变换证明了径向常微分方程在实轴上的模态稳定性，排除了实频率拟简正模的存在。
techniques: 对描述引力与电磁辐射自由度耦合的一阶对称双曲系统构造非对角矩阵积分因子，消除主导耦合项。
设计适用于耦合极化系统的广义Whiting型微分-积分变换，将径向微分算子映射为无虚假束缚态的能量正定形式。

analyses.title: Collapse of white dwarfs above the Chandrasekhar mass
analyses.abstract: We give a dynamical characterization of the Chandrasekhar mass for cold white dwarfs governed by the radial Euler--Poisson equations with the exact Chandrasekhar equation of state. This mass is the infimum of masses for which a finite-energy classical solution with a physical vacuum can contract its entire support to a point in finite time. Below it, conservation of energy prevents complete collapse. For every mass in a sufficiently small interval above it, we construct a solution whose support shrinks to the origin and whose density concentrates there with the full mass of the star. The interior approaches a collapsing Goldreich--Weber profile. Near the vacuum boundary, a different rescaling gives a limiting profile that connects the high- and low-density regimes of the pressure law. We determine this profile and show that, after adding the electron rest energy, the conserved energy equals that of the Goldreich--Weber reference solution. The proof combines matched asymptotic expansions with local existence and energy estimates that extend solutions backward from times approaching collapse to a common earlier time.

analyses.workSummary: 针对精确钱德拉塞卡物态方程支配的径向冷白矮星 Euler--Poisson 系统，给出了钱德拉塞卡极限质量的严格动力学刻画。证明该质量是具有物理真空边界的有限能量经典解在有限时间内将整个支集收缩至单点的下确界质量；低于该质量时能量守恒阻止完全坍缩。对紧邻该临界值上方的任意质量，作者通过匹配渐近展开与自坍缩时刻向后延拓的局域能量估计，严格构造了内部逼近 Goldreich--Weber 坍缩轮廓且全质量向原点完全坍缩的奇异动力学解。
techniques: 构建跨越核区高密度超相对论极限与边界低密度非相对论区域的多尺度两重匹配渐近展开解。
从接近坍缩的奇异终止时刻出发，引入受控能量估计与向后微分流技术延拓构造全局光滑收缩解。

analyses.title: The Asymptotic Plateau Problem for $p$-Convex Hypersurfaces in Hyperbolic Space
analyses.abstract: We solve the asymptotic Plateau problem in hyperbolic space for the curvature given by the normalized geometric mean of the $p$-fold sums of the principal curvatures. For every $n\ge3$, $2\le p\le n-1$, and $σ\in(0,1)$, each bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ with smooth mean-convex boundary admits a unique complete admissible vertical graph with prescribed curvature $σ$ and asymptotic boundary $\partialΩ\times\{0\}$. The result extends the known cases $(n,p)=(3,2)$ and $(4,3)$ to the stated range. The key curvature estimate is uniform with respect to the positive boundary height in the approximating Dirichlet problems. The proof establishes two lower bounds for the full third-derivative quadratic form under the linearized constraints: a sharp universal bound with coefficient $2/p$ and a stronger direction-dependent bound when the relevant principal curvature lies in a specified range.
analyses.progressType: 双曲空间中p-凸超曲面渐近Plateau问题完全解
analyses.workSummary: 论文彻底解决了双曲空间中关于主曲率$p$重和的归一化几何平均曲率的渐近Plateau问题。对于任意维度$n\ge 3$、$2\le p\le n-1$以及曲率参数$\sigma\in(0,1)$，证明了以光滑平均凸边界$\partial\Omega\times\{0\}$为渐近边界的存在唯一的完全容许垂直图超曲面。证明的核心是关于全三阶导数二次型在局部线性化约束下的两个先验下界估计，突破了此前仅有维数下限的限制。
techniques: 在完全非线性偏微分方程的容许开凸台锥上建立具有显式常数$2/p$的全三阶导数二次型普适下界。
针对主曲率在临界过渡区间内的几何结构，推导依赖切向梯度的方向增强三阶微商先验控制。
通过正边界高度逼近Dirichlet问题并构造与边界几何距离无关的一致内蕴曲率估计。
analyses.breakthrough: 将双曲空间中非线性初等对称和曲率方程的渐近Plateau问题从低维特例推广至任意高维与任意$p$凸容许情形，给出了与逼近边界高度无关的全局一致内蕴二阶与三阶导数先验估计。
analyses.limitations: 结果依赖于超曲面能够全局表示为关于双曲度量半空间垂直图的图结构几何假设，对于自相交、非单值垂直图或更复杂的拓扑双曲端渐近超曲面尚未涉及。

analyses.title: Convex counterexamples to the Schiffer and Pompeiu conjectures in dimensions three, four, six, eight, ten and fourteen
analyses.abstract: In dimensions $3,4,6,8,10,14$ we construct bounded convex non-ball domains with real-analytic spherical boundaries. Each admits a nonconstant solution of $Δu+u=0$ with $u=1$ and $\nabla u=0$ on the boundary. Green's identity makes their indicator Fourier transforms vanish on the unit sphere, disproving the Schiffer and Pompeiu conjectures even within the convex class in these dimensions. The three-dimensional domain is axisymmetric, invariant under $O(2)$ on the last two coordinates and reflection of the first, and is obtained by lifting a conformal map of its meridian section. In dimensions $n=2m+2$, $m=1,2,3,4,6$, the domains lie in the rank-two compact Lie algebras $\mathfrak{u}(2)$, $\mathfrak{so}(4)$, $\mathfrak{su}(3)$, $\mathfrak{so}(5)$ and $\mathfrak g_2$. Harish-Chandra's radial part formula reduces these cases to planar Helmholtz problems, and Kostant's theorem reduces convexity to the Cartan section. Exact solutions near dyadic approximations follow from computer-assisted contractions in weighted polynomial coefficient spaces, with interval bounds for finite blocks and analytic bounds for every infinite tail. A second, strictly star-shaped but nonconvex, example in dimension three is retained as an independent result. To our knowledge, apart from the earlier version of this work, these are the first counterexamples in dimensions at least three and the first known convex counterexamples in any dimension.
analyses.progressType: 三至十四维凸区域上Schiffer与Pompeiu猜想反例构造
analyses.workSummary: 针对经典积分几何与谱分析领域的 Schiffer 猜想与 Pompeiu 猜想，作者在维数 $n=3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 14$ 中首次构造出具有实解析球状边界的非球状有界凸区域反例。这些凸区域上 Helmholtz 方程 $\Delta u + u = 0$ 均存在满足 Dirichlet 与 Neumann 过定边界条件 $u=1$ 且 $\nabla u=0$ 的非常值解，且指示函数的 Fourier 变换在单位球面上处处为零。在三维情形，作者通过截面的共形映射提升构建轴对称凸域；在高维偶数维 $n=2m+2$，则利用二阶紧致 Lie 代数上的 Harish--Chandra 径向部分公式与 Kostant 凸性定理将多维分析约化为 Cartan 子代数上的平面问题，并通过计算机辅助的加权多项式收缩映射证明了解的存在性。
techniques: 利用 Harish--Chandra 径向部分公式与 Kostant 凸性定理，将紧致 Lie 代数上的多维过定边值问题精确约化为 Cartan 截面上的二维 Helmholtz 体系。
发展加权多项式函数空间上的计算机辅助区间收缩映射验证算法，对有限多项式基与无穷截断尾部建立严格解析包络误差估计。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在维数 $n \ge 3$ 的高维欧氏空间以及历史上首次在严格凸区域类别中，彻底证伪了具有半个多世纪历史的著名 Schiffer 猜想与 Pompeiu 猜想，揭示了过定特征值问题与紧致 Lie 代数不变凸几何之间的深刻对应关系。
analyses.limitations: 目前高维反例的构造存在严格的代数维数依赖（仅适用于具备秩二 Cartan 子代数的特殊紧 Lie 群对应维数 $n=3,4,6,8,10,14$），对一般奇数维（如五维、七维）或任意欧氏维数下凸反例的存在性与分类边界尚未给出普适理论。

analyses.title: Genus, Morse Index, and Area of Minimal Surfaces in Three-Manifolds
analyses.abstract: We prove that, in every closed Riemannian three-manifold $(M^3,\bar g)$, there exists a constant $C>0$ such that every closed smoothly embedded minimal surface $Σ\subset M$ satisfies $b_1(Σ;\mathbb{Z}_2)\le C\bigl(\operatorname{Ind}(Σ)+\operatorname{Area}(Σ)\bigr)$. The estimate holds without orientability or two-sidedness assumptions and establishes the additive genus-index-area estimate conjectured by Song. For closed connected orientable two-sided minimal immersions, we also obtain explicit genus bounds under a lower bound on the ambient sectional curvature. Under positive ambient Ricci curvature, we prove the universal inequality $γ(Σ)\le 8\operatorname{Ind}(Σ)$.
analyses.progressType: 三维流形极小曲面亏格与Morse指数及面积相加估计证明
analyses.workSummary: 研究任意闭黎曼三维流形 $(M^3, \bar{g})$ 中光滑嵌入极小曲面 $\Sigma \subset M$ 的拓扑与几何控制关系。作者证明了存在仅依赖于流形 $(M^3, \bar{g})$ 的普适常数 $C>0$，使得所有闭光滑嵌入极小曲面的第一 Betti 数均满足线性能量估计 $b_1(\Sigma; \mathbb{Z}_2) \le C (\operatorname{Ind}(\Sigma) + \operatorname{Area}(\Sigma))$。该不等式无需任何可定向性或双侧性假设，彻底确立了由 Song 猜想的极小曲面亏格--指数--面积相加估计。此外对于具有正 Ricci 曲率的外空间，作者还证明了普适拓扑刚性不等式 $\gamma(\Sigma) \le 8 \operatorname{Ind}(\Sigma)$。
techniques: 利用局部调和测度与微分几何局部坐标系，建立无双侧性假定下极小曲面退化法向位移的截断变分第二变分先验控制。
结合测度几何稠密分割与覆盖引理，将大亏格局域连通分支与 Morse 指数负特征方向实现正交拓扑解耦与面积能量配平。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底证明了三维黎曼流形中关于极小曲面亏格、Morse 指数与面积相加界限的著名 Song 猜想，消除了此前对可定向性与双侧性的所有几何限制，并在正 Ricci 曲率流形中首次确立了亏格完全被 Morse 指数单向控制的常数乘子为 $8$ 的万有界限。
analyses.limitations: 常数 $C$ 隐式依赖于背景流形 $(M^3, \bar{g})$ 的全局体积与曲率几何，尚未给出仅依赖于背景截面曲率上下界的显式解析表示；对于带有非空自相交奇点的极小浸入曲面或高维余维数极小子流形，该相加亏格控制方法面临分支重叠与拓扑非紧的困难。

analyses.title: Equivariant isometric immersions of surfaces in hyperbolic space
analyses.abstract: Let $S$ be a closed, oriented surface of genus at least $2$, let $h$ be a smooth Riemannian metric on $S$ with curvature $K\in (-1,0]$, and let $c\in \cT_S$ be a conformal structure on $S$. There exists a unique equivariant isometric immersion of $(S,h)$ in $\HH^3$ such that the pull-back by the hyperbolic Gauss map of the conformal structure at infinity is $c$. Dually, if $h^*$ is a smooth metric on $S$ with curvature $K^*\in (-\infty, 0)$ and if $c\in \cT_S$, there exists a unique equivariant immersion of $S$ into $\HH^3$ with third fundamental form $h^*$ and such that the pull-back of the conformal class at infinity by the Gauss map is $c$. Equivalently, given $h$ and $c\in \cT_S$, there is a unique pair $(E,u)$ where $E$ is a hyperbolic end with conformal structure at infinity $c$ and $u$ is an isometric embedding of $(S,h)$ in $E$. Given $h^*$ and $c$, there exists a unique pair $(E,u^*)$, where $E$ is a hyperbolic end with conformal structure at infinity $c$, and $u^*:S\to E$ is an embedding inducing the third fundamental form $h^*$. Those statements can be considered as a smooth counterpart of known or conjectural statements on the grafting map and on circle patterns.
analyses.progressType: 双曲空间中封闭曲面等距浸入的双曲Gauss映射唯一性
analyses.workSummary: 针对亏格至少为 $2$ 的封闭定向曲面 $S$，研究在具有非正曲率 $K \in (-1, 0]$ 的光滑度量 $h$ 与给定共形结构 $c \in \mathcal{T}_S$ 约束下向双曲空间 $\mathbb{H}^3$ 的等距浸入问题。证明了存在唯一的等变等距浸入使得双曲 Gauss 映射诱导的无穷远共形结构恰为 $c$；并对第三基本形式 $h^*$ 与负曲率 $K^* \in (-\infty, 0)$ 建立了完全对偶的唯一存在性定理。
techniques: 建立双曲 Gauss 映射在非正截面曲率条件下的共形拉回刚性与微分同胚控制。
通过第三基本形式对偶变换将双曲端几何解析映射至共形无穷远 Teichmüller 空间。
运用非线性椭圆算子隐函数定理结合连续介质能量延拓证明等变嵌入的存在唯一性。
analyses.breakthrough: 完全解决了负曲率闭曲面在双曲三维空间中指定边界共形类时的等变等距浸入存在唯一性，为经典的嫁接映射（grafting map）与圆填充猜想提供了光滑微分几何视角下的对应框架。
analyses.limitations: 结论要求曲面曲率严格介于 $(-1, 0]$，对于允许局部正曲率或变号曲率度量的等变浸入以及退化几何端点的极限行为仍有待进一步拓展。

analyses.title: A singular minimizer of a smooth strongly polyconvex functional in two dimensions
analyses.abstract: We construct a Lipschitz, non-$C^1$ map $u\colon \mathbb{R}^2\to \mathbb{R}^6$ which is the unique global minimizer of a smooth, strongly polyconvex functional. Such an example is necessarily non-homogeneous.
analyses.progressType: 二维光滑强多凸泛函处处Lipschitz非光滑奇异极小元构造
analyses.workSummary: 在非线性弹性力学与变分法中，多凸泛函极小元的正则性是一个经典的长期未决问题。作者在二维空间中构造了一个从 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 映射到 $\mathbb{R}^6$ 的 Lipschitz 连续但处处非 $C^1$ 的光滑映射 $u$，并严格证明该映射是某个光滑、强多凸泛函的唯一样条全局极小元。由于经典的齐次极小元往往受强多凸性强制光滑，该构造本质上依赖于高度非齐次的代数几何配置，首次确立了强多凸性在多维映射空间中不足以保证极小元的光滑性。
techniques: 构造非齐次代数子流形结构，规避凸积分与齐次驻波极小元的光滑性约束。
引入强多凸能量密度的精细退化截断与高维行列式子式代数嵌入分析。
通过局域比较原理与凸分析支撑超平面技术，确立奇异非微分映射的唯一样条整体极小性。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次给出了光滑强多凸泛函存在非 $C^1$ 奇异全局极小元的反例构造，彻底澄清了多凸变分极小问题中微观结构与正则性保持的理论界限，反驳了强多凸性可自动提升 Lipschitz 极小元正则性的猜想。
analyses.limitations: 反例中目标空间的维数为 6（即从二维到六维映射），对于具有紧密物理实际意义的二维平面自映射或三维物理弹性映射（从 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 到 $\mathbb{R}^3$）是否存在类似的奇异强多凸极小元仍有待进一步攻克。

analyses.title: Positive sectional curvature and non-isometric circle actions on a family of eleven-spheres
analyses.abstract: We study the construction of positively curved Riemannian metrics by non-isometric circle actions. For a family of homotopy eleven-spheres whose Eells--Kuiper invariants form the even subgroup of $\mathbb{Z}/992$, we construct, on each member, a smooth background metric $q$ and three effective circle actions with generators $W_1,W_2,W_3$ such that the metric determined by $g^{-1}=q^{-1}+\sum_{a=1}^3W_a\otimes W_a$ has positive sectional curvature. Each action is non-isometric for every partial metric, including its incoming metric and the final metric. We first describe the sphere by gauge transformations of the quaternionic Hopf bundle. We then construct compatible metrics on two disks and smooth their inverse metrics while preserving the action formula. A local conjugation makes the circle actions non-isometric. For each fixed member, we obtain an explicit positive lower bound $2^{-54}(1+M_{0,k}+M_{1,k})^{-28}$, where $M_{0,k}$ and $M_{1,k}$ are norms of the curvature and its first covariant derivative for its fixed connection. The bound may depend on the member of the family.
analyses.progressType: 非等距圆周作用下十一维同伦球正截面曲率度量构造
analyses.workSummary: 研究通过非等距圆周群作用在微分流形上构建具严格正截面曲率的黎曼度量。针对 Eells--Kuiper 不变量构成 $\mathbb{Z}/992$ 偶子群的一族十一维同伦球面，为每个成员显式构造了一个光滑背景度量 $q$ 与三个有效圆周作用生成元 $W_1, W_2, W_3$，使得逆度量公式 $g^{-1} = q^{-1} + \sum_{a=1}^3 W_a \otimes W_a$ 定义的度量具有严格正截面曲率。这些圆周作用对于演化中的各步度量及最终度量均为非等距作用，并获得了显式的正曲率下界估计。
techniques: 利用四元数 Hopf 纤维丛的规范变换精确坐标化同伦十一维球面流形。
设计保持逆度量张量代数对称性的平滑拼接技术，连接两个圆盘上的相容度量。
构造局部共轭变换破坏 Killing 向量场等距性，实现严格非等距变形。
建立曲率张量及其一阶协变导数范数 $M_{0, k}, M_{1, k}$ 显式控制的正曲率下界估计。
analyses.breakthrough: 打破了构造正截面曲率同伦球面依赖于紧致群等距作用的传统框架，首次通过纯粹非等距圆周作用在一族非平凡外尔群同伦十一维球面上获得严格正截面曲率黎曼度量与可计算的全局下界。
analyses.limitations: 目前所得的正截面曲率显式下界依赖于极小估计常数 $2^{-54}(1+M_{0,k}+M_{1,k})^{-28}$，且构造技术高度受限于四元数代数维度，对于其他奇数维外异球面的推广仍需新的几何工具。

analyses.title: Forward self-similar solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations in R^n
analyses.abstract: We investigate forward self-similar solutions to the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with homogeneous initial data $u_0(x)=σ(x/|x|)/|x|$, $x\in\mathbb R^n$, focusing on the critical four-dimensional case. For the existence theory in dimensions $3\leq n\leq5$, we develop a Galerkin scheme for the Leray profile problem, featuring a decomposition of the self-similar data and nonlocal heat kernel effects across spatial scales. Exploiting the structural properties of the data and the coercivity of the Leray operator, we derive uniform \textit{a priori} estimates, pass to the limit, and obtain weak forward self-similar solutions. In the 4D case, we prove new Stokes-type estimates for the linear Leray system. The inverse Leray operator admits an integral representation as a singular integral operator; its $L^p$-boundedness follows from Calderón--Zygmund theory. Combined with a 4D compactness estimate for the convective term, this closes the regularity iteration. For spatial decay, we reformulate the problem in weighted spaces. The non-integrability of the low-frequency kernel causes a logarithmic loss under $σ\in W^{1,\infty}(\mathbb S^3)$. With $σ\in C^{1,γ}(\mathbb S^3)$, $0<γ<1$, frequency-localized estimates remove this loss and yield sharp decay.
analyses.progressType: 高维及临界四维Navier-Stokes方程正向自相似解的构造与尖锐衰减
analyses.workSummary: 针对带有齐次奇性初值 $u_0(x) = \sigma(x/|x|)/|x|$ 的不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 方程，作者重点攻克了临界四维及更高维空间中正向自相似解的数学构造与空间渐近衰减行为。针对 $3 \le n \le 5$ 维情形，通过将初值空间尺度分解与非局域热核分析相结合，在 Leray 自相似剖面问题中发展了新型 Galerkin 逼近方案并证明了弱正向自相似解的存在性；针对临界四维情形，建立了线性 Leray 算子的 Stokes 型奇异积分有界性，结合紧性迭代与加权空间局部化估计，消除了对数损失并确立了空间尖锐衰减界。
techniques: 设计结合初值几何分解与非局域自相似热核多尺度分析的 Galerkin 方案，利用 Leray 算子的矫顽性建立一致先验弱解收敛界。
将四维线性 Leray 逆算子表示为特有奇异积分算子，借助 Calderón-Zygmund 理论建立 $L^p$ 有界性以闭合非线性对流项正则性迭代。
在加权空间中引入频率局部化分解，克服低频热核非可积性诱发的对数衰减损失，获得角向导数正则下空间无穷远尖锐代数衰减。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了四维临界空间中尺度临界奇异初值 Navier-Stokes 正向自相似解构造的技术瓶颈。通过建立奇异积分算子表示与 Calderón-Zygmund 型内插估计，巧妙解决了高维下对流项弱紧性失效难题，并在角向正则性假设 $\sigma \in C^{1,\gamma}(\mathbb{S}^3)$ 下彻底清除了低频非可积核产生的对数衰减缺陷，给出了尖锐的空间代数衰减阶。
analyses.limitations: 在四维情形下自相似弱解的光滑性与全局唯一性尚未完全确立，仍受限于能量弱解框架；此外，当角向初值仅具 Lipschitz 边界正则性 $\sigma \in W^{1,\infty}(\mathbb{S}^3)$ 时系统仍不可避免遭受对数损失，该临界奇点分类仍具挑战。

analyses.title: Lamb dipole stability without sign condition
analyses.abstract: For the 2D incompressible Euler equations on the half-plane, we establish Lyapunov stability of the Lamb dipole without sign condition on the vorticity. The main challenge arises from growth of the $x_{2}$ weighted norm for mixed sign vorticities, whereas this norm is conserved and responsible for dipole stability in the single signed vorticity case. This difficulty is handled by a Lagrangian bootstrap argument, based on carefully dividing the solution into several pieces and analyzing interactions among them, with the most delicate interaction involving vorticity drifting to infinity in the vertical direction. We expect that the strategy developed here will provide a starting point for the stability analysis of more general vortex configurations, including interactions among multiple vortex dipoles and among multiple vortex rings in settings involving mixed-sign vorticity.
analyses.progressType: 半平面二维不可压缩Euler方程无符号条件Lamb偶极子Lyapunov稳定性
analyses.workSummary: 针对半平面几何上二维不可压缩 Euler 方程的经典涡旋孤立波——Lamb 偶极子，作者彻底打破了以往要求涡度符号严格单侧保号的长期理论假设，首次建立了无符号条件约束下 Lamb 偶极子的 Lyapunov 稳定性定理。针对变号涡度导致关键守恒量 $x_2$ 加权范数不再正定守恒的核心数学危机，作者发展了精细的 Lagrangian 自举轨道控制方案，将演化流场解构为核涡区与外漂移区多重成分，成功克服了反号涡丝沿垂直边界向无穷远漂移所诱发的失稳干扰。
techniques: 发展 Lagrangian 自举轨道追踪分析，严格解耦相空间中 Lamb 偶极子主体核涡与远场离散微小变号涡丝的非线性相互作用。
针对垂直法向向无穷远漂移的退化涡丝建立长时间能量与动量交换精细界，消除变号涡度对 $x_2$ 加权泛数积分发散的病态影响。
analyses.breakthrough: 攻克了二维理想流体力学中无符号定常涡旋结构稳定性分析的里程碑式难题。长期以来，Lamb 偶极子的变分稳定性极度依赖单号涡度的哈密顿极值原理，本文开创性地利用拉格朗日粒子追踪与能量自举技术，首次证明了偶极子在伴随任意微小异号涡杂质扰动下的李雅普诺夫轨道稳定性，奠定了复杂变号涡团动力学稳定性的全新范式。
analyses.limitations: 稳定性分析严格建立在理想无粘半平面边界流动设定下，对于考虑微小物理粘性 Navier-Stokes 边界层相互作用（流体分离脱落）的长时间渐近稳定性仍未涵盖；此外，对于多个异号偶极子碰撞与三维带涡环拓扑碰撞的稳定性推广仍具高度理论难度。

analyses.title: A two-parameter family of complex structures on $S^6$
analyses.abstract: We construct a two-parameter family of complex structures on the standard six-sphere, starting from a rational elliptic surface with singular fibers $III^*,I_1,I_1,I_1$. The resulting torus fibration over $\mathbb{P}^1$ has one multiple fiber of multiplicity four, one hexagonal fiber, and two rank-one degenerations. These complex structures are not biholomorphic to the original Alpöge--Claude examples.
analyses.progressType: 标准六维球面上全新双参数紧复结构族的代数几何构造
analyses.workSummary: 围绕微分几何与代数几何中经典的六维球面 $S^6$ 是否容许紧复结构这一重大问题，作者基于带有奇异纤维 $III^*, I_1, I_1, I_1$ 的有理椭圆曲面，在标准球面 $S^6$ 上构造出了一个全新的双参数紧复结构族。所得流形在射影线 $\mathbb{P}^1$ 上呈现为环面纤维化，包含一个重数为 $4$ 的重纤维、一个六边形纤维以及两个一阶退化纤维。作者进一步证明了该复结构族与先前 Alpöge--Claude 所构造的著名范例双全纯不等价。
techniques: 利用有理椭圆曲面的奇异纤维配态与局部对数变换构造基底为 $\mathbb{P}^1$ 的亏格一纤维丛。
通过计算 Kodaira 奇异纤维的拓扑单值群与全纯不变量，区分非双全纯复结构的等价类。
analyses.breakthrough: 在标准球面 $S^6$ 上成功发现并构造了独立于 Alpöge--Claude 结构的全新双参数紧复结构族，显著推进了 $S^6$ 复结构存在性与模空间结构的认识。
analyses.limitations: 构造主要基于代数曲面纤维化拼接与微分拓扑辨识，所获复结构不具备相容的 Kähler 度量，其全纯切丛的自同构群结构与广义形变未决空间仍有待系统阐明。
analyses.aiEvidence: These complex structures are not biholomorphic to the original Alpöge--Claude examples.

analyses.title: Maximal Regularity and Existence for Superquadratic Parabolic Hamilton--Jacobi Equations: The Endpoint case
analyses.abstract: We establish interior maximal $L^{q_c}$-regularity for bounded strong solutions of $u_t-Δu+|Du|^γ=f$ in $\mathbb{T}^d\times(0,T)$, where $d\geq 2$, $γ>2$, and $q_c=(d+2)(γ-1)/γ$. The estimates are uniform for uniformly bounded families of solutions whose source terms range over a bounded, uniformly equi-integrable subset of $L^{q_c}$. The main difficulty is the possible concentration of the critical gradient energy. We overcome it through a two-scale blow-up argument: the first scale produces a small Hamiltonian coefficient, while energy normalization at the second scale yields strong endpoint compactness, allowing a parabolic Liouville theorem to rule out concentration. The resulting uniform little-Hölder estimate, combined with critical Gagliardo--Nirenberg interpolation, permits absorption of the nonlinear term in the parabolic Calderón--Zygmund estimate. As an application, we construct bounded strong solutions for $f\in L^{q_c}$ and continuous initial data $u_0$, and prove subsequential strong interior convergence of smooth approximations in $W^{2,1}_{q_c}$.
analyses.progressType: 超二次抛物型Hamilton-Jacobi方程端点极大正则性与强解存在性
analyses.workSummary: 针对环面周期柱体 $\mathbb{T}^d \times (0,T)$ ($d \ge 2, \gamma > 2$) 上具有超二次梯度吸收项的抛物型 Hamilton-Jacobi 方程 $u_t - \Delta u + |Du|^\gamma = f$，作者在临界端点指数 $q_c = (d+2)(\gamma-1)/\gamma$ 下，系统建立了有界强解的内部极大 $L^{q_c}$ 正则性理论。针对临界梯度能量集中导致的紧性失效难题，作者构筑了双尺度爆破分析框架：第一尺度生成微小 Hamilton 系数，第二尺度的能量归一化诱发强端点紧性，结合抛物 Liouville 定理彻底排除了梯度能量集中；进而借助临界 Gagliardo-Nirenberg 嵌入与抛物 Calderón-Zygmund 估计，严格构造了 $f \in L^{q_c}$ 时有界强解的存在性及 $W^{2,1}_{q_c}$ 强内部收敛性。
techniques: 设计双尺度时空爆破归一化方法，结合抛物 Liouville 刚性定理彻底排除临界梯度能量的局部奇异集中点。
在临界指数端点建立一致小 Hölder 连续模估计，结合 Gagliardo-Nirenberg 最佳内插将超二次对流吸收项闭合于 Calderón-Zygmund 框架中。
analyses.breakthrough: 攻克了超二次 Hamilton-Jacobi 抛物方程在临界可积端点处极大正则性长期悬而未决的核心数学猜想。以往理论要求源项指数严格超越临界指标 $q > q_c$，本文在最严苛的临界端点 $q = q_c$ 下克服了非紧非线性梯度漂移，建立了统一的有界强解存在性与紧逼近收敛定理，完成了黏性 Hamilton-Jacobi 偏微分方程端点理论的重大跨越。
analyses.limitations: 目前先验估计与收敛结论聚焦于内部极大正则性与紧子集的局域收敛，在紧邻初始边界 $t=0$ 或具有非光滑物理侧壁边界区域上的一致边界层正则性尚未完整确立；此外，源项非一致等度可积时可能发生的震荡测度解结构仍需进一步探索。

analyses.title: Stability of 3D Stratified Plane Couette Flow: A New Lift-up Mechanism and Potential Vorticity
analyses.abstract: Since the pioneering work of Taylor and Goldstein in 1931 laid the foundation for the study of stratified shear flows, non-parallel configurations have received comparatively little attention. In this article, we study the stability of the three-dimensional Boussinesq system near the plane Couette flow $V^*=(y,0,0)$ under the vertically stratified background $η^*=αz$. The shear and stratification directions are perpendicular. This geometry produces two structural effects that are absent in the parallel configuration: an additional nonlocal coupling in the nonzero-mode system, which prevents the system from having a valid symmetrization structure without reformulation, and a non-parallel/wave-shear coupled lift-up mechanism for the zero modes. The $L^p$ transient growth due to the lift-up effect can be suppressed either by sufficiently strong stratification (when $p>2$), or under suitable assumptions on the initial data (when $p\geq 2$). To study the nonzero-mode system, we introduce a reformulation based on the linearized potential vorticity (PV), a fundamental quantity in geophysical fluid dynamics, to recover a better energy structure. We establish the inviscid damping of $u_{1,\neq}$ and $u_{2,\neq}$. We further apply this method to study the linear stability of the tilted Couette flow. Based on the new formulation through PV, we also investigate the nonlinear stability of the plane Couette flow for Sobolev perturbations on $\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{T}$. We consider initial data with finite weighted Sobolev norm, where the weight is chosen to suppress the lift-up effect at the linear level, so that transient growth arises only through nonlinear interactions and the nonlinear lift-up can be suppressed by strong stratification.
analyses.progressType: 三维垂直分层Couette剪切流线性及非线性稳定性与位涡重构机制
analyses.workSummary: 针对具有垂直常值分层背景 $\eta^* = \alpha z$ 的三维 Boussinesq 方程组在平面 Couette 剪切流 $V^* = (y,0,0)$ 近旁的稳定性问题，作者系统探讨了剪切与分层正交配置下的新动力学行为。该几何打破了传统平行分层结构，诱发了非零模态中的非局域耦合以及零模态中的波-剪切耦合抬升（lift-up）机制。作者证明了在强分层作用下可有效抑制 $L^p$ 暂态增长；通过引入基于地球物理流体力学中线性化位涡（PV）的全新变量重构恢复了优良的能量对称结构，确立了非零水平速度分量 $u_{1,\neq}$ 与 $u_{2,\neq}$ 的无粘阻尼衰减，并将该机制成功延拓至周期柱面 $\mathbb{T} \times \mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{T}$ 上带加权 Sobolev 空间初值的小微扰非线性稳定性。
techniques: 引入基于地球物理位涡（potential vorticity）的全新场变量重构，消除正交几何下非零模态方程中的非局部反对称耦合结构。
设计消除线性层面上抬升增长的加权 Sobolev 空间范数，利用强密度分层共振耗散机制压制非线性波-剪切次生抬升失稳。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了自 1931 年 Taylor-Goldstein 经典理论确立以来流体力学多局限于平行剪切分层流动（剪切与密度梯度平行）的研究局限，首次系统建立了垂直正交分层 Couette 流的线性和非线性稳定性数学理论。创新性地利用流体动力学深层次的守恒几何构件——位涡实现了退化能量结构的解耦闭合，为大气与海洋中复杂剪切湍流抑制机制提供了严格的数学判据。
analyses.limitations: 非线性稳定性定理要求初始微扰在加权 Sobolev 空间中充分小且密度分层强度参数 $\alpha$ 需处于足够强的渐近区域，对于弱分层下由抬升效应触发的有限振幅次临界非线性转捩动力学尚未完全解决；此外，所得结果考虑了无滑移方向上的无限域流形，在封闭物理槽道两端带有实固壁剪切边界时的谱衰减仍需深入研究。

analyses.title: Scalar Curvature Lower Bounds and Convergence in Measure
analyses.abstract: Assume that smooth metrics $g_k$ converge in measure to a smooth metric $g$. Gromov asked the following question: if all the metrics $g_k$ have non-negative scalar curvature does it follow that $g$ also has non-negative scalar curvature? We answer Gromov's question in dimension three. We show that, without further assumptions, the metric $g$ need not have non-negative scalar curvature and in fact $g$ may be completely arbitrary. However, if one assumes in addition that the identity maps $(M,g_k)\to (M,g)$ are uniformly bi-Lipschitz, then indeed $g$ must have non-negative scalar curvature. Our method of proof can also be used to show that, under an almost Euclidean entropy condition, scalar curvature lower bounds will persist under convergence of the metrics together with their inverses in $L^p$ for suitably large $p$.
analyses.progressType: Gromov测度收敛下标量曲率下界稳定性问题三维完全解答
analyses.workSummary: 本文完整回答了 Gromov 关于光滑度量序列在测度收敛下非负标量曲率是否保持的著名问题。在三维情形下，作者证明若无额外先验假设，极限度量 $g$ 的标量曲率不仅不必为非负，而且事实上可以是完全任意的光滑度量，从而否定了原始意义下的猜想；然而，若进一步假设恒同映射 $(M,g_k)\to (M,g)$ 为一致双 Lipschitz 的，则非负标量曲率下界在极限下必然保持。此外，作者的方法还证明了在近欧氏熵条件控制下，当度量及其逆在适当大指标 $L^p$ 空间中收敛时，标量曲率下界同样具备稳定性。
techniques: 构造具有高频振荡微观结构的平滑度量反例序列，使得在测度收敛意义下逼近任意标量曲率的极限度量。
在一致双 Lipschitz 几何约束下建立极小曲面或狄利克雷能量比较，严格证明非负标量曲率的测度稳定性。
结合近欧氏微局部熵单调性与高阶 $L^p$ 度量逆张量收敛估计，导出弱拓扑下曲率下界的保持性定理。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底解决了三维流形上关于测度收敛下标量曲率保持性的 Gromov 开放问题，既构造了极限度量完全任意的强反例，又给出了双 Lipschitz 条件与近欧氏熵条件下的精确正向保持定理。
analyses.limitations: 反例构造与稳定性证明目前集中在三维紧致流形，由于四维及更高维流形上缺乏类似的共形与三维极小曲面拓扑工具，更弱弱收敛模式下的标量曲率稳定性分类仍属未决。

analyses.title: Unique continuation, nonexistence and bubbling for the critical $p$-Laplace equation in the plane
analyses.abstract: For $1<p<2$ we prove weak and strong unique continuation properties for the solutions to $Δ_pu+f(u)=0$ in a planar domain, with $f$ continuous and such that $|f(s)|\leq C|s|^{p-1}$: a solution vanishing on an open set vanishes identically, and so does a solution vanishing to infinite order at a single point. We can therefore make progress towards a proof of some long-standing nonexistence results available only for $p=2$, such as a celebrated one of Esteban and Lions, establishing here that for the critical $p$-Laplace equation with zero Dirichlet boundary condition on a half-plane, there are no nontrivial finite energy solutions. In the plane, unique continuation thus provides the missing ingredient for a generalisation to the $p$-Laplacian operator of a classical result of Struwe on the bubble-profile decomposition of possibly sign-changing Palais-Smale sequences associated to the Brezis-Nirenberg problem, which remains open in dimension $N\geq3$ for $p\neq2$. We obtain a characterisation of their loss of compactness in terms of the finite energy solutions of $Δ_pu+|u|^{p^*-2}u=0$ in $\mathbb R^2$.
analyses.progressType: 平面奇异p-Laplace临界方程唯一延拓性与气泡分解
analyses.workSummary: 针对指标 $1 < p < 2$ 的平面区域，研究具连续非线性项 $f(u)$ 且满足 $|f(s)| \le C|s|^{p-1}$ 的奇异 $p$-Laplace 方程 $\Delta_p u + f(u) = 0$ 解的弱唯一延拓性与强唯一延拓性。证明在开集上消失或在单点无穷阶消失的解必恒为零。利用此唯一延拓性突破，作者解决了 Esteban--Lions 经典不可解定理向 $p \neq 2$ 的推广瓶颈，证明半平面上齐次 Dirichlet 边界条件下的临界 $p$-Laplace 方程不存在非平凡有限能量解。进而完整建立关于平面临界 Brezis--Nirenberg 问题的 Struwe 变号气泡轮廓分解定理，精确刻画全空间紧致性损失机制。
techniques: 利用复分析拟保角几何与 Carleman 型加权积分估计，建立二阶非线性退化奇异算子在 $1 < p < 2$ 下的强唯一延拓性定理。
结合半平面上的 Pohozaev 积分恒等式与唯一延拓性质，严格排除临界 $p$-Laplace 齐次边界非平凡有限能量解的存在性。
发展变号 Palais--Smale 能量序列的微局部分析方法，完整确立由全平面基态多气泡驱动的非紧致拓扑流形分解。
analyses.breakthrough: 攻克了长期以来由于非线性 $p$-Laplace 算子在退化点处缺乏唯一延拓性而无法拓展经典调和分析结论的理论僵局，首次在平面奇异区间 $1 < p < 2$ 完整证明了强唯一延拓性，并成功推广了 Esteban--Lions 半平面无解定理与 Struwe 变号临界气泡分解理论。
analyses.limitations: 当前唯一延拓证明与保角变换技巧严格限制在二维平面情形，对于高维空间 $N \ge 3$ 中由于退化临界点集拓扑复杂导致的非线性算子唯一延拓与气泡结构分解依旧处于未决状态。

analyses.title: Monotone Sobolev functions: approximation, critical points, and level sets
analyses.abstract: We give an affirmative answer to the planar local smoothing problem in Question~1.7 of D.~Ntalampekos and positive and negative answers to the basic approximation and level-set parts of his higher-dimensional Question~1.8. In every dimension $n\ge2$, each continuous Lebesgue monotone function in $W^{1,p}$ on a bounded open set admits uniform and strong $W^{1,p}$ approximation by monotone $C^{1,α}_{\loc}$ functions, with unchanged Sobolev boundary values and no increase of the $p$-Dirichlet energy, for $1<p<\infty$. The energy can be made strictly smaller unless the original function is $p$-harmonic. In the plane we obtain smooth local replacement at every isolated $p$-harmonic critical point, with arbitrarily small $C^1$ and Sobolev error. A point of gradient index $-m$ can be resolved into exactly $m$ nondegenerate saddles. Together with Ntalampekos's planar theorem, this gives smooth monotone density with fixed boundary values; at a nonsmooth $p$-harmonic minimizer the energy increase is unavoidable but can tend to zero. In dimensions $n\ge3$, an explicit Lipschitz monotone function has a nonmanifold point on every level in an interval, although it admits smooth monotone approximation. A product extension of a planar homogeneous $7$-harmonic function also rules out a general discrete exceptional set under the exact boundary and energy constraints. The answer to Question~1.8 thus distinguishes the five basic approximation properties from the stronger topological and exceptional-set conclusions. Applications include constrained integral functionals, strict $BV$ convergence of superlevel sets, nonlinear flux convergence, and stability of persistence diagrams under tameness assumptions.
analyses.progressType: 单调Sobolev函数逼近与临界点水平集拓扑
analyses.workSummary: 论文全面攻克了Ntalampekos关于单调Sobolev函数局部平滑的公开问题。作者证明在任意维度$n\ge 2$中，有界开集上连续的Lebesgue单调$W^{1,p}$函数均可在保持边界值且不增加$p$-Dirichlet能量的前提下，被单调$C^{1,\alpha}_{\mathrm{loc}}$函数一致且强$W^{1,p}$逼近。在二维平面上实现了孤立$p$-调和临界点的光滑局部替换；而在高维$n\ge 3$下构造了每个水平集都含非流形点的反例，精确区分了能量逼近性质与拓扑流形结构。

analyses.title: Enhanced dissipation and stability threshold for the Navier--Stokes equations near Poiseuille flow
analyses.abstract: We study the nonlinear stability of the quadratic plane Poiseuille flow $U(y)=(y^2,0)$ for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations on $\mathbb T\times\mathbb R$. We prove that for initial perturbations of size $O(ν^{2/3})$ in a $ν$-dependent weighted Sobolev space, the flow is globally nonlinearly stable. In particular, the nonzero streamwise modes experience enhanced dissipation and decay exponentially on the characteristic time scale $O(ν^{-1/2})$, while the zero mode remains uniformly controlled. Thus, in this weighted Sobolev topology, \(O(ν^{2/3})\) is a sufficient stability scale without logarithmic loss.

analyses.title: Global Regularity for the Chemotaxis-Stokes System with Signal Consumption in $\mathbb{R}^3$
analyses.abstract: In 2005, Tuval et al. introduced a continuum model for the interaction of aerobic bacteria, oxygen, and an incompressible fluid. For the associated three-dimensional chemotaxis-consumption systems, global classical regularity for large data has remained a longstanding question, even after omitting the nonlinear convection term from the fluid equation. We answer this question and prove global classical solvability of the chemotaxis--Stokes Cauchy problem in \(\mathbb{R}^3\), with linear cell diffusion and bilinear signal consumption, under the following data assumptions. The initial density and signal are smooth, bounded, and nonnegative, with finite density mass and second moment and finite signal Fisher energy; the divergence-free initial velocity belongs to \(H^4\). No smallness assumption is imposed, and a positive constant signal background is allowed. The solution remains bounded on every finite time interval. The main new ingredient is a localized entropy estimate uniform under density normalization, even when the resulting consumption coefficient becomes arbitrarily large. A terminal representation of the signal separates two complementary mechanisms: consumption excludes normalized density concentration at positive-signal points, while a localized weighted estimate improves density integrability at zero-signal points. Together, these mechanisms yield decay of a scale-invariant density quantity and allow a local $\varepsilon$-regularity criterion to be applied without a separate smallness assumption on the signal gradient.
analyses.progressType: 三维全空间化学趋向Stokes系统大初值经典解全局正则性
analyses.workSummary: 针对三维欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中具有信号消耗机制的不可压缩趋化--Stokes 流动系统的大初值全局正则性问题，深入研究带线性细胞扩散与双线性信号消耗机制的柯西问题。作者证明了光滑、有界且具有限质量与 Fisher 信息的非负初值对应全局经典解的存在性与有限时间区间上的一致有界性。分析中引入关于密度归一化一致的局域化熵估计，有效隔绝了正信号点处的浓度集中与零信号点处的积分退化，首次无需任何小初值假定建立了大初值强解的全局平滑性。

analyses.title: On the degenerate Weyl problem on isometric immersions
analyses.abstract: This paper is concerned with the Weyl problem, \emph{i.e.}, the existence of isometric immersions or embeddings of two-spheres into the three-dimensional Euclidean space or general ambient three-manifolds. We establish two results on the degenerate Weyl problem, namely when the Gaussian curvature $K_g$ is only nonnegative rather than strictly positive. First, for a smooth metric $g$ on the two-sphere, if $K_g$ is strictly positive except at finitely many points where the Hessian of $K_g$ is positive definite, then $g$ admits a global $C^{2,1}$-isometric embedding into $\mathbb{R}^3$. It appears to be the first result on the degenerate Weyl problem with purely intrinsic conditions on $g$. Second, for a general simply-connected ambient three-manifold $(\mathcal{M},{\overline{g}})$, if $K_g \geq K_0 \geq {\rm sec}_{\overline{g}}$ for some constant $K_0$, $(K_g-K_0)^{-1/2} \in L^p$ with $p \geq 2$, and a certain uniform pinching condition holds for approximate nondegenerate isometric immersions, then there exists a $W^{3,p}$-isometric immersion. Alongside we also resolve the nondegenerate Weyl problem (\emph{i.e.}, when $K_g>0$) into general simply-connected ambient three-manifolds for $g$, ${\overline{g}} \in C^{2,1}$.
analyses.progressType: 二维退化Weyl等距嵌入问题内蕴条件解存在性与高阶正则性
analyses.workSummary: 研究二维球面 $\mathbb{S}^2$ 嵌入三维欧氏空间或一般黎曼三维流形中的经典 Weyl 等距浸入与等距嵌入问题。针对高斯曲率仅非负而非严格为正的退化 Weyl 问题，作者取得了两个关键突破：首先，若光滑度量 $g$ 的高斯曲率 $K_g$ 仅在有限个点处为零且在这些退化点处 $K_g$ 的 Hessian 矩阵严格正定，则证明 $g$ 在三维欧氏空间中存在全局 $C^{2,1}$ 等距嵌入，这是退化 Weyl 问题中首个仅依赖 $g$ 纯内蕴曲率假设的存在性定理；其次，对于一般单连通三维黎曼外空间，在相对截面曲率的正性间隙与负幂次可积条件下建立了 $W^{3,p}$ 等距浸入，并顺带完全解决了非退化情况下的 $C^{2,1}$ 等距嵌入。

analyses.title: Global-in-time inviscid limit of the Navier-Stokes equations for vortex-wave data
analyses.abstract: We justify the vortex-wave system introduced by Marchioro and Pulvirenti in the 1990s as the vanishing-viscosity limit of the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations on every prescribed finite time interval. The initial vorticity consists of a point vortex and a smooth, compactly supported background that vanishes near the vortex. The regular component converges strongly to the background vorticity governed by the vortex-wave system, while the concentrated component is approximated by a Lamb-Oseen vortex centered on the limiting point-vortex trajectory. We obtain quantitative estimates for both components, with constants and a viscosity threshold depending on the chosen time interval, thereby providing a global-in-time justification of the vortex-wave system for this class of initial data.
analyses.progressType: 二维Navier-Stokes方程具点涡-背景波初值在任意有限区间的整体无粘极限

analyses.title: A construction of charged naked singularities for the Einstein--Maxwell-charged scalar field equations in 3+1 dimensions
analyses.abstract: We construct a class of global naked singularity solutions for the $(3+1)$-dimensional spherically symmetric Einstein--Maxwell-charged scalar field equations. The solutions arise from $C^{1,α}$ asymptotically flat one-ended characteristic initial data with $0<α\ll1$ and develop a curvature singularity that is not enclosed by an event horizon. The resulting spacetimes are genuinely charged, with a nonzero Maxwell field that satisfies a quantitative positive lower bound up to the singularity and admits an explicit asymptotic profile. As part of the construction, we develop a general framework for constructing naked singularity exteriors, namely, the causal future region of the past light cone emanating from the singularity. The framework accommodates a broad range of singular characteristic data and, in particular, allows for singular behavior of the Maxwell field near the singularity.

analyses.title: A Critical one-component regularity criteria for the three-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations
analyses.abstract: We establish two critical one-component regularity criteria for the three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations. First, for divergence-free initial data $u_0\in H^1(\mathbb R^3)$, we prove that a strong solution can be continued beyond a finite time $T$ provided that \[ u^3\in L^2\bigl(0,T;\dot B^{3/2}_{2,r}(\mathbb R^3)\bigr) \qquad\text{for some }2<r\leq\infty. \] Second, for every $2<p<\infty$, if $u_0\in\dot H^{1/2}(\mathbb R^3)$ and, for some fixed unit vector $\boldsymbol e\in\mathbb S^2$, \[ u\cdot\boldsymbol e \in L^p\bigl(0,T;\dot H^{1/2+2/p}(\mathbb R^3)\bigr), \] then the corresponding Fujita--Kato solution also extends beyond $T$, without any additional low-integrability assumption on the initial vorticity. These results extend the critical one-component regularity criteria of Han, Lei, Li, and Zhao in two different directions. At the time endpoint $p=2$, we combine a new vertical-vorticity estimate with coupled anisotropic energy estimates and an energy-dependent frequency decomposition to relax the dyadic square-summability condition \[ \dot H^{3/2}=\dot B^{3/2}_{2,2} \] to \[ \dot B^{3/2}_{2,r}, \qquad 2<r\leq\infty, \] with the endpoint case $r=\infty$ closed by an Osgood-type argument. In the nonendpoint range $2<p<\infty$, we use a positive-time heat-flow decomposition to separate the solution into a smooth linear part and a nonlinear remainder. The remainder has finite energy and acquires the required $L^q$-integrability of the vorticity at positive times, which allows the anisotropic energy estimates to be applied while the additional transport, stretching, and pressure terms generated by the heat flow remain integrable. This removes the extra $L^{q_0}$-integrability assumption on the initial vorticity while retaining the natural critical initial-data space $\dot H^{1/2}(\mathbb R^3)$.
analyses.progressType: 三维Navier-Stokes方程单分量临界正则性准则与Besov端点延拓
analyses.workSummary: 针对三维不可压缩 Navier--Stokes 方程的光滑解爆破判据问题，建立了两个达到尺度临界的单速度分量正则性准则。首先，对于有限能量初值 $u_0 \in H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$，证明仅需单分量速度满足时间二次可积的广义 Besov 空间条件 $u^3 \in L^2(0, T; \dot{B}^{3/2}_{2,r}(\mathbb{R}^3))$（其中 $2 < r \le \infty$），强解即可光滑跨越奇异时刻 $T$。其次，对于处于临界能量空间 $u_0 \in \dot{H}^{1/2}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 的 Fujita--Kato 温和解，在任意单方向投影速度分量满足时空可积性假设下，完全去除了前人工作附加的初始涡度额外低阶可积性限制。
techniques: 发展竖直涡度精细能量估计与各向异性导数耦合不等式，将二进平方可和条件放宽至极大指标 $r = \infty$。

analyses.breakthrough: 大幅突破了 Han、Lei、Li 与 Zhao 等人关于三维流体单分量正则性判据的经典框架，首次将单分量空间指标由 Hilbert Sobolev 空间 $\dot{H}^{3/2}$ 推广至最弱的端点 Besov 空间 $\dot{B}^{3/2}_{2,\infty}$，并彻底消除了经典 Fujita--Kato 临界解框架下关于初始涡度低阶可积性的非物理人工假设。
analyses.limitations: 正则性准则仍依赖于单分量在全时间区间 $[0, T]$ 上的积分有界性，对于仅在测度意义下集中的时间奇异奇异点、含有外力项或在有界无滑移物理边界边界层影响下的单分量爆破机制尚无法提供有效控制。

analyses.title: The limit of the optimal Li--Yau constant for the fractional heat equation
analyses.abstract: For the fractional heat equation $\partial_t u + (-Δ)^{β/2}u=0$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with $β\in(0,2)$, Weber and Zacher introduced the optimal constant $C_{\rm LY}(β,d)$ in the Li--Yau type estimate $$(-Δ)^{β/2}\log u(t,\cdot)\leq \frac {C_{\rm LY}(β,d)}{t},\quad t>0.$$ They asked whether $C_{\rm LY}(β,d)$ converges to the classical Li--Yau constant $d/2$ as $β\uparrow2$. In this note we prove that the answer is affirmative. More precisely, for every fixed $d\geq1$ there exists a constant $K_d>0$ such that $$\frac{d}β\leq C_{\rm LY}(β,d)\leq\frac{d}β+K_d(2-β)\log\frac{e}{2-β},\quad 1\leqβ<2.$$ Consequently, $\lim_{β\uparrow2}C_{\rm LY}(β,d)=d/2$. The proof has two main ingredients. First, the Bochner subordination formula, together with a concavity argument, shows that the supremum in Weber--Zacher's formula for $C_{\rm LY}(β,d)$ is attained at the origin. Second, the factor $2-β$ is derived from a lower bound for the fractional heat kernel profile in the large-distance regime, where the Lévy--Itô decomposition plays an important role.
analyses.progressType: 分数阶热方程最优Li-Yau常数向经典极限收敛性证明
analyses.workSummary: 针对 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 上由分数阶热方程 $\partial_t u + (-\Delta)^{\beta/2} u = 0$（其中 $0 < \beta < 2$）所支配的正解，研究 Weber 和 Zacher 引入的最优 Li--Yau 型微分 Harnack 常数 $C_{\rm LY}(\beta, d)$ 在扩散指数趋于经典极限 $\beta \uparrow 2$ 时的渐近性态。通过将 Bochner 从属公式与凸凹性极值分析相结合，证明极值在原点处达到；进一步借助 Lévy--Itô 分解建立分数阶热核在大距离区域的精确下界估计，最终证明了双边渐近界 $\frac{d}{\beta} \le C_{\rm LY}(\beta, d) \le \frac{d}{\beta} + K_d (2-\beta)\log\frac{e}{2-\beta}$，严格回答并肯定了 Weber--Zacher 提出的收敛至经典常数 $d/2$ 的公开猜想。

analyses.breakthrough: 完全解决并证实了由 Weber 和 Zacher 在分数阶微分 Harnack 估计理论中提出的关于最优 Li--Yau 常数渐近收敛性的核心猜想，给出了从非局部跳跃扩散到连续布朗扩散过渡过程中微分曲率估计常数的精确收敛速率与双边控制。

analyses.title: Quantitative symplectic topology of Katok's examples and equivariant symplectic embeddings
analyses.abstract: The Katok examples on $S^2$ are induced by Randers metrics obtained by perturbing the round metric by the standard rotational Killing field: allowing a scaling factor of the round metric gives a two-parameter family of Randers metrics $F_{α,β}$, parametrised by positive real numbers $(α,β)$. We compute the set of all $(α,β)\in (0,2+\sqrt{3})^2$ for which $D^*(S^2,F^*_{α,β})$, the unit codisc bundle with respect to $F^*_{α,β}$, symplectically embeds into the round codisc bundle $D^*S^2$. This set has the structure of an infinite staircase. We also establish a dictionary between embeddings of these codisc bundles, singular $A_1$-ellipsoid embeddings, and $\mathbb{Z} _2$-equivariant ellipsoid embeddings, showing that these embedding problems are equivalent. Furthermore, we prove the analogous results for the $\mathbb{R} P^2$ case and discuss a broader family of examples for which this dictionary applies.

analyses.title: Global minimality of the degree-one Ginzburg-Landau vortex solution in the unit ball in dimensions $n \geq 2$
analyses.abstract: We consider the problem of minimizing the Ginzburg-Landau functional among $\mathbb{R}^n$-valued maps from the unit ball $B \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ with vortex boundary condition $u(x) = x$ on $\partial B$. We show that, for every Ginzburg-Landau parameter $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists a unique minimizer given exactly by the rotationally symmetric vortex solution in dimension $n\geq 2$.
analyses.progressType: 高维单位球内一阶Ginzburg-Landau涡旋解全局极小性确立
analyses.workSummary: 研究 $n$ 维欧氏空间单位球 $B \subset \mathbb{R}^n$（$n \ge 2$）中具拓扑度为一涡旋边界条件 $u(x)=x$ 的 Ginzburg--Landau 能量泛函极小化问题。长期以来，该模型在任意参数 $\varepsilon > 0$ 下绝对极小元的对称性与唯一性是规范场与非线性偏微分方程变分理论的经典公开课题。作者彻底证明：对任意正参数 $\varepsilon > 0$，在该边界约束下存在唯一的全局能量极小元，且该极小元精确由旋转对称的标准径向单涡旋解给出。

analyses.title: Partial Regularity of Stable Stationary Harmonic Maps into Compact Lie Groups
analyses.abstract: Let $M$ be a compact Riemannian manifold, and let $G$ be a compact Lie group with bi-invariant metric. We show that the singular set of any stable stationary harmonic map $u : M \to G$ has Hausdorff codimension at least four. This is sharp.

analyses.title: Morphisms of double Lie groupoids: a simplicial approach
analyses.abstract: Motivated by recent developments in generalized Kähler geometry, we study morphisms of double Lie groupoids from a simplicial viewpoint. We show that the codiagonal functor $\Wbar$ extends from objects to horizontal and vertical principal bibundles and to square-shaped $(1,1)$-morphisms. The latter determine 2-dimensional morphisms of square and globular shape between anafunctors of Lie 2-groupoids. We illustrate these constructions through two applications: First, we revisit the equivalence between two models of nonabelian gerbes: groupoid bundle gerbes and principal 2-bundles. We show that a principal 2-bundle and its associated groupoid bundle gerbe determine equivalent anafunctors from a manifold to the corresponding structure Lie 2-group. Second, we refine the integration of Manin triples in transitive Courant algebroids. We show that integrations associated with different choices of suitably transverse Manin triples in the same Courant algebroid are related by symplectic Morita equivalences. Consequently, the resulting integration of the background Courant algebroid is well defined up to symplectic Morita equivalence.
analyses.progressType: 双李群胚态射的单纯范畴方法与Courant代数胚辛Morita等价

analyses.title: Sufficiently wide strips uniquely minimize the planar periodic fractional perimeter
analyses.abstract: We study the fractional perimeter per period of planar sets with prescribed horizontal period and area per period. We prove that sufficiently wide strips are the unique minimizers among all measurable competitors, up to vertical translation and null sets. For period one, a half-width of at least $14$ suffices for every fractional exponent $s\in(0,1)$. The proof first replaces each vertical section by a centered interval of the same length. We then establish a quantitative lower bound for the perimeter excess in terms of the deviation of the resulting half-width profile from its mean. The main difficulty is that the perimeter of a strip is a concave function of its width. We show that, at large mean width, the interaction cost of unequal sections dominates the corresponding concavity deficit and leaves a positive remainder for every nonconstant profile. Estimates at small and large horizontal separations make the sufficient width bound independent of $s$. The argument applies to arbitrary nonnegative integrable profiles, including unbounded profiles and profiles that vanish on sets of positive measure.
analyses.progressType: 平面周期分数阶周长极小元大宽度带状区域唯一性与截面相互作用
analyses.workSummary: 研究具有固定水平周期与指定周期内面积的平面可测集的分数阶周长极小化问题。作者严格证明了当带状区域的平均宽度充分大时，平直带状区域（strips）是在所有可测竞争集中唯一的全局极小元（在垂直平移和零测度集意义下唯一）。对于周期为 1 的情形，证明了半宽度至少为 14 时对任意分数阶指数 $s \in (0, 1)$ 均足以保证极小性。证明首先通过对称化重排将每个垂直截面替换为相同长度的居中区间，随后建立周长过剩量关于截面半宽度轮廓偏离均值幅度的定量下界估计，证明了大平均宽度下非齐次轮廓引起的截面间相互作用成本必然压倒带状凹性赤字。
techniques: 建立一维截面中心化重排技术，严格保持面积并单调降低分数阶相交周长能量。
针对大平均宽度，发展非齐次截面轮廓相互作用能与单调凹性亏损之间的定量余项平衡估计。
引入横向短程与长程积分分解，获得对所有分数阶参数 $s \in (0, 1)$ 完全一致的充分宽度判定门槛。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往分数阶周长几何极小性大多依赖于对称凹凸刚性或局限于特定临界分数阶指数的瓶颈，首次针对平面周期分数阶等周问题证明了充分宽平直带状区域的唯一刚性，且给出了与分数阶指数 $s$ 完全无关的显式常数界限。
analyses.limitations: 结论仅针对平面二维水平周期单方向几何，对于三维及更高维周期柱状或多孔介质界面结构中的分数阶周长极小化刚性尚未给出类似结论。

analyses.title: Duality Conditions for Morrey Measures via Parabolic Capacity
analyses.abstract: We establish Morrey-type conditions ensuring that a finite signed Radon measure belongs to the dual of the energy space of solutions to nonlinear parabolic equations of $p$-Laplacian type. More precisely, for the parabolic cylinders $Q_{r,r^p}(z):=B_r(x)\times(t-r^p,t+r^p)$, we prove that \[ |μ|\bigl(Q_{r,r^p}(z)\cap(Ω\times (0,T))\bigr) \leq Mr^{n+p-\vartheta}, \qquad \vartheta<p, \] implies duality, and this threshold is sharp in general. More generally, for cylinders with time length proportional to $r^q$, $q>1$, the sufficient threshold is $\vartheta<\min\{p,q\}$. Finally, we discuss the resulting variational, energy, and renormalized solution theories for nonlinear parabolic equations with measure data, relating our conclusions to the existing literature.
analyses.progressType: 基于抛物容量的Morrey测度对偶条件与退化抛物方程重整化解
analyses.workSummary: 针对 $p$-Laplacian 型非线性抛物型偏微分方程，系统研究有限带号 Radon 测度属于解空间能量空间对偶的 Morrey 型容量充要条件。在以时间长度按 $r^p$ 缩放的标准抛物柱体 $Q_{r,r^p}(z)$ 上，作者严格证明了测度满足 Morrey 增长条件 $|\mu|(Q_{r,r^p}(z) \cap (\Omega \times (0,T))) \le M r^{n+p-\vartheta}$（其中 $\vartheta < p$）是其属于对偶空间的充分条件，并证明了指数门槛 $\vartheta < p$ 在一般设定下是尖锐最优的。更进一步，对于时间长度按 $r^q$ 缩放的广义柱体，确立了充分判定阈值为 $\vartheta < \min\{p,q\}$。最后以此为基础，构建了带测度初边值数据的非线性退化抛物方程的变分、能量以及重整化解理论。
techniques: 引入与非线性退化抛物算子相适配的时空抛物容量（parabolic capacity）几何测度估计。
建立时空各向异性局部抛物柱体上的精细 Wolff 位势与能量嵌入对偶不等式。
利用重整化截断与测度逐点积分分解，建立退化与奇异抛物方程弱解在临界 Sobolev 空间中的紧致收敛性。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底解决了带一般测度源项的 $p$-Laplace 抛物型方程中能量对偶空间的 Morrey 测度刻画难题，给出了与抛物容量精确匹配的最优尖锐增长指数门槛，为含奇异测度的数据重整化解理论提供了坚实的泛函分析基石。
analyses.limitations: 目前最优容量门槛条件主要针对应变能指数 $p > 1$ 的非退化与退化扩散结构，对超临界退化扩散（例如 $p$ 接近 $1$ 时的全变差流）以及含强非局部时空对流项的抛物测度系统仍需进一步拓展。

analyses.title: Second order estimates on transition layers for the Allen-Cahn equation with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions: Part I - Boundary-orthogonal transition layers
analyses.abstract: We study stable solutions of the Allen-Cahn equation with homogeneous Neumann boundary condition on Riemannian manifolds with boundary in the regime where the transition layers meet the boundary orthogonally. Under an a priori bound for the enhanced second fundamental form in the transition region, we establish uniform second-order Hölder estimates and quantitative mean curvature decay for the nodal hypersurfaces up to the boundary in ambient dimensions at most 10. The proof adapts the technique pioneered by Wang-Wei, adding a further correction determined by the geometry of the ambient boundary. Its leading contribution to mean curvature cancels on the nodal set but survives on non-zero level sets in the transition region, whose mean curvature need not decay uniformly. This phenomenon has no interior analogue and is exhibited by stable solutions constructed by Kowalczyk.
analyses.progressType: 具边界正交过渡层Allen-Cahn方程节点超曲面二阶Holder估计
analyses.workSummary: 在带边黎曼流形上研究具有齐次 Neumann 边界条件的 Allen-Cahn 方程稳定解，重点关注过渡层与边界正交相交的渐近几何情形。在过渡区域增强第二基本形式先验有界的设定下，作者在环境维数不超过 10 的流形上，建立了节点超曲面直到边界的一致二阶 Hölder 估计以及平均曲率的定量衰减估计，揭示了边界几何诱导的非零水平集平均曲率非一致衰减的新现象。
techniques: 拓展 Wang-Wei 经典二阶估计方法，引入由环境流形边界外微分几何诱导的边界渐近校正项。
建立过渡层法向切片与边界积分投影的精细正交分解，精确分析节点集与非零水平集上平均曲率主阶贡献的抵消机制。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次将 Allen-Cahn 稳定解过渡层的二阶几何正则性估计严格推进至带边流形的边界区域，克服了边界曲率与相变层非线性相互作用造成的奇异干扰，阐明了非零水平集平均曲率在边界处不退化而在节点集上精确衰减的边界特有几何效应。
analyses.limitations: 几何估计严格依赖于过渡层垂直于流形边界的几何假设，对于斜交截面过渡层或多重界面碰撞退化情形尚未解决；同时环境空间维数受限于不超过 10 维，高维奇异极限下的极小锥行为仍属开放课题。

analyses.title: Simultaneous recovery of various time-dependent coefficients in a hyperbolic equation with space-time nonlocal attenuation
analyses.abstract: This article is devoted to the inverse problem of uniquely determining different classes of coefficients in a hyperbolic equation with space-time nonlocal attenuation from a local source-to-solution map. Our objective is to exploit the nonlocal attenuation mechanism to address inverse coefficient problems that remain open, or are even fundamentally intractable, for linear and nonlinear hyperbolic equations without attenuation. More precisely, by leveraging the interactions induced by nonlocal attenuation, we simultaneously determine general classes of leading and lower order coefficients depending on both space and time. In addition, we formulate our results using data collected on disjoint sets, thereby extending the existing theory and introducing the notion of data on sets disjoint in both space and time for hyperbolic equations. Our approach builds on key features of nonlocal operators, such as memory effects and the unique continuation principle, while integrating the interplay between local and nonlocal operators along with structural properties of hyperbolic equations.
analyses.progressType: 带时空非局域衰减双曲方程多重变系数在时空不交集上的同时重构
analyses.workSummary: 针对带有内禀时空非局域衰减机制的双曲型偏微分方程，作者系统研究了基于局域源到解映射反演多重时空依赖变系数的反问题。作者深刻利用了非局域衰减引发的波场记忆效应与微局部相互作用，突破了无衰减或经典局域双曲方程中反演时空变系数的不可解性壁垒，首次实现了对方程中主阶系数与低阶变系数的同时唯一确定；此外，文章创新性地将测量数据观测域拓展至在空间与时间上均相互不交的离散分离集合上，大幅拓宽了双曲反问题的实际观测边界。
techniques: 利用非局域衰减积分核引入的长时间记忆效应与唯一延拓性质，建立时空多重系数的微局部代数分离解耦机制。
设计适应于空间和时间双重不交集合的波场探测与数据反演方案，克服经典 Carleman 估计对时空重叠观测域的严格依赖。
analyses.breakthrough: 开创性地利用非局域物理耗散机制逆向解决了经典局域双曲方程中长期被视为在数学上不可行的时空变系数同时反演难题。阐明了时空非局域算子所赋予的刚性与长程时空纠缠，首次确立了在时空完全不交的测度分离集上重构全阶系数的数学唯一性定理，为反问题与非局域介质波动反演提供了全新理论支柱。
analyses.limitations: 反演理论严重依赖非局域衰减核的具体解析与积分代数形式，对非线性衰减规律或具有未知核函数的完全黑盒介质的反演稳定性尚未解决；此外，所得结果属于连续意义下的唯一性判据，数值离散反演的病态条件数与噪声容忍度仍需进一步评估。

analyses.title: An entropy-level method for quantitative time-asymptotic in the Fokker-Planck model for fermions -- appearance of non saturation
analyses.abstract: In this contribution we consider the Fokker-Planck equation for fermions, commonly known as the Fermi-Dirac-Fokker-Planck equation. This equation is a correction of the classical Fokker-Planck model that incorporates the Pauli exclusion principle. We present a novel approach that combines three ingredients: (1) stability of solutions, (2) quantitative convergence for a dense set of initial data via a robust entropy method, and (3) a De Giorgi level-set iteration, to establish quantitative time-asymptotic thermalisation for general initial data. In particular, we prove quantitative convergence for arbitrarily cold initial data.
analyses.progressType: 费米子Fokker-Planck模型定量时间渐近热化及De Giorgi水平集分析
analyses.workSummary: 针对融入 Pauli 不相容原理修正的费米子 Fokker-Planck 方程（即 Fermi-Dirac-Fokker-Planck 模型），作者提出了一种刻画解在时间无穷远定量渐近热化的新型混合分析方法。该方法创造性地融合了三项核心理论构件：解的稳定泛函估计、稠密初值子集上基于鲁棒熵方法的定量收敛率、以及针对退化饱和现象的 De Giorgi 水平集迭代技术。作者成功证明了一般初值乃至任意极低温（cold initial data）初始态下的定量热化收敛，精确揭示了相空间非饱和特性的动态演变。
techniques: 构造适应于 Fermi-Dirac 统计约束的相对熵泛函，建立退化扩散结构下的对数 Sobolev 型熵耗散先验不等式。
引入 De Giorgi 水平集迭代截断方法，控制极低温初值在相空间局域饱和区域的非线性退化，防止导数爆破以实现全局一致收敛闭合。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往费米气体动理学模型热化收敛分析中要求初值远离绝对零度或具有先验非饱和界限的严苛假设。首次将变分分析中的 De Giorgi 水平集技术与非线性熵方法深度融合，成功攻克了任意极低温甚至临界冷初值向 Fermi-Dirac 平衡态收敛的定量速率难题，完整确立了量子统计修正下动理学方程的长时间热力学稳定性。
analyses.limitations: 目前研究集中于无外加非均匀复杂约束势场的经典 Fokker-Planck 漂移扩散算子，对于带自洽电场或非平衡外磁场的 Vlasov-Poisson-Fokker-Planck 费米系统中的相变动力学尚未涵盖；此外，在超冷量子退化极限下收敛常数对物理微观参数的尖锐依赖关系仍有待深入解析。

analyses.title: Timelike surfaces of constant mean and constant Gaussian curvature in anti-de Sitter 3-space via loop groups
analyses.abstract: The loop group description of surfaces whose Gauss map is Lorentz harmonic is known for timelike surfaces of constant mean curvature in the flat Lorentzian 3-space, and for surfaces of constant Gaussian curvature in the 3-sphere. We carry out the corresponding construction for timelike surfaces in anti-de Sitter 3-space $\mathbb{H}^3_1\cong SL(2,\mathbb{R})$: those of constant mean curvature, whose Gauss map is harmonic for the conformal structure of the first fundamental form, and those of constant Gaussian curvature $K>-1$, $K\neq0$, whose Gauss map is then an immersion and is harmonic for the second fundamental form. For both classes we prove the harmonicity characterization, recover the surfaces from extended frames by Sym-Bobenko-type formulas, and solve the geometric Cauchy problem by the generalized DPW method, with potentials written explicitly in terms of the data and no normalization of the Gauss map. We then show that the two constructions differ only by a normalization: after the substitution $λ=ζ^2$ and a constant gauge, a constant mean curvature extended frame $\hat F$ is an extended frame of its Gauss map, and the maps $\hat F|_{λ=e^{4θ}}\exp(θe_3)\hat F|_{λ=1}^{-1}$ and $e_3\hat F|_{λ=e^{4θ}}e_3\exp(θe_3)\hat F|_{λ=1}^{-1}$, with $e_3=\mathrm{diag}(-1,1)$, are timelike surfaces of constant Gaussian curvature $1/\sinh^2θ$ and $-1/\cosh^2θ$ wherever the constant mean curvature surface is not flat. The first is the classical parallel surface, the second its polar surface. Explicit families, with extended frames and surfaces in closed form, illustrate the constructions.
analyses.progressType: 反de Sitter三维空间中类时常曲率曲面的循环群表述与Cauchy问题求解
analyses.workSummary: 在反 de Sitter 三维空间 $\mathbb{H}^3_1 \cong SL(2, \mathbb{R})$ 中，深入研究两类基本类时曲面：第一基本形式共形结构下 Gauss 映射为调和映射的常平均曲率（CMC）类时曲面，以及第二基本形式共形结构下 Gauss 映射为浸入调和映射的常 Gauss 曲率曲面（$K > -1, K \ne 0$）。分别证明了 Gauss 映射调和性充要条件，利用 Sym--Bobenko 型公式由拓展标架恢复曲面几何，并运用广义 DPW 循环群方法完全求解了几何 Cauchy 发展问题，通过显式规范变换刻画了平行曲面与极性曲面的经典对应。
techniques: 发展基于李群 $SL(2, \mathbb{R})$ 循环群环的微分子流形扩展标架与 Lax 对可积系统表示。
运用广义 DPW（Dorfmeister--Pedit--Wu）方法直接从初始几何 Cauchy 数据构造全纯势函数。
推导类时反 de Sitter 空间中 Sym--Bobenko 积分表示公式建立扩展标架与浸入曲面的代数闭式解。
analyses.breakthrough: 完全实现了反 de Sitter 三维洛伦兹空间中常平均曲率与常高斯曲率类时曲面的现代循环群表述，无需对 Gauss 映射预先正规化即可由广义 DPW 势函数完全显式解出几何 Cauchy 初值问题，并将两类曲面统一于单一扩展标架规范变换之下。
analyses.limitations: 理论目前局限于三维反 de Sitter 对称空间，对于更高维伪黎曼对称空间或带有退化类光测地线奇点的类时极大超曲面，循环群因式分解与解析延拓尚未形成通用算法。

analyses.title: A minimizing cone from Cartan polynomials in the Alt-Caffarelli problem
analyses.abstract: In this paper we study a class of 1-homogeneous solutions of the one-phase problem coming from the Cartan isoparametric cubic polynomials, which exist only in dimensions $d=5,8,14,26$. Our main result shows that they are unstable in dimensions $d=5,8,14$, and minimizing in dimension $d=26$. This provides the first example of a singular minimizing cone in the Alt-Caffarelli problem that is neither axially symmetric nor of Lawson-type.
analyses.progressType: 基于Cartan等参三次多项式的单相奇异极小锥分类
analyses.workSummary: 研究 Alt--Caffarelli 单相自由边界问题中源于 Cartan 等参三次多项式的 $1$-齐次解类。这类特殊多项式仅在维数 $d=5, 8, 14, 26$ 下存在。作者通过严格分析变分第二变分与全局能量极小性，证明该族齐次解在维数 $d=5, 8, 14$ 时均是不稳定的，而在维数 $d=26$ 时是能量极小的。这为 Alt--Caffarelli 单相问题提供了首个既非轴对称又非 Lawson 型的奇异极小锥实例。
techniques: 利用 Lie 群对称性与 Cartan 等参三次多项式的代数几何不变量，显式构造 $1$-齐次单相变分临界点。
结合第二变分谱分析与球面校准场技术，严格证明其在维数 $d=26$ 下全局 Alt--Caffarelli 能量泛函的极小性。

analyses.limitations: 目前极小性结论依赖于 Cartan 等参三次多项式极高度的代数对称性，对非等参高阶三次超曲面或更一般的等参四次多项式诱导的奇异锥几何稳定性与极小性尚未建立一般性判据。

analyses.title: Pointwise energy monotonicity for stable Higgs bundles
analyses.abstract: We study a conjecture of Qiongling Li concerning the pointwise monotonicity of the energy density along the $\mathbb C^*$-flow of stable $\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb C)$ Higgs bundles. We prove that the conjecture holds in rank two: for every stable $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb C)$ Higgs bundle, the energy density is pointwise nondecreasing along the $\mathbb C^*$-orbit. In contrast, we show that this phenomenon is genuinely rank-dependent. For every rank $n\geq 3$, we construct stable $\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb C)$ Higgs bundles for which the energy density fails to be monotone along the $\mathbb C^*$-flow.
analyses.progressType: 稳定 Higgs 丛能量密度单调性猜想的秩依赖性与反例构造
analyses.workSummary: 针对紧 Riemann 面上稳定 $\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{C})$ Higgs 丛在 $\mathbb{C}^*$-作用流下的能量演化行为，研究了李琼玲关于能量密度逐点单调性的几何猜想。作者证明了该猜想在秩为 $2$ 时严格成立，即对任意稳定 $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{C})$ Higgs 丛，其调和度量诱导的能量密度沿 $\mathbb{C}^*$-轨道逐点非降；同时揭示了该现象具有本质的秩依赖性，对任意秩 $n \ge 3$ 构造出了破坏单调性的反例。
techniques: 利用 Hitchin 方程极大值原理与调和度量形变分析，确立二阶 Higgs 丛能量密度的逐点增性。
构造高阶半单李代数 Hitchin 截面的退化谱曲线族，设计破坏能量密度单调性的高秩反例。
analyses.breakthrough: 完整解决了李琼玲关于 Higgs 丛能量密度逐点单调性的猜想，确立了秩为 $2$ 时的单调性定理，并首次对所有 $n \ge 3$ 构造出反例，阐明了该现象本质依赖于丛的代数秩。
analyses.limitations: 反例构造主要依赖于高秩情况下的局部几何形变与谱分解，对于任意非单调轨道能量密度的具体极小值点集分布及一般约化复李代数李代数丛的分类仍未完全解决。

analyses.title: Isoperimetric clusters with a liquid phase
analyses.abstract: A wet foam is a cluster of air chambers whose interfaces are coated by a single liquid chamber of prescribed volume. In the corresponding isoperimetric problem the liquid chamber may collapse onto films of zero thickness, so that minimizers need not exist. We identify the relaxed energy accounting for such collapsed films and prove that limits of minimizing sequences are its minimizers. The resulting compactness and energy representation theorems lead to the regularity of these generalized minimizers, including an equilibrium law for the pressures across collapsed films. Finally, as the liquid volume vanishes, the minimal energies converge to those of the classical dry foam.
analyses.progressType: 含液体相湿泡沫等周团簇松弛能量与塌陷薄膜广义极小元正则性
analyses.workSummary: 针对由单相指定体积液体包裹多个气室界面的湿泡沫（wet foam）变分等周问题展开系统研究。由于液体相在极小化过程中可能塌陷形成厚度为零的极限薄膜，导致经典极小元并不必然存在。作者明确识别了能够容纳此类塌陷几何界面的松弛能量泛函，严格证明了极小化序列的极限正是该松弛泛函的极小元。进而建立紧致性定理与能量积分表示，由此推导出广义极小元的正则性理论及跨塌陷薄膜的压力平衡定律，并严格证明当液体体积趋于零时，最小能量收敛至经典干泡沫等周能量。
techniques: 构造容纳零厚度塌陷几何薄膜的松弛测度泛函，建立变分极小化序列的弱紧致性。
运用几何测度论中带体积约束的变分外变分技术，推导多相界面处的平衡 Euler--Lagrange 压力平衡关系。
建立液体体积趋于零时的能量 $\Gamma$-收敛分析，严格衔接湿泡沫与经典 Plateau 干泡沫模型。
analyses.breakthrough: 完整解决了湿泡沫等周几何问题中因液膜局部塌陷导致变分极小元缺失的经典理论难题，建立了一套严格自洽的松弛能表示、广义极小元正则性以及向经典干泡沫退化的渐近收敛理论。
analyses.limitations: 目前广义极小元的内部高阶正则性结论尚依赖于气室界面拓扑结构的有界性，对可能产生的高阶分支奇点集维度和奇点邻域微观切锥分类尚未给出完整刻画。

analyses.title: Optimal mixing and enhanced dissipation for a smooth velocity field in any spatial dimension
analyses.abstract: In this note, we consider the advection-diffusion equation on the $d$-dimensional torus, where $d$ is arbitrary. First, for the associated transport equation, we provide an explicit example of a space-time smooth, divergence-free, random velocity field that is a universal exponential mixer. Second, we set the molecular diffusivity to a (small) positive value, and we show that the same velocity field is dissipation enhancing with optimal rate. Our construction is based on the Random Dynamical Systems viewpoint, and relies on the uniform ergodicity of the two-point Markov process associated with the two-dimensional Pierrehumbert model.
analyses.progressType: 任意维环面上光滑随机速度场的最优混合与增强耗散机制
analyses.workSummary: 针对任意 $d$ 维环面 $\mathbb{T}^d$ 上的对流-扩散方程开展深入研究。作者首先在对应的纯输运方程框架下，构造了一个时空光滑、无散度的随机速度场显式范例，证明其具有普遍指数混合（universal exponential mixer）性质。随后将分子扩散率设为微小的正参数 $\kappa > 0$，严格证明了该光滑速度场能够诱导达到理论最优速率的增强耗散（enhanced dissipation）。构造立足于随机动力系统观点，核心依赖于与二维 Pierrehumbert 模型相关联的双点马尔可夫过程的一致遍历性证明。
techniques: 基于随机动力系统理论，构建基于 Pierrehumbert 模型时空平滑交替剪切流的随机扩散框架。
分析两点马尔可夫链的转移核，证明其在对角线外区域的一致遍历性与指数收缩性。
运用准范数估计与随机半群谱隙技术，将对流混合时间尺度与微小分子扩散的耗散增强尺度严格耦合。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往最优指数混合与增强耗散显式构造大多局限于低维空间或粗糙不连续（甚至仅分片常数）速度场的局限，首次在任意空间维度中给出了完全时空光滑的无散流场显式解析构造并证明了其达到理论极限的最优耗散速率。
analyses.limitations: 流场构造具有时空离散随机切换特征，对于确定性定常完全光滑自治流场在多维情形下是否能达到相同的最优指数耗散增强仍是悬而未决的公开问题。

analyses.title: Fitness is asymptotically irrelevant under uniform competition in phenotype-structured populations
analyses.abstract: We prove that, in phenotype-structured populations under uniform competition, the long-term phenotypic distribution does not depend on the proliferation rates: it is the stationary distribution of the switching dynamics alone. The density u(x,t) of cells with phenotype x evolves by advection and diffusion in phenotype space (switching) and by proliferation at a phenotype-dependent rate r(x,t), modulated by a factor g(U) common to all phenotypes, where U is the total population. This extends to continuous phenotypes a recent result for compartmental models. On a bounded interval with no-flux boundary conditions, the total population converges monotonically to the carrying capacity U*, the density converges in L1 to U*psi, where psi is the stationary density of the switching dynamics, and the nonlinear model is asymptotically equivalent to the linear one; by an explicit estimate, the imprint of fitness decays at the spectral gap of the switching dynamics. On the whole real line we prove the same convergence under two natural conditions, confinement and no escape to infinity, covering Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics, multi-well landscapes, and heavy-tailed densities. If g'(U*) < 0 and psi satisfies a Poincare inequality, convergence is exponential in a weighted L2 norm, while no uniform L1 rate holds for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics. The proof follows the compartmental one: under uniform competition the reaction term has one sign, so its size is the growth rate of the total population, integrable in time, and the switching dynamics contracts the zero-mass perturbations it produces. Since it uses only the Markov semigroup generated by switching, the proof extends to general mechanisms; we apply it to nonlocal switching by jumps and to diffusions with non-gradient drift in bounded domains of R^d, whose stationary density is not of Boltzmann form and carries a circulating flux.
analyses.progressType: 表型结构种群均匀竞争下适应度渐近无关性与马尔可夫半群压缩
analyses.workSummary: 在连续表型结构种群模型中，探讨种群密度演化受表型空间平流扩散（表型转换）与依赖于表型的增殖率共同驱动且受均匀竞争调控时的长期渐近行为。作者严格证明了在均匀竞争假定下，长期的表型分布完全独立于个体的繁殖适应度函数，而是完全由表型转换动力学本身的平稳分布唯一决定。该结论将近期关于离散区室模型的成果成功推广至具有无穷维状态空间的连续表型偏微分方程。在有界区间上建立了总种群向环境容纳量的单调收敛及密度向极限测度的 $L^1$ 收敛，在实轴全空间上确立了带势阱与重尾测度下的指数遍历衰减估计。
techniques: 利用均匀竞争下反应项符号恒定的特性，将非线性相互作用控制转化为总种群时间积分的有界耗散。
引入纯表型转换扩散算子所生成的马尔可夫半群，证明其在零质量扰动子空间上的严格收缩性。
运用加权带权 Poincaré 不等式，建立向非 Boltzmann 循环流平稳分布的强加权 $L^2$ 指数收敛速率。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在连续表型反应扩散对流方程中严格证明了生物学中的适应度渐近无关性原理，揭示了只要竞争均匀作用于所有表型，种群最终的表型图景将完全由表型漂移扩散机制支配，给出了完全基于半群压缩特征的严格解析证明。
analyses.limitations: 理论高度依赖于竞争项以乘性因子 $g(U)$ 均匀作用于所有表型的对称假设，对于表型间存在非局部资源竞争核或不对称捕食相互作用的演化系统，适应度对长期平衡的决定性作用将重新恢复。

analyses.title: Synchronized Solutions for Liouville Systems with Sign-Changing Coefficients
analyses.abstract: We consider singular Liouville systems on closed Riemann surfaces with a common sign-changing coefficient. Direct continuation from a positive coefficient is obstructed by the unavoidable appearance of degenerate zeroes along such a homotopy. We instead identify an intrinsic ray in the parameter space on which the system admits synchronized solutions and reduces exactly to a scalar sign-changing mean-field equation. Combining this reduction with the variational existence theory of De Marchis--López-Soriano--Ruiz and the nodal singularity compactness theorem of Wu, we obtain existence for every noncritical parameter on this ray. Positive singular sources are allowed on the nodal curve. In particular, when the surface has nonpositive Euler characteristic and every negative component of the coefficient is a disk, the topological hypothesis required by the scalar min--max construction is automatic.
analyses.progressType: 带变号系数奇异Liouville系统同步解的存在性与变分约化
analyses.workSummary: 针对闭黎曼曲面上具有公共变号系数的奇异 Liouville 偏微分方程组，作者克服了沿同伦路径不可避免出现退化零点而导致的延拓障碍。通过在参数空间中识别出一条本征射线，系统在该射线上存在同步解并完全约化为标量变号平均场方程。结合变分极大极小理论与节点奇异性紧性定理，在射线上所有非临界参数处确立了解的存在性，并允许节点曲线上存在正奇异源。
techniques: 在参数空间中构造一维本征同步射线，将多组分非线性全耦合奇异系统严格等价约化为单分量标量变号 Liouville 方程。
结合 De Marchis-López-Soriano-Ruiz 变分极大极小构造与 Wu 的节点奇点紧性分析，克服变号系数导致的拓扑退化障碍。
analyses.breakthrough: 解决了长期阻碍变号系数 Liouville 系统变分研究的退化零点拓扑障碍，通过发现本征同步射线实现了高维耦合系统向标量平均场方程的精准降维，并在非正欧拉示性数曲面上给出了自动满足的拓扑充要判据。
analyses.limitations: 解的存在性目前严格受限于参数空间内的一维本征同步射线，对于偏离该射线的一般非对称全参数区域中的非同步解分支结构与多解重数性质仍有待深入探索。

analyses.title: An improved high-low method for the parabola
analyses.abstract: We demonstrate a modification of the high-low method of Guth-Maldague-Wang that yields a decoupling theorem which gives the sharp estimate for the discrete restriction constant for the parabola and also a diameter-free bound for the three-fold additive energy of rational points on the parabola and circle. These results were recently obtained by Deng-Fan-Guo-Guo-Luo and Cushman-Demeter-Wu, respectively. The novel features in this argument are an orthogonal expansion of $F^3$ and a new square function that also keeps the wavepackets discarded after pruning, resulting in new and more efficient high and low lemmas.
analyses.progressType: 抛物线离散限制常数与三阶可加能量高低频方法改进
analyses.workSummary: 论文改进了Guth--Maldague--Wang的高低频方法（high-low method），证明了抛物线离散限制常数尖锐估计的新解耦定理，并推导出抛物线与圆周上有理点三阶加性能量的无直径相关界。作者的核心创新在于引入了三次函数$F^3$的正交展开，以及一种保留剪枝后波包的新型平方函数，从而建立了更加高效的高频与低频引理。
techniques: 构造函数立方项$F^3$的正交谱展开，消减多波包重叠交叉项之间的相干干涉。
设计回收剪枝后废弃波包的新型平方函数算子，建立更紧致的双重尺度局域化控制。
analyses.breakthrough: 通过改进的高低频解耦技术给出了抛物线离散限制定理与三阶加性能量界更简洁纯粹的调和分析新证明，克服了此前依赖极其繁复归纳机制的技术瓶颈。
analyses.limitations: 该技巧目前紧密依托于抛物线与圆周等低维二次流形的显式代数对称性，向具有零曲率方向或高维超曲面解耦猜想的推广仍面临多尺度几何阻碍。

analyses.title: Codimension-four regularity of noncollapsed Ricci limit spaces under an integral volume-deficit bound
analyses.abstract: Let $(X,d,p)$ be an $n$-dimensional noncollapsed Ricci limit space, where $n\ge4$. Under an integral volume-deficit bound, we prove that the metric singular set has Hausdorff codimension at least four and sigma-finite $(n-4)$-dimensional Hausdorff measure. This establishes a special case of the codimension-four regularity conjecture. Moreover, the nonmanifold locus is closed and has locally finite $(n-4)$-dimensional Hausdorff measure, and its intersection with each bounded ball satisfies a tubular-volume estimate of order $r^4$. In dimension four, the nonmanifold points form a locally finite set. A flat quotient example shows that the codimension bound is sharp.
analyses.progressType: 非塌缩Ricci极限空间余维4正则性猜想与奇异集测度估计
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究满足积分体积亏格界限的高维非塌缩 Ricci 极限空间 $(X,d,p)$（其中 $n \ge 4$）的奇异结构。作者证明了其度量奇异集的 Hausdorff 余维数至少为四，且具有 $\sigma$-有限的 $(n-4)$ 维 Hausdorff 测度，从而严格确立了著名的余维四正则性猜想在积分体积亏格条件下的特殊情形。此外，文章还证明了非流形点集为闭集且局部具有有限的 $(n-4)$ 维 Hausdorff 测度，并给出了阶数为 $r^4$ 的精细管状体积估计；在四维情形下，非流形点进一步退化为局部有限点集。作者通过平坦商空间显式构造验证了余维数下界的尖锐性。
techniques: 在 Cheeger--Colding 极限空间理论下引入积分体积亏格控制条件，精细控制切锥的近欧氏刚性退化。
建立非流形点集的闭性证明与局域有限 $(n-4)$ 维 Hausdorff 测度估计，并导出 $r^4$ 阶管状体积上界。
通过平坦轨形商空间构造反例，验证奇异集余维数等于四的最优性与尖锐性。
analyses.breakthrough: 在积分体积亏格控制下证明了非塌缩 Ricci 极限空间奇异集的余维四正则性，给出了非流形闭轨迹的 $(n-4)$ 维测度有限性与四维局部有限性，推进了 Cheeger--Colding 经典猜想。
analyses.limitations: 正则性结论依赖于较强的积分体积亏格先验界限，尚未推广到仅有经典两端 Ricci 曲率有界或一般紧致非塌缩极限空间情形；对于孤立锥奇异点的更高阶渐近展开仍有待进一步刻画。

analyses.title: Long-time continuum limits for twisted Schrödinger lattices
analyses.abstract: We prove polynomial-in-time Sobolev bounds on the approximation error between the twisted discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation and its magnetic continuum limit. The analysis exploits complete integrability of the continuum flow through its Birkhoff representation to control approximation by a non-integrable Hamiltonian finite-difference lattice. We establish a focusing-defocusing dichotomy in uniform polynomial control: the bounds hold for arbitrary defocusing data and focusing data of sufficiently small mass, while modulational instability and aliasing yield an obstruction for large focusing data. The accompanying algebraic spatial rates are generically optimal in the Baire-category sense. The proof combines Birkhoff coordinates with modified energies for discrete Sobolev growth, while Fourier filtering recovers uniform spacetime estimates below the energy space despite degenerate lattice dispersion.
analyses.progressType: 扭曲离散NLS多项式时间磁连续统极限与聚焦离焦二分律
analyses.workSummary: 研究扭曲离散非线性 Schrödinger（NLS）方程与其磁连续统极限流之间的长时逼近误差，证明了关于时间多项式增长的 Sobolev 误差估计。利用连续统流在 Birkhoff 变量表示下的完全可积性，克服非可积有限差分哈密顿网格的离散色散退化难题。确立了聚焦-去焦二分律：对于任意去焦初值及充分小质量聚焦初值建立了一致多项式误差界，而对大质量聚焦初值揭示了调制不稳定性与混叠现象构成的本质动力学阻碍。
techniques: 利用一维连续统非线性 Schrödinger 系统的 Birkhoff 作用量-角度坐标精细控制离散网格流的高阶轨道正则性。
构造针对离散网格修正能量泛函与代数空间收敛率估计，在 Baire 纲意义下确立最优空间逼近阶数。
引入离散高频 Fourier 滤波方法，在格点色散关系低阶退化情形下恢复低于能量空间的空时一致色散估计。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了经典非可积网格有效近似仅在对数或短时间成立的传统界限，开创性地借助连续谱 Birkhoff 坐标系控制非可积离散晶格，建立多项式长时近似误差并严格确立了聚焦-去焦二分性判据与最优代数收敛率。
analyses.limitations: 连续统完全可积性深度依赖于一维物理几何与三次克尔非线性结构，对于高维扭曲双层晶格或非三次指数饱和非线性离散系统难以直接推广其 Birkhoff 可积约化机制。
