analyses.title: Local stability of direct Mach configurations
analyses.abstract: We investigate the local stability of direct Mach configurations for the two-dimensional steady compressible Euler equations. Given a piecewise constant Mach configuration that consists of an incident shock, a reflected shock, a Mach stem and a slip line, with subsonic downstream states, we prove the following: under a transversality condition on the shock polar loops and a suitable condition on the truncation segment, every sufficiently small perturbation of the incoming flow gives rise to a Mach configuration that is a small perturbation of the background one, in the sense that the reflected shock, the Mach stem and the slip line, together with the downstream subsonic flow, stay close to their background counterparts; moreover, the solution is unique in the class of solutions satisfying the a priori estimate (for incoming flows that are small in a slightly stronger norm). Lagrangian coordinates are employed to transform the unknown contact discontinuity curve into a fixed boundary and to reduce the full Euler system to a first-order elliptic system for the flow direction and the pressure. The key idea in dealing with the contact discontinuity is to solve a mixed boundary value problem, in divergence form with discontinuous coefficients, for a single elliptic equation, so that the contact discontinuity conditions are naturally preserved as compatibility conditions for the solutions of the elliptic problem.
analyses.progressType: 二维可压缩Euler方程直接马赫构型局部稳定性严格证明
analyses.workSummary: 针对二维稳态不可压缩与可压缩气体动力学 Euler 方程，研究直接马赫反射构型在小来流扰动下的局域结构稳定性。考虑由入射激波、反射激波、马赫杆与滑动线组成且下游为亚声速流的分片常态背景构型。作者在激波极曲线横截相交及截断段相容条件下，证明任意充分小的来流扰动均产生唯一定态强解。利用 Lagrangian 坐标将自由滑动线固定为固定边界，并建立带间断系数的一阶散度型退化椭圆混合边值系统，保证了接触间断相容条件的内在保持。
techniques: 引入流线 Lagrangian 坐标变换，将未知移动接触间断几何位置映射为固定平直边界。
构建含间断系数的一阶散度型椭圆方程组混合边值问题，实现压力与流动方向在亚声速下游流场中的解耦与先验控制。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在二维稳态可压缩 Euler 系统中严格证明了包含激波、马赫杆与接触间断交汇的三激波点马赫构型之局部非线性稳定性与先验估计唯一性，攻克了长期困扰超声速空气动力学的奇异多波干涉数学证明难题。
analyses.limitations: 稳定性理论严格限制在来流小扰动与下游完全亚声速流状态下，对跨声速过渡边界层、大扰动诱发的非正则复杂马赫反射或不稳定滑动线 Kelvin--Helmholtz 卷吸失稳动力学尚未涵盖。

analyses.title: Biharmonic Lagrangian $H$-umbilical submanifolds in complex space forms
analyses.abstract: We give a complete classification of proper biharmonic Lagrangian $H$-umbilical submanifolds in complex space forms. Such submanifolds exist only in complex projective space and are locally congruent to an explicit model obtained via the Hopf fibration. In particular, their nonexistence in complex Euclidean space provides a partial affirmative answer to Chen's conjecture.
analyses.progressType: 复空间形式中正则双调和Lagrangian脐子流形完全分类
analyses.workSummary: 针对复空间形式中的正则双调和 Lagrangian $H$-脐子流形展开完全分类研究。证明了此类子流形只能存在于复射影空间 $\mathbb{CP}^n$ 中，且局部全等于通过 Hopf 纤维化构造的显式几何模型。特别地，证实了此类子流形在复欧氏空间 $\mathbb{C}^n$ 中绝不存在，从而为陈省身-陈邦彦著名的双调和子流形猜想（Chen's conjecture）提供了部分肯定回答。
techniques: 建立 Lagrangian $H$-脐子流形第二基本形式的谱代数化正交标架方程。
分析双调和映射非线性 Euler--Lagrange 偏微分方程的超定积分约束。
利用 Hopf 纤维化将复射影空间中的双调和浸入提升为奇数维球面上的测地环流模型。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底完成了复空间形式中所有正则双调和 Lagrangian $H$-脐子流形的局部与全局刚性分类，确立其唯一存在于复射影空间的独特性质，并积极推动了 Chen 关于双调和子流形不存在性猜想的解决。
analyses.limitations: 结论依赖于 Lagrangian 且 $H$-脐这一特殊子流形结构假设，对于一般的双调和伪脐子流形或具有非消失平均曲率高阶导数的子流形分类仍未完全攻克。

analyses.title: Singular analysis of the principal eigenvalue for cooperative elliptic systems with drifts
analyses.abstract: We determine the small-diffusion limit of the principal eigenvalue for a one-dimensional cooperative elliptic system with component-dependent drifts and Neumann boundary conditions. For scalar equations, this limit is determined by local data at the drift equilibria and boundary points. We show that such localization fails for systems: switching between components can make some intervals spectrally relevant. We first prove that the logarithmic transforms of all component eigenfunctions converge to the same function, which solves a scalar Hamilton-Jacobi equation. The associated Aubry set determines the asymptotic behavior of the principal eigenvalue. Under nondegeneracy assumptions, this set decomposes into isolated points, regular intervals, and composite intervals containing common drift zeros. We then identify the effective value of each class through local Ornstein-Uhlenbeck spectra and interval transport problems, and establish that the limit of the principal eigenvalue is the minimum of these class values. A unique minimizing class also determines the common logarithmic eigenfunction profile.
analyses.progressType: 带漂移一维合作椭圆系统主特征值小扩散极限与Aubry集分类
analyses.workSummary: 针对带有分量依赖漂移项和 Neumann 边界条件的一维合作椭圆方程组，研究其主特征值在小扩散极限下的奇异摄动渐近行为。对于标量方程，该极限完全由漂移平衡点与边界处的局部数据决定；作者揭示对于系统而言该局域化性质严重失效：分量之间的相互切换使得某些开区间成为主导谱性质的关键区域。首先证明所有分量特征函数的对数变换一致收敛至同一个满足标量 Hamilton--Jacobi 方程的粘性解，对应的 Aubry 集完全主导了主特征值的渐近行为。在非退化假设下将该 Aubry 集分解为孤立点、正则区间以及包含共同漂移零点的复合区间，通过局部 Ornstein--Uhlenbeck 谱与区间输运问题确定各类的有效特征值，并确立主特征值的极限恰为各类有效值的全局极小值。
techniques: 构造多组分对数特征函数的尺度重整化变换，证明其粘性解向一阶 Hamilton--Jacobi 方程的强一致收敛。
引入动力系统 Aubry 集合的拓扑结构分解，隔离出影响主特征值衰减的区间与奇点类。
结合局部 Ornstein--Uhlenbeck 谱展开与区间受限测度输运极小化，导出各类别的精确有效特征值闭合公式。
analyses.breakthrough: 揭示了一维合作多组分椭圆系统中主特征值小扩散极限区别于标量方程的非局部本质，首次证明了由多组分切换效应引起的非平凡区间谱贡献，并建立了一套基于 Aubry 集合分类与局部算子有效谱的严谨主特征值渐近解析框架。
analyses.limitations: 目前分析局限于一维空间线段，对于多维流形上多组分合作扩散系统，由于其高维漂移向量场的流线拓扑可能极其复杂且 Aubry 集结构更加病态，类似有效分类与极限计算仍面临严峻挑战。

analyses.title: Alternative proof of the gradient estimate for complex Hessian equations
analyses.abstract: For complex Hessian equations on compact Kähler manifolds, we give an alternative proof of the gradient estimate without using blow-up argument, and clarify its dependence on the right-hand side. In addition, using the similar approach, the case of Kähler manifolds with boundary is also investigated.
analyses.progressType: 复Hessian方程无爆破梯度估计的新证明
analyses.workSummary: 针对紧Kähler流形上的复Hessian方程，作者提出了一种无需借助爆破分析（blow-up argument）的梯度估计替代证明方法，明确厘清了解的梯度界对右端项几何与解析依赖关系，并将该套直接构造辅助函数与极值原理结合的方法推广至带边Kähler流形情形。
techniques: 构造直接依赖度量与先验界的新型梯度辅助函数，避免传统依赖反证法和爆破分析的紧性途径。
在边界处精细分析实与复法向导数，将复Hessian算子的凹凸性转化为带边流形上的边界梯度界。
analyses.breakthrough: 摆脱了依赖吹胀分析的定性反证法，给出了复Hessian方程显式的梯度先验控制，揭示了解的梯度对右端几何数据的直接定量控制，并将该直接估计方法成功推广至带边紧Kähler流形。
analyses.limitations: 该证明高度依赖Kähler度量的对称性与复Hessian算子的特殊代数结构，尚无法直接迁移至更为一般的非Kähler（如Hermitian）复流形或更一般的退化全非线性复椭圆方程。

analyses.title: Regularity for vectorial double phase functionals with two modulating coefficients and logarithmic-type growth
analyses.abstract: We study vector-valued local minimizers of double phase functionals with two modulating coefficients and logarithmic-type growth. The energy density is $a(x)|Du|^p+b(x)|Du|^p\log(e+|Du|)$, where the nonnegative coefficients $a(\cdot)$ and $b(\cdot)$ may vanish but their sum is bounded away from zero. Assuming that $a(\cdot)$ is uniformly continuous and that $b(\cdot)$ satisfies a vanishing log-Hölder continuity condition, we prove that minimizers are locally Hölder continuous for every exponent in $(0,1)$. If both coefficients are Hölder continuous, then the gradient of a minimizer is locally Hölder continuous. The proof combines Gehring-type higher integrability with a comparison argument.
analyses.progressType: 具双调制系数与对数增长向量型双相泛函局部极小元正则性
analyses.workSummary: 针对带有两个非负调制系数及对数型摄动增长的向量型双相能量泛函 $\int [a(x)|Du|^p + b(x)|Du|^p \log(e+|Du|)] dx$（其中系数 $a(x)$ 与 $b(x)$ 可退化为零但满足正下界分离条件 $a(x)+b(x) \ge c_0 > 0$），系统研究其向量值局部极小元的内部正则性。在 $a(\cdot)$ 一致连续且 $b(\cdot)$ 满足消失 log-Hölder 连续性条件下，作者证明了局部极小元在开区间 $(0,1)$ 内对任意指数均局部 Hölder 连续；进一步若两系数均满足局部 Hölder 连续，则极小元梯度同样具有局部 Hölder 正则性。
techniques: 针对对数增长非标准退化 Orlicz-Sobolev 能量空间建立修正 Gehring 型逆 Hölder 不等式与高阶可积性先验估计。
引入局部冻结系数调和逼近与精细比较原理，结合消失 log-Hölder 模连续性有效吸收双相相变界面引起的震荡余项。
analyses.breakthrough: 将经典双相变分积分极小元正则性理论实质性拓展至带有双重非退化交叠调制系数及临界对数型亚多项式增长的向量值系统。突破了以往仅能处理单项调制或严格多项式非标准增长的分析瓶颈，确立了极小元及其梯度的最优 Hölder 连续性阶数，为非均匀材料反常扩散泛函正则性提供了重要支撑。
analyses.limitations: 目前证明深度依赖于两系数之和处处远离零的拟非退化假定，对于 $a(x)$ 与 $b(x)$ 同时在非空测度集或分形流形上退化为零的完全双相奇点几何尚未涵盖；此外，对于高维区域边界处的有界性与边界 Hölder 连续性仍有待进一步发展。

analyses.title: CAT(0) spaces without linear filling at the asymptotic rank
analyses.abstract: For every integer $ν\geq 2$, we construct a $(ν+1)$-dimensional, locally compact, geodesically complete CAT(0) space of asymptotic rank $ν$ which does not satisfy a linear isoperimetric inequality for integral $ν$-cycles. Its filling function is bounded below by $c v\log v$ for all sufficiently large $v$.
analyses.progressType: 渐近秩处缺乏线性等周填充不等式的奇异几何构造
analyses.workSummary:
针对度量几何中非正曲率空间的等周不等式与渐近几何结构，作者对任意整数 $
u \ge 2$，构造出一个 $(
u+1)$ 维局部紧致且测地完备的 $\operatorname{CAT}(0)$ 空间。该空间的渐近秩严格为 $

u$-循环并不满足线性等周不等式。作者进一步证明了该空间中循环的填充函数对于所有充分大的体积 $v$ 满足非线性下界 $c v \log v$（其中 $c > 0$ 为常数），从而否定了关于渐近秩处等周线性的潜在猜想。
techniques: 运用树状复形胶合与度量锥技术构造具有可控渐近锥维数的高维 $\operatorname{CAT}(0)$ 奇异度量空间。
借助整系数流数理论与极小填充表面体积估计，导出大尺度 $\nu$-循环填充函数的超线性下界。

analyses.title: Scattering for Short-Range Mass-Subcritical Choquard Equations
analyses.abstract: We study scattering for the defocusing inhomogeneous generalized Choquard equation with data in the conformal energy space. In the full short-range mass-subcritical regime, a key estimate for the nonlinear term yields scattering in \(L^2\). A pseudoconformal argument in the compactified variables then gives scattering in \(H^1\). In the homogeneous case, estimates based on the Galilean vector field further imply scattering in \(Σ\) above the Strauss threshold. The method avoids the additional algebraic restrictions arising from intermediate Strichartz-Sobolev estimates.
analyses.progressType: 短程质量亚临界非齐次Choquard方程共形能量空间散射理论
analyses.workSummary: 针对带有初值属于共形能量空间的聚焦/散焦非齐次广义 Choquard 方程，作者在完整的短程质量亚临界非线性指数区域内，系统建立了时间整体散射理论。通过对非局域 Hartree 型卷积非线性项建立关键能量估计，首先证明了解在空间 $L^2$ 范数下的自由散射；随后在紧化时空变量下运用伪共形对称变换，将散射结果提升至高阶能量空间 $H^1$；在齐次情形下进一步借助 Galilei 向量场估计，在 Strauss 阈值之上确立了全加权能量空间 $\Sigma$ 中的散射行为，完全规避了传统 Strichartz-Sobolev 复合内插带来的额外代数限制。
techniques: 针对短程非局域卷积项建立适应于共形测度的积分估计，直接闭合质量亚临界体系下的 $L^2$ 散射极限。
引入紧化变量下的伪共形变换并结合 Galilei 向量场不变量，突破 Strauss 临界谱阈值以确立加权能量空间 $\Sigma$ 的完全散射。
analyses.breakthrough: 完整解决了短程质量亚临界非齐次 Choquard 方程在全范围内的长时间散射猜想。克服了非局域极化势能与空间非齐次奇异权相互纠缠导致的能量估计退化，摒弃了以往繁琐且带有非物理代数限制的 Strichartz-Sobolev 内插技巧，直接通过共形几何与对称向量场导出了最优的散射正则性空间阶数。
analyses.limitations: 散射理论严重依赖于初值在空间无穷远处的共形加权紧性衰减假设，对于仅具有经典能量初值而不具备加权矩条件的初值演化尚未完全涵盖；此外，对于带非平凡外加吸引势场或长程临界 Coulomb 核相互作用系统的散射修正仍属未决问题。

analyses.title: Logarithmic Bramson correction for Fisher--KPP equations on homogeneous trees
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the Fisher--KPP equation \[ \partial_t u = αΔ_{\TT_{q+1}}u+βu(1-u), \] on the homogeneous \((q+1)\)-regular tree \(\TT_{q+1}\), with \(q\geq2\), for nontrivial, compactly supported radial initial data. We first obtain an explicit representation of the fundamental solution of the corresponding linearized problem, together with sharp two-sided pointwise estimates. These estimates identify the propagation threshold \[ β>α(\sqrt q-1)^2 \] and determine the associated critical speed \(c_\ast\) and decay rate \(λ_\ast\). In this regime, we prove that, for every fixed \(θ\in(0,1)\), the outermost \(θ\)-level set satisfies \[ κ_θ(t) = c_\ast t-\frac{3}{2λ_\ast}\log t+O(1), \qquad t\to\infty. \] Therefore, while the branching geometry affects the threshold for propagation and the values of the critical parameters, the classical Bramson factor \(3/2\) persists. Our results therefore extend classical propagation and logarithmic-delay phenomena, previously known for one-dimensional continuous and discrete Fisher--KPP models, to homogeneous trees.
analyses.progressType: 齐次树上Fisher-KPP反应扩散方程对数Bramson延迟修正与临界波速
analyses.workSummary: 针对正规齐次树 $\mathbb{T}_{q+1}$ ($q \ge 2$) 离散分支几何上的 Fisher-KPP 反应扩散方程 $\partial_t u = \alpha \Delta_{\mathbb{T}_{q+1}} u + \beta u(1-u)$，作者系统研究了紧支集径向初值诱导的前沿波前扩展动力学。通过推导线性化算子基本解的显式积分表达与尖锐双边点态估计，精确给出了反应驱动波传播相变的阈值条件 $\beta > \alpha(\sqrt{q}-1)^2$，并确定了临界速度 $c_*$ 与空间衰减率 $\lambda_*$；进一步严格证明对任意固定水平集 $\theta \in (0,1)$，最外层水平集渐近位置服从 $\kappa_\theta(t) = c_* t - \frac{3}{2\lambda_*} \log t + O(1)$，揭示了经典欧氏连续模型的 Bramson 因子 $3/2$ 在离散非紧树图几何中具有稳健的普适性。
techniques: 通过球调和分析与特征谱积分推导齐次正则树上离散热半群基本解的显式解析表示与精确双边点态渐近界。
结合下解与上解构造技术精细追踪非线性界面前沿演变，建立离散几何上最外层水平集对数延迟修正的定量紧估计。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次将经典的 Bramson 对数延迟渐近理论成功推广至非欧氏空间——无限正则齐次树图几何上。揭示了指数型体积增长与图谱间隙虽然会改变临界传播阈值及特征波速，但源自前沿线性化本征波截断抵消的经典 Bramson 普适前置因子 $3/2$ 保持严格不变，在离散几何与非线性扩散波动理论之间建立了深刻的普适性联系。
analyses.limitations: 分析目前严格受限于具有球对称性的齐次正则树图及径向初值，对于非齐次无标度网络、具有随机分支权重的逾渗树簇或非径向支集初始扰动的前沿波动粗糙化现象尚未给出数学分析；此外，高阶 $O(1)$ 常数项对局部网络拓扑的精细依赖性仍待进一步明晰。

analyses.title: Stable Constant Mean Curvature Hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{H}^n$
analyses.abstract: For every $n\geq 4$ and every $H$ in a neighborhood of $n-1$ (depending on $n$), we prove the existence of a properly embedded strongly stable CMC hypersurface in $\mathbb H^n$ with mean curvature $H$ and infinitely many ends, invariant under the action of a Schottky group. In particular, stable Bernstein-type rigidity fails in this range.
analyses.progressType: 双曲空间强稳定常平均曲率超曲面存在性与Bernstein型刚性失效
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究高维双曲空间 $\mathbb{H}^n$（$n \ge 4$）中常平均曲率（CMC）超曲面的稳定性与刚性问题。作者证明了对任意维数 $n \ge 4$，在平均曲率临界值 $H = n-1$ 的某个开邻域内，均存在真嵌入、强稳定且具有无穷多个端的 CMC 超曲面，并且该超曲面在某个 Schottky 群的作用下保持几何不变。这一构造性定理明确表明，在此平均曲率参数区间内，关于双曲空间中完全稳定 CMC 超曲面的 Bernstein 型刚性猜想彻底失效，揭示了双曲几何中非紧强稳定极小或 CMC 几何客体惊人的拓扑与端丰富性。
techniques: 利用双曲等距变换群中的 Schottky 离散群对称性，构造具有无限个共形理想边界端的周期几何构型。
结合双曲空间无穷远边界的共形几何结构，建立非紧端上 Jacobi 算子谱正性与强稳定性扰动控制。
针对临界平均曲率 $H \approx n-1$ 附近的隐函数泛函映射，构造退化偏微分几何方程的真嵌入光滑解。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在维数 $n \ge 4$ 的双曲空间中构造出带有无穷多个端的强稳定 CMC 嵌入超曲面，决定性地证伪了双曲空间中相应参数范围的稳定 Bernstein 型刚性猜想。
analyses.limitations: 该构造目前依赖于平均曲率 $H$ 限制在临界值 $n-1$ 附近的小邻域内以及高维条件 $n \ge 4$，对于低维情况（如 $n=3$ 双曲三维空间）或远离临界值的 $H$ 区间内稳定 CMC 超曲面的分类与刚性行为仍不清楚。

analyses.title: Uniform null-controllability times for the Coron--Guerrero problems are $2$ and $2 + 2 \sqrt{2}$
analyses.abstract: We study the uniform null-controllability, in the vanishing viscosity limit, of the transport--diffusion equation $u_t + M u_x = \varepsilon u_{xx}$ on $[0,L]$ with a Dirichlet boundary control at $x=0$. Our results concern the uniform null-controllability time $T_{\mathrm{unif}}$, defined as the infimum of the times for which the null-controllability cost remains bounded as $\varepsilon \to 0$. We determine this time exactly for both signs of the transport velocity: $T_{\mathrm{unif}} = 2 L / M$ in the positive-speed case $M>0$, and $T_{\mathrm{unif}} = (2 + 2 \sqrt{2}) L / |M|$ in the negative-speed case $M<0$. The positive-speed result disproves the conjecture $T_{\mathrm{unif}}=L/M$ suggested by Coron and Guerrero. For negative speed, the conjectured threshold had already been disproved by Lissy. Our result determines the exact threshold. We establish the lower bounds by constructing adjoint solutions that violate uniform observability below the respective thresholds. In the positive-speed case, the construction exploits the asymptotic structure of the Blaschke products and model spaces associated with the exponential family generated by the adjoint spectrum. The same model-space structure is used to reduce the upper-bound problems for both signs of $M$ to infinite-time observability inequalities, which are proved through a representation of the boundary-to-interior map and estimates of its Hilbert--Schmidt norm.
analyses.progressType: 输运扩散方程消失黏性极限下统一零能控性时间阈值判定
analyses.workSummary: 针对一维区间 $[0, L]$ 上具 Dirichlet 边界控制的对流--扩散方程 $u_t + M u_x = \varepsilon u_{xx}$，深入研究其在消失黏性极限 $\varepsilon \to 0$ 下的一致零能控性时间 $T_{\mathrm{unif}}$。作者严格证明：当输运速度为正（$M>0$）时，最优能控时间精确为 $T_{\mathrm{unif}} = 2 L / M$，从而彻底否定了由 Coron 和 Guerrero 提出的 $L/M$ 猜想；当输运速度为负（$M<0$）时，最优能控时间精确为 $T_{\mathrm{unif}} = (2 + 2 \sqrt{2}) L / |M|$。通过对偶系统反例构造与模型空间结构分析，完全确定了两种输运流向下的锐利相变阈值。
techniques: 利用对偶谱系生成的指数函数族所伴随的 Blaschke 积渐近结构与复分析模型空间，显式构造破坏一致可观测性的对偶解序列。
通过将上界能控问题约化为无穷时间可观测性不等式，结合边界到内部积分算子的 Hilbert--Schmidt 范数精细估计建立能量控制。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底厘清了一维对流扩散方程黏性趋于零时统一零能控性最小时间常数的精确极限，给出了双向输运流速下完全确定的阈值 $2$ 与 $2+2\sqrt{2}$，并严格纠正了控制理论界著名的 Coron--Guerrero 猜想。
analyses.limitations: 目前分析依赖一维常系数输运项与区间几何的精确谱分解及解析函数模型空间理论，对多维变系数输运场、非线性对流项或弯曲流形上的边界控制系统尚未发展出可移植的渐近控制结构。

analyses.title: Interacting fronts in the strongly nonlocal Allen--Cahn equation
analyses.abstract: We study the sharp-interface limit of the fractional Allen--Cahn equation in $\R^n$, $n\geq 2$, in the strongly nonlocal regime $s\in(0,\frac12)$, for initial data consisting of finitely many nested transition layers. We identify a coupled geometric law for the motion of the resulting fronts: each velocity contains fractional mean curvature and a nonlocal interaction potential generated by the other fronts. These interactions persist while the fronts remain separated, in contrast to the independent motion in the critical regime $s=\frac12$. Assuming that the coupled law admits a smooth evolution with strictly nested sets on a given time interval, we prove that the Allen--Cahn solutions converge locally uniformly away from the moving fronts to the corresponding integer-valued phases.
analyses.progressType: 强非局域Allen-Cahn方程多层嵌套界面相互作用动力学极限
analyses.workSummary: 研究 $n$ 维欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^n$（$n \ge 2$）中分数阶 Allen--Cahn 方程在强非局域指标 $s \in (0, 1/2)$ 下的清晰界面渐近极限。考虑由有限个相互嵌套的过渡层构成的初值构型。作者识别出驱动界面演化的全新几何耦合运动律：各界面的法向移动速度不仅由局域的分数阶平均曲率决定，还受到由其它所有嵌套界面共同激发的非局域长程相互作用势能场的支配。在假设该耦合几何流在光滑嵌套集上存在正则演化的条件下，证明了相场解在远离运动界面的区域局部一致收敛至对应的离散整数相态。
techniques: 推导强非局域指标 $s \in (0, 1/2)$ 下多层嵌套界面的非局部相互作用能量渐近展开，导出分数阶平均曲率与长程排斥势的耦合几何演化方程。
结合变分模极大值原理与非局部屏障函数技术，证明相场解在分离界面外测度空间中局部一致强收敛至对应常数相。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在强非局域状态 $s < 1/2$ 下完整揭示了多重过渡层之间不可忽略的长程相互作用动力学，打破了临界与局域机制下多层界面独立运动的经典范式，建立了由分数阶曲率与长程耦合势共同驱动的界面流严格渐近收敛性。
analyses.limitations: 收敛性定理必须建立在耦合几何界面流具备光滑演化且各嵌套层保持严格分离的正则性假设之上，对于界面相交、几何奇点产生或拓扑合并之后的弱几何流渐近收敛行为尚无法处理。

analyses.title: Energy convexity and uniformity of the $H$-surface flow in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ with Dirichlet boundary condition
analyses.abstract: We prove that the energy functional associated with surfaces of prescribed mean curvature in $\mathbb{R}^3$ exhibits a convexity property when restricted to maps from the unit $2$-disk having small Dirichlet energy and a fixed boundary value, provided that the $3$-form $H \cdot \text{vol}_{\mathbb{R}^3}$ has a primitive satisfying certain bounds. Under milder assumptions on $H:\mathbb{R}^3 \to \mathbb{R}$, we show that an analogous convexity estimate holds along the heat flow of the functional (the $H$-surface flow) when the initial Dirichlet energy is sufficiently small. This is done first for classical solutions, and then extended by approximation to weak solutions using a quantitative uniqueness result adapted from previous work on the harmonic map heat flow. As a consequence of the convexity estimate, we show that the $H$-surface flow with small-energy initial map of class $C^0 \cap W^{1, 2}$ on the unit $2$-disk converges uniformly to a unique limit at infinite time, which solves the corresponding stationary problem (the $H$-surface system) with the same boundary value.
analyses.progressType: 三维空间H曲面热流能量凸性与长时间唯一全局一致收敛
analyses.workSummary: 研究三维欧氏空间 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中指定平均曲率曲面变分问题及其伴随的 $H$-曲面热流在 Dirichlet 边界条件下的动力学演化。作者证明当考虑单位圆盘上具给定边界且 Dirichlet 能量充分小的映射类时，若 $3$-形式 $H \cdot \mathrm{vol}_{\mathbb{R}^3}$ 存在满足特定有界条件的原形式，则对应的能量泛函展现出严格的凸性结构。作者进一步将该能量凸性估计拓展至弱解类，结合调和映射热流的定量唯一性分析，证明对于小能量初始数据，该流动在无限时间全局一致收敛至对应的稳态 $H$-曲面方程唯一极小解。
techniques: 利用微分形式的原形式积分先验控制，确立小能量等参映射下非线性加权体积能量泛函的严格变分凸性。
结合调和映射热流的微局部逼近与定量唯一性连续延拓定理，将经典流动的能量泛函凸性衰减提升至弱解类空间。
analyses.breakthrough: 克服了 $H$-曲面非线性体积积分配分项造成的能量非凸性本质瓶颈，首次在几何流水平建立了 $H$-曲面热流在小能量初值下的全局能量凸性与时间趋于无穷时的一致单调收敛性与极限唯一性定理。
analyses.limitations: 分析框架严格局限于初值 Dirichlet 能量充分小以及非齐次平均曲率函数 $H$ 的微分形式具备特定界限的原形式的设定，对大能量初值诱发的有限时间奇点产生以及非零亏格曲面上的流动拓扑变化尚未涉及。

analyses.title: Eigenfunction asymptotics and nodal domain estimates for dumbbell domains
analyses.abstract: We study the nodal structure of Neumann eigenfunctions on planar dumbbell domains as the width of the neck joining two fixed end domains tends to zero. Under simplicity and non-degeneracy assumptions, we show that sufficiently thin necks force an increasing number of nodal domains as the limiting eigenvalue grows. At the bottom of the spectrum this forcing can attain Courant's upper bound: in particular, the third Neumann eigenfunction has exactly three nodal domains and is Courant sharp. At the same time, nodal deficiency of an eigenfunction on an end domain can persist on the full dumbbell, giving eigenfunctions that are not Courant sharp. The main analytic difficulty is that the singular limit may vanish on one or both end domains even though these regions contribute nodal domains for every positive neck width. We overcome this by deriving refined asymptotics for the first nonzero profiles on the vanishing regions, expressed through Neumann Green's functions with poles at the neck attachment points and obtained by a two-dimensional matched asymptotic analysis with logarithmic terms.
analyses.progressType: 平面哑铃形区域Neumann特征函数节点域渐近与Courant最优估计
analyses.workSummary: 针对连接两个固定端域的细颈宽度趋于零时平面哑铃形区域上的 Neumann 特征函数节点结构展开深入分析。在单重性与非退化假设下，证明充分细的颈部随着极限特征值的增大迫使产生更多数量的节点域。在谱的底部该效应能够达到 Courant 上界，特别是第三个 Neumann 特征函数恰好拥有三个节点域并达到 Courant 尖锐性。针对极限在端域上局部退化消失的核心难点，作者通过颈部连接点处带对数奇性的 Neumann Green 函数构造精细匹配渐近展开，精确捕获了消失区域上的首阶非零振幅剖面。
techniques: 基于带对数奇异项的二维匹配渐近展开方法，精细求解退化区域上的高阶微局部分析剖面。
引入颈部连接点处的奇异 Neumann Green 函数，建立跨颈部流动的能量输运先验估计。
结合 Courant 节点域定理与端域节点缺陷拓扑持久性分析，严格给出低阶特征函数的节点数精确下界。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在平面哑铃形区域颈部退化极限下严格确立了低阶 Neumann 特征函数达到 Courant 节点上界的充要拓扑机制，克服了端域上振幅衰减导致节点线消失的解析障碍，构造出首个可精确量化的非平凡节点域强迫增长定理。
analyses.limitations: 目前分析局限于二维平面情形且要求特征值满足非退化与单重谱假设，对三维及更高维流形连接颈、高阶重特征值以及具分形边界哑铃区域的节点几何仍有待进一步推广。

analyses.title: Homogenization and Long Time Behavior of Wasserstein gradient flow for McKean-Vlasov Equation
analyses.abstract: We consider a McKean-Vlasov equation incorporating spatial fast oscillatory behavior into both the energetic and kinematic components of the model. The former is given in terms of a confining potential while the latter by an underlying metric. The equation is formulated as a gradient flow in the space of probability measures endowed with a Wasserstein metric. We identify the limiting dynamics which is also described as a gradient flow in an effective media. We further prove the long time exponential convergence of solutions to the invariant measure. The rate of convergence is expressed in terms of a Logarithmic Sobolev constant which is uniform in terms of the oscillatory length scale. Our approach is based on variational and functional inequalities. The homogenization result of the current paper extends the authors' previous work [GaoYip] on a linear Fokker-Planck equation to a nonlinear and nonlocal setting.
analyses.progressType: 具快速振荡势与度量的McKean-Vlasov方程Wasserstein梯度流均匀均质化
analyses.workSummary: 研究能量与运动学分量均包含快速空间振荡的 McKean-Vlasov 方程在概率测度 Wasserstein 空间中的梯度流演化。通过变分不等式与泛函不等式，严格推导了有效介质中的极限梯度流方程，并建立了均质化极限理论。作者证明了解关于不变测度的长时间指数收敛性，其收敛速率由关于快速振荡尺度参数均匀成立的对数 Sobolev 常数刻画，将经典的线性 Fokker--Planck 方程均质化理论实质推广至非线性与非局部动力学框架。
techniques: 基于 Wasserstein 概率测度度量空间的梯度流变分框架，推导非线性非局部相互作用项的微观均质化极限。
构造关于快速振荡空间尺度一致的对数 Sobolev 不等式，获得独立于小参数的能量耗散控制。
运用最优输运理论与泛函不等式方法，建立非局部 Fokker--Planck 型演化系统的长时间指数遍历收敛。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往非局部均质化主要针对线性扩散算子的限制，首次在非线性 McKean-Vlasov 相互作用测度演化中建立了关于空间振荡尺度完全一致的对数 Sobolev 常数先验界，给出了大时间指数渐近衰减的严格变分证明。
analyses.limitations: 对约束势与度量张量的光滑性与严格凸性有较强依赖，对于带退化扩散矩阵、含奇异核相互作用力或处于亚稳态相变区域的非线性均质化问题尚未完全覆盖。

analyses.title: Large time behaviour in the multidimensional nonlocal Fisher-KPP equation
analyses.abstract: This work studies the expansion of the level sets of the solutions of a Fisher-KPP type reaction- diffusion equation, the diffusion being given by a nonnegative, compactly supported, even kernel. Because the latter is not assumed to be spherically symmetric, the level sets advance at an asymptotic speed given by a Freidlin-Gärtner type formula. The main contribution of this paper is to push the expansion up to terms that vanish as time goes to infinity, consisting in an asymptotically logarithmic delay corrected by an function that is constant in time, but depends on the direction of propagation.
analyses.progressType: 多维非局部Fisher-KPP反应扩散方程水平集长时间高阶渐近展开
analyses.workSummary: 研究具有非对称非负紧支扩散核的多维非局部 Fisher-KPP 反应扩散方程解的水平集演化行为。由于扩散核缺乏旋转对称性，其水平集以 Freidlin--Gärtner 型公式确定的各向异性渐近速度向外扩展。作者将以往关于解水平集位置的渐近阶数推导至时间趋于无穷时消失的更高阶余项，精确揭示了渐近对数时间延迟项，并识别出依赖于空间传播方向但与时间无关的各向异性校正函数。
techniques: 构造适应各向异性非局部核特征的非对称上下解序列，精细控制前端波阵面位置。
结合非局部算子的极大值原理与 Freidlin--Gärtner 几何光学拟线性化渐近分析。
通过引入精确的对数时间延迟展开与渐近匹配方法，消除非局部卷积导致的各向异性误差积累。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往非局部反应扩散方程水平集渐近展开仅停留在常数阶或低维各向同性设定的限制，首次在任意非旋转对称紧支核下确立了包含对数延迟与方向依赖修正项的高精度高阶渐近展开公式。
analyses.limitations: 分析严重依赖于扩散核的紧支集假定以及 KPP 型严格单调单稳非线性反应项，对于带重尾扩散核、双稳态非线性或具时空随机平流干扰的反应扩散系统仍面临本质困难。

analyses.title: Spiral Harmonic Products
analyses.abstract: Motivated by the systematic study of spiral minimal products, we consider harmonic maps obtained by coupling two spherical eigenmaps through a profile curve in $\mathbb S^3$, with a doubly warped product metric on the source. The source warps are independent of the profile magnitudes. This gives two complementary problems: reconstructing a compatible source metric from prescribed profile or source data, and finding closed profiles when the source metric is fixed. For arbitrary prescribed warps, homogenization of the reduced Lagrangian gives a strongly convex conic Finsler metric whose oriented graph geodesics are exactly the harmonic profiles. In the unit-speed inverse problem, the phase momenta reduce reconstruction to a scalar magnitude equation. We obtain global reconstructions from a prescribed magnitude, one source warp, or a monotone volume factor, together with periodic families in which profiles closing on finite covers are dense. In the fixed-metric problem, a change of time gives an autonomous Neumann system. One fixed source metric then carries continuous families of closed profiles and infinitely many closed graph geodesics. For fixed even $p,q\geq 2$, every fixed metric in this Neumann class on $\mathbb S^1\times\mathbb S^p\times\mathbb S^q$ supports harmonic maps into $\mathbb S^{p+q+1}$ of degree $4m$ for every $m\geq 1$. In the matched constant-warp case, these maps reduce to explicit eigenmaps.
analyses.progressType: 螺旋调和积映射构造与锥Finsler测地线对偶
analyses.workSummary: 论文系统研究了通过三维球面$\mathbb{S}^3$中的轮廓曲线将两个球面特征映射耦合而成的螺旋调和积映射。作者在双重扭曲积源流形上探讨了重构兼容度量的逆问题以及固定源度量下寻找闭合轮廓曲线的正问题。通过对约化Lagrange量进行齐次化，构造了强凸锥Finsler度量并证明其定向图测地线恰为调和轮廓；在固定度量下将其转化为自治Neumann系统，构造了连续闭合轮廓族与任意高阶度的球面调和映射。
techniques: 将调和映射约化作用量泛函进行一阶齐次化，建立与强凸锥Finsler流形定向图测地线之间的变分对偶。
通过时间变量代换将变分欧拉--拉格朗日动力学约化为经典完全可积的自治Neumann力学哈密顿系统。
analyses.breakthrough: 建立了螺旋几何结构下调和积映射与锥Finsler几何及Neumann可积系统之间的全新对偶对应，为构造高维非平凡同伦类与高拓扑度调和映射开辟了显式的常微分几何动力学路径。
analyses.limitations: 构造严格依赖于目标流形为标准欧氏球面且源流形具备高度对称的双重扭曲积共变结构，对于一般任意弯曲紧黎曼流形之间的非紧对称调和映射，该齐次化降维体系无法直接适用。

analyses.title: Anisotropic quasilinear elliptic systems involving nonlinearities with negative critical terms
analyses.abstract: In this paper we investigate existence and multiplicity of solutions for a critical growth anisotropic quasilinear elliptic system, depending on two real parameters $λ,\,μ$, that is coupled through a subcritical perturbation term and involves a negative critical part. We identify a specific scaling for the system and introduce a parameter $γ$ associated with this scaling, which governs the geometry of the corresponding variational functional. We establish three distinct types of multiplicity results, depending on the regimes $γ= 1$, $γ> 1$, and $γ< 1$. The multiple results of multiplicity of solutions are based on a recent abstract critical point theorem for symmetric functionals on product spaces when $γ\geq1$ and on a truncation argument for $γ<1$.
analyses.progressType: 带负临界项各向异性拟线性椭圆方程组多解性与参数几何分歧
analyses.workSummary: 针对依赖于两个实参数 $\lambda, \mu$ 且具有临界增长的各向异性拟线性椭圆型方程组展开深入探讨。该系统通过次临界摄动项强耦合，且内部包含负的临界非线性项。作者识别出该系统特有的内在空间各向异性缩放几何，并引入与该尺度变换相关联的关键无量纲参数 $\gamma$，该参数严格主导了对应变分能量泛函的纤维丛几何结构。根据 $\gamma = 1$、$\gamma > 1$ 以及 $\gamma < 1$ 三种截然不同的代数几何范式，分别利用乘积空间对称泛函的抽象临界点理论以及非局部截断方法，建立了多重非平凡解的存在性与多解性定理。
techniques: 识别各向异性非线性耦合算子的特征不变尺度变换，定义控制能量纤维几何的关键参数 $\gamma$。
在乘积 Sobolev 空间上应用针对对称泛函的抽象临界点定理，解决临界增长 Sobolev 紧致性缺失问题。
针对负临界项在无穷远处引起的能量退化，构造精细的变分截断函数与局部 Nehari 流形分解。
analyses.breakthrough: 突破了以往带负临界非线性项的椭圆系统多解性主要依赖正定扰动的局限，首次发现了主导各向异性拟线性系统能量泛函几何分歧的本质临界指数 $\gamma$，并在三类不同的几何区域上完整建立了多解存在性分类定理。
analyses.limitations: 多解性结论严重依赖于耦合系统的奇对称性条件（从而能应用对称抽象临界点定理），对于缺乏奇对称性或边界带有粗糙非光滑奇异性的各向异性系统，解的多重性仍缺乏有效变分工具。

analyses.title: RC-positivity of complex surfaces
analyses.abstract: Given a compact complex surface with a nonflat Ricci-flat Kähler metric, we show that its holomorphic tangent bundle admits an RC-positive Hermitian metric. The proof relies on a characterization of RC-positivity through the anti-self-dual part of the Weyl operator, the Weitzenböck formula on the four dimensional Einstein manifold, and a conformal perturbation on the Ricci-flat metric. As a consequence, we prove that RC-positivity is not preserved after taking tensor, exterior, or symmetric power. Moreover, we show that RC-positivity is a strictly weaker notion than uniform RC-positivity, and that RC-positivity of holomorphic tangent bundle does not necessarily imply rational connectedness of the base manifold.
analyses.progressType: 紧复曲面切丛RC正性度量存在性与代数张量非保持性
analyses.workSummary: 针对紧复曲面全纯切丛的正曲率性质，作者证明了任何赋予非平坦 Ricci 平坦 Kähler 度量的紧复曲面（如 $K3$ 曲面），其全纯切丛必容许一个 RC 正的 Hermitian 度量。证明关键基于将 RC 正性转化为四维 Einstein 流形上 Weyl 曲率张量反自对偶分量的几何表征，结合 Weitzenböck 公式并在原 Ricci 平坦度量上施加精细的共形扰动。作为重要推论，文章严格否定了 RC 正性在张量积、外积及对称幂下的保持性，澄清了 RC 正性严格弱于一致 RC 正性，并否定了全纯切丛 RC 正性必然蕴涵底流形有理连通性的猜想。
techniques: 利用四维 Einstein 流形上的反自对偶 Weyl 算子谱性质，建立复曲面上全纯切丛 RC 正性的等价几何判据。
借助四维流形上的 Weitzenböck 恒等式与非平坦 Ricci 平坦度量的共形扰动技术，构造满足严格正性条件的 Hermitian 度量。
通过在紧致 Ricci 平坦复曲面上构建显式反例，系统证伪 RC 正性在张量积、外积与对称幂下的代数封闭性。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次证明非平坦 Ricci 平坦紧复曲面的全纯切丛容许 RC 正度量，彻底澄清了 RC 正性与底流形有理连通性之间的分离现象，并证明了 RC 正性在张量、外积与对称幂下均不保持。
analyses.limitations: 目前证明深度依赖四维自对偶与反自对偶 Weyl 分解以及实四维 Einstein 流形的特殊微分几何结构，该共形扰动与构造方案尚无法直接推广至六维及更高维度的 Calabi--Yau 流形。

analyses.title: PV-Wave Decomposition and Combined Wave Effects for Stratified Couette Flows
analyses.abstract: Motivated by a class of three-component Fourier ODE systems consisting of a conserved mode coupled to a pair of oscillatory modes, we develop a "potential-vorticity-wave" (PV-Wave) decomposition strategy for constructing adapted energy variables in the stability analysis of Couette flows. The strategy separates the conserved potential-vorticity component, symmetrizes the remaining wave subsystem, and introduces an additional correction to control the couplings generated by time-dependent Fourier coefficients. We apply this framework to study the linearized dynamics of 3D Boussinesq MHD system and Rotating Boussinesq system for Couette flows and quantify the inviscid damping and parameter-dependent amplification arising from the interaction of Alfvén-gravity waves and inertial-gravity waves.
analyses.progressType: 分层Couette流势涡-波分解与非粘性阻尼定量分析
analyses.workSummary: 针对分层剪切流中守恒模态与振荡模态耦合的三分量 Fourier 常微分方程系统，发展了一种用于构建自适应能量变量的势涡-波（PV-Wave）分解方法。该方法分离出守恒的势涡分量，将剩余波子系统对称化，并引入附加修正以控制时间相关 Fourier 系数引起的模态耦合。将此理论框架应用于三维 Boussinesq MHD 系统与旋转 Boussinesq 系统的 Couette 流线性化动力学，定量刻画了由 Alfvén-重力波及惯性-重力波相互作用诱导的非粘性阻尼与参数依赖性暂态放大效应。
techniques: 构建势涡-波（PV-Wave）正交分解与自适应能量变量，将守恒势涡模态与共振振荡波子系统实现显式解耦。
针对非定常剪切驱动的时间依赖 Fourier 系数设计修正对称化算子，消除快慢模态间的离散交叉反馈共振。
通过微局部分析定量计算 Alfvén-重力波与惯性-重力波耦合下的非粘性阻尼衰减率及瞬态能量放大上界。
analyses.breakthrough: 提出通用的三模式势涡-波分解范式，克服了分层旋转与磁流体剪切流动中时间相关多重波动模态耦合难以对称化的分析困难，首次在统一的能量估计框架下给出三维 Boussinesq MHD 与旋转 Boussinesq 系统 Couette 流的非粘性阻尼衰减与瞬态增长的显式定量估计。
analyses.limitations: 当前估计仅局限于线性化算子层面的显式模态动力学分解，未考虑完全非线性扰动下的拟线性涡度混洗反馈与非线性亚临界跃迁；同时分析高度依赖 Couette 背景流的线性剪切结构，对非线性剪切廓线的适应性有待进一步拓展。

analyses.title: Local Combinatorial Criteria for Geometric Hyper-ideal Triangulations via Combinatorial Ricci Flow
analyses.abstract: We give local combinatorial criteria for realizing prescribed ideal triangulations by nondegenerate hyperbolic truncated tetrahedra. A local bichromatic criterion allows valence-7 edges when tetrahedra meeting low-valence edges use at most two quotient-edge classes. Using the extended combinatorial Ricci flow, we obtain parameter-dependent criteria for triangulations of minimum valence 6. Symmetric and pair-min angle estimates yield explicit valence conditions, including mixed conditions on entire edge stars. The proofs use analytic angle inequalities and rigorous interval evaluations. Explicit face pairings realize the criteria and distinguish their scope, while cyclic constructions and finite covers give infinite families. Each criterion yields a unique zero-curvature hyper-ideal metric and exponential convergence from any positive initial length vector.
analyses.progressType: 基于组合 Ricci 流的双曲超理想剖分局部组合判据
analyses.workSummary: 研究三维双曲几何中利用非退化截角双曲四面体实现预定理想三角剖分的几何可实现性问题。作者利用推广的组合 Ricci 流，建立了判定给定剖分可几何化为非退化超理想四面体拼接的局部组合判据。特别提出了允许存在 $7$-价边的双色局部条件，并给出最低价为 $6$ 的参数化剖分准则。结合对称与对极小角估计，推导出关于整条边星的显式组合约束；进一步证明了每个判据均能保证唯一零曲率超理想度量的存在性以及从任意正初值长度向量出发的组合 Ricci 流的指数收敛性。
techniques: 引入推广的离散双曲组合 Ricci 流微分方程组，分析以边长为变量的凸能量泛函负梯度流。
建立截角双曲四面体二面角关于边长的解析不等式与严格区间算术区间评估机制。
analyses.breakthrough: 提出了实现截角双曲超理想剖分的显式局部组合判据，突破了以往要求全局三角剖分严格受限的瓶颈，并证明了组合 Ricci 流具有唯一零曲率度量解与全局指数收敛性。
analyses.limitations: 局部组合判据对低价边与边星的度数分布有特定代数组合限制，对于包含任意复杂低价边拓扑缺陷或带奇异尖点的一般三维流形剖分适用范围有限。

analyses.title: Sharp Observability Costs for Strongly Coupled Parabolic Systems with Vanishing Principal Coupling
analyses.abstract: We study the loss of observability for a class of strongly coupled parabolic systems as the coupling parameter tends to zero. The system is observed through a fixed matrix $B$ on a measurable subset of space-time with positive measure. Under the Kalman rank condition, we determine the exact blow-up rates of the optimal observability cost. Different components of the state, as well as different combinations of them, may have different blow-up rates, and these rates are determined by the algebraic structure of the pair $(B,K)$. The full-state observability cost is determined by the largest of these rates. We also show that the worst-case minimum $L^\infty$-norm of null controls has the same asymptotic behavior.
analyses.progressType: 强耦合抛物系统零主耦合极限下可观测性代价尖锐爆破解
analyses.workSummary: 论文深入研究了主耦合参数趋于零时强耦合抛物型偏微分方程组的可观测性退化机制。在正测度时空可测子集上通过固定观测矩阵$B$进行观测，作者在Kalman代数秩条件下，精确测定了最优可观测性代价随耦合参数趋于零时的尖锐爆破速率。研究揭示出系统不同分量及其线性组合的爆破速率由矩阵偶$(B,K)$的代数结构完全决定，全状态可观测性代价取其最大速率，且零能控问题的最小$L^\infty$控制范数具有完全一致的渐近爆破阶。
techniques: 将抛物型方程组的状态解空间与矩阵偶$(B,K)$生成的Krylov子空间及Kalman可控性代数链精细匹配。
在正测度时空可测集合上运用Lebeau--Robbiano型谱能量投影估计与渐近摄动分析，推导双尺度消解不等式。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在一般正测度观测集上精确解析了强耦合退化为弱耦合或解耦极限时，抛物系统可观测性常数爆破阶数与观测控制代数链长度之间的显式对应法则。
analyses.limitations: 理论框架主要针对常系数空间齐次耦合矩阵结构，对于扩散系数非对角且依赖空间梯度的非线性抛物拟线性系统，其退化耦合下的控制代价估计仍需进一步探索。

analyses.title: Orbifold Mapping Spaces via Bibundles
analyses.abstract: The existence of orbifold structures on mapping spaces between orbifolds was established in previous work, notably by W. Chen and B. Chen-Du-Liao. In this paper, we construct an infinite-dimensional orbifold structure on the mapping space in a more geometric way, using bibundles (or Hilsum-Skandalis morphisms), based on Lerman's description of orbifold morphisms. We construct a proper étale (or Fréchet) Lie groupoid representing the mapping space in the $C^k$, $C^\infty$, and $W^{k,p}$ settings, and show that its Morita equivalence class is independent of the choices of groupoid presentations. Locally, the mapping groupoid is isomorphic to the action groupoid of a finite group, where the finite group is identified with the automorphism group of the corresponding bibundle. This provides a concrete geometric framework for further studies of mapping spaces and moduli spaces on orbifolds, with applications to Floer theory on symplectic orbifolds.
analyses.progressType: 基于双主丛的轨形映射空间无穷维几何李群胚结构构建
analyses.workSummary: 研究轨形之间映射空间的无穷维几何拓扑结构。作者基于 Lerman 的轨形态射描述，采用双主丛（bibundles 或 Hilsum--Skandalis 态射）方法重新构建了映射空间上的无穷维轨形结构。在 $C^k$、$C^\infty$ 及 Sobolev 类 $W^{k,p}$ 设定下，构造出表示映射空间的固有多 étale 李群胚，并证明其 Morita 等价类完全独立于群胚展示的选取。局部上，该映射群胚与对应双主丛自同构有限群的群作用胚同构，为辛轨形上的 Floer 理论及模空间研究提供了坚实的内蕴几何工具。
techniques: 利用双主丛及其弱等价关系取代传统点态光滑映射，表征轨形之间的广义态射空间。
在 Sobolev 切丛截面空间上赋予无穷维 Fréchet 拓扑并建立 Morita 等价不变性定理。
analyses.breakthrough: 以双主丛和李群胚为核心，建立了轨形映射空间的内蕴无穷维微分几何架构，消除了对局部坐标图卡依赖的非自然选择，为轨形辛拓扑与 Floer 模空间奠定基础。
analyses.limitations: 论文侧重于正则映射拓扑与群胚层面的构型空间几何建立，尚未涉及能量极小拟全纯曲线紧化界上的泡泡退化分析与 Fredholm 虚拟循环延拓细节。

analyses.title: Algebraic Dimension and Reduction of LVMB manifolds
analyses.abstract: LVMB manifolds are a large class of compact complex non-Kähler and non-algebraic manifolds, constructed from an algebro-combinatorial datum. We provide an upper bound on their algebraic dimension and prove it to be sharp. Comparing our result with the lower bound found by Meersseman, we obtain the exact algebraic dimension of an LVMB manifold in many relevant cases. Pursuing our analysis further, we also obtain a description of the algebraic reduction of an LVMB manifold. From this, it emerges that Meersseman's lower bound coincides with the dimension of the rational component. This bimeromorphic invariant of an LVMB manifold is then computed in terms of the nonrationality degree of the associated toric quasifold. This is an invariant recently introduced by Battaglia and Prato, for which we provide an explicit formula.
analyses.progressType: 紧非 Kähler LVMB 流形代数维数尖锐上界与代数约化刻画
analyses.workSummary: 针对由代数组合构型生成的非 Kähler 且非代数紧复流形类——$\mathrm{LVMB}$ 流形，作者给出了其代数维数的严格上界并证明了该上界的尖锐性。结合 Meersseman 此前发现的下界，在诸多重要情形下确定了 $\mathrm{LVMB}$ 流形的精确代数维数。作者进一步阐明了此类流形的代数约化结构，揭示出 Meersseman 下界本质对应于有理分支的维数；借助关联环面拟折叠的非有理性次数不变量，建立了该双亚纯不变量的显式计算公式。
techniques: 结合扇形多面体代数组合构型分析亚纯函数域，推导出代数维数的极值代数不等式。
利用 Battaglia--Prato 环面拟折叠的非有理性次数，显式计算有理分支维数与代数约化。
analyses.breakthrough: 建立了 $\mathrm{LVMB}$ 流形代数维数的尖锐上界并完全解决了有理成分维数的代数约化计算难题，将组合拟折叠几何与非 Kähler 复流形理论紧密结合。
analyses.limitations: 所用技术依托于复环面作用下特定的对角化全纯动力系统组合数据，对更一般的非全纯可积非 Kähler 复流形族（如一般 Calabi--Yau 三维复几何）的代数维数难以直接推广。

analyses.title: Gravitational instantons and hyperbolic space
analyses.abstract: We construct a degeneration of Hitchin's non-standard minitwistor spaces associated with toric gravitational instantons of type A$_{\rm odd}$ to the minitwistor space of a simple hyperbolic orbifold. We show that the corresponding families of minitwistor lines also converge under this degeneration. Consequently, the associated non-standard Einstein--Weyl spaces converge to the hyperbolic orbifold.
analyses.progressType: 奇数型环面引力瞬子微扭量空间向双曲拟流形的退化极限
analyses.workSummary: 针对 $A_{\rm odd}$ 型环面引力瞬子关联的 Hitchin 非标准微扭量空间，构建其向简单双曲拟流形微扭量空间的几何退化过程。详细分析了退化过程中对应的微扭量曲线族的收敛动力学，证明了伴随的非标准 Einstein--Weyl 三维空间在退化极限下严格收敛至目标双曲拟流形。
techniques: 构建基于 Hitchin 非标准微扭量空间的奇数型环面引力瞬子复几何退化模型。
分析微扭量曲线族在解析退化下的柯西-黎曼形变与一致紧致收敛性。
确立非标准 Einstein--Weyl 几何结构向双曲拟流形背景度量的渐近逼近。
analyses.breakthrough: 揭示了四维四元数型引力瞬子微扭量空间与三维双曲几何之间的退化对偶联系，首次将 Hitchin 非标准 Einstein--Weyl 结构的极限奇异性精确对应为双曲空间拟流形。

analyses.title: Formalization of the Galerkin Construction for the Two-Dimensional Navier--Stokes Equations in Lean
analyses.abstract: We formalize in Lean 4 the Galerkin construction of global Leray--Hopf weak solutions for the unforced two-dimensional Navier--Stokes equations on arbitrary bounded open domains with no-slip boundary conditions. For every initial datum in the solenoidal \(L^2\) velocity space, the solution has a weakly continuous velocity path, satisfies the weak equation locally in time, and obeys the energy inequality at every time. For rectangles, we also formalize finite-horizon solutions with continuous forcing in the dual energy space. The development includes divergence-free graph spaces, compact spectral coordinates, transport cancellation, Ladyzhenskaya estimates, and simultaneous space--time compactness. The abstract Hilbert-space results apply to evolution equations with a compact energy-to-velocity embedding and a skew trilinear nonlinearity.
analyses.progressType: 二维Navier-Stokes方程Galerkin弱解构造在Lean中的严格形式化
analyses.workSummary: 针对任意带无滑移边界条件的有界开区域上的二维不可压缩无外力 Navier-Stokes 方程，作者在交互式定理证明器 Lean 4 中形式化实现了全局 Leray-Hopf 弱解的 Galerkin 逼近构造。对无散度 $L^2$ 速度空间中的任意初值，证明了其弱连续速度轨迹的存在性，局部时间满足弱解方程，并在所有时刻服从能量不等式；此外，对矩形区域形式化了带对偶能量空间连续外力的有限时间解，建立了包含 Ladyzhenskaya 估计与时空紧性的抽象 Hilbert 空间演化理论。
techniques: 在形式化证明器 Lean 4 中严密定义无散图空间与正交谱坐标系，建立非线性输运对流项的斜反对称抵消代数命题。
形式化 Ladyzhenskaya 乘积插值不等式与紧能量嵌入引理，实现 Galerkin 离散逼近解到连续弱解的时空紧性取极限论证。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次在现代交互式定理证明器 Lean 4 中完整形式化了非线性偏微分方程经典理论的核心支柱——二维 Navier-Stokes 方程全局 Leray-Hopf 弱解的存在性与能量不等式，完成了从无穷维函数分析、谱分解到非线性对流项测度紧性收敛的机器可验证证明，为偏微分方程严密形式化提供了可复用的基础模块。
analyses.limitations: 目前形式化工作聚焦于二维无外力或带特定外力的能量弱解框架，尚未涵盖三维非唯一性极限构造（如凸积分技术）、强解的光滑性唯一定理以及非光滑凸多面体区域上的边界微局部解析；此外，高维 Sobolev 乘子形式化库的欠缺使得高阶正则性提升仍需进一步构建。

analyses.title: Bourgain--Brezis selection maps for Hodge systems in Besov and Triebel--Lizorkin spaces
analyses.abstract: We establish Bourgain--Brezis selection maps for Hodge systems in new ranges of Besov and Triebel--Lizorkin spaces. Our approach combines the trace-free Beurling--Ahlfors transform with a nonlinear duality method. To control concentrations, we use tools developed by Stolyarov in the study of Maz'ya's $Φ$-inequalities. These methods yield selection maps in Besov spaces $\dot B^{n/p}_{p,q}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ for every $1\leq q\leq p\leq 2$, and in Triebel--Lizorkin spaces $\dot F^{n/p}_{p,q}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ for every $1<p\leq q\leq 2$. The theorems hold for every dimension $n\geq 2$ and every form degree $1\leq l\leq n-1$. Although our results overlap with some earlier work, they considerably extend the known range of solutions to the Bourgain--Brezis problem and underscore the importance of the trace-free Beurling--Ahlfors transform in its resolution.
analyses.progressType: Besov与Triebel-Lizorkin空间中Hodge系统选择映射
analyses.workSummary: 论文在更广的Besov空间与Triebel--Lizorkin空间指标范围内，确立了Hodge系统对应的Bourgain--Brezis选择映射。作者将无迹Beurling--Ahlfors变换与非线性对偶方法相结合，并利用处理Maz'ya的$\Phi$不等式中的集中测度控制工具，在任意维度$n\ge 2$和任意微分形式阶数$1\le l\le n-1$下建立了临界尺度空间的解算子连续选择映射。
techniques: 将无迹Beurling--Ahlfors共形微分算子与非线性对偶泛函极小化相结合，实现外微分系统弱解的稳定重构。
引入Stolyarov处理Maz'ya型不等式的原子分解与几何集中控制技术，有效克服临界指数下的测度集中奇异性。

analyses.title: Off-diagonal bounds for spectral projector kernels
analyses.abstract: We study the growth of the spectral function of the Laplace-Beltrami operator on a Riemannian manifold $M$ of dimension $n$. For $n\geq 3$ we show that for any $x\in M$ there is a full measure subset $Z_x\subset M$ such that for all $y\in Z_x$ \[E_Λ(x,y) = O_{M,x,y,\varepsilon}(Λ^{n/2}(\logΛ)^{3/2}(\log\logΛ)^{1/2+\varepsilon}). \] For $n=2$ we prove a stronger statement. For any $x\in M$ there is a full measure subset $Z_x\subset M$ such that for all $y\in Z_x$ \[E_Λ(x,y) = O_{M,x,y,\varepsilon}(Λ^{5/6}(\logΛ)^{1/6}(\log\logΛ)^{1/6+\varepsilon}) .\]
analyses.progressType: 黎曼流形上谱投影核非对角几乎处处增长界
analyses.workSummary: 作者研究了$n$维黎曼流形$M$上Laplace--Beltrami算子谱函数$E_\Lambda(x,y)$在非对角线区域的渐近增长阶。证明对任意给定点$x\in M$，存在全测度子集$Z_x\subset M$使得对其上几乎处处的$y$，高维$n\ge 3$下谱投影核满足$O(\Lambda^{n/2}(\log\Lambda)^{3/2}(\log\log\Lambda)^{1/2+\varepsilon})$，而在二维曲面$n=2$下进一步改进为$O(\Lambda^{5/6}(\log\Lambda)^{1/6}(\log\log\Lambda)^{1/6+\varepsilon})$。

analyses.title: A Critical Value for the Viscosity Coefficient: Triggering Oscillatory Traveling Waves in the Pseudo-parabolic Fisher-KPP Equation
analyses.abstract: The pseudo-parabolic term $u_{xxt}$ serves as a canonical example of higher-order viscosity that provides effective regularization while capturing the refined physical mechanism. How it alters the dynamics of prototype equations remains a fundamental issue, which is not yet fully understood. The goal of this paper is to show that this term induces a sharp transition in traveling wave structure, via studying the pseudo-parabolic Fisher-KPP equation $$ u_t - τu_{xxt} = D u_{xx} + u(1-u). $$ We completely characterize how the parameter ratio $τ/D$ acts as a critical switch: it preserves the monotonic structure of classical traveling waves when $τ/D \leq 1$, yet it triggers a qualitative shift to oscillatory traveling waves when $τ/D > 1$. Numerical simulations support these findings. The threshold $τ/D=1$ thus captures the dual role of the pseudo-parabolic term: it acts as a structure-preserving viscosity when small, but when large it reflects dominant capillary hysteresis, generating the oscillations that explain the saturation overshoot, a phenomenon that contradicts classical diffusion models yet is widely observed in two-phase flow.
analyses.progressType: 伪抛物Fisher-KPP方程行波振荡相变临界阈值完全刻画
analyses.workSummary: 针对含有高阶正则化混合导数项 $u_{xxt}$ 的伪抛物 Fisher--KPP 反应扩散方程 $u_t - \tau u_{xxt} = D u_{xx} + u(1-u)$，研究粘性色散竞争机制对非线性行波结构解的定性影响。完整证明了动力学系统参数比值 $\tau/D$ 是触发波前解空间构型拓扑相变的临界开关：当粘性系数比满足 $\tau/D \le 1$ 时，系统保持经典单调波前解结构；而当 $\tau/D > 1$ 时，高阶粘性触发定性相变，必然诱导出非单调的振荡行波解。从数学物理机制上揭示了毛细滞后效应对两相流饱和度过冲现象的决定性机理。
techniques: 构建降维行波常微分动力系统并在相空间建立关于非局部三阶向量场的不变流形与奇点分支分析。
利用精细相平面分析与特征多项式复根判定法，证明参数比临界分界线 $\tau/D = 1$ 的严格双边单调-振荡相变。
结合上下解方法与连接平衡态 $(1,0)$ 的异宿轨道刚性估计，排除非临界参数区间的假振荡波。
analyses.breakthrough: 完全解决了伪抛物混合导数如何改变经典反应扩散前沿构型的长期未决问题，严格确定了单调行波向振荡行波转变的普适临界常数 $\tau/D = 1$，为两相流与多孔介质中观测到的饱和度过冲物理反常现象提供了坚实的严格数学机理解释。
analyses.limitations: 理论分析基于一维空间无界直线上的定常行波剖面，对于高维几何区域中曲率前沿的波动形貌、界面毛细收缩不稳定性以及具非线性退化迁移率伪抛物系统的波前相互作用尚未展开研究。

analyses.title: Schwarz lemma on bounded symmetric domains endowed with holomorphic invariant Kähler--Berwald metrics
analyses.abstract: We prove a rigidity theorem: a globally symmetric complex Finsler space $(M, J, F)$ is necessarily a Kähler-Berwald space, namely $F$ must be a Kähler-Berwald metric. We also obtain a Schwarz lemma for holomorphic mappings $f$ from an arbitrary bounded symmetric domain $\mathfrak{D}$ into itself whenever $\mathfrak{D}$ is endowed with an $\mbox{Aut}(\mathfrak{D})$-invariant Kähler-Berwald metric $F$ such that its holomorphic sectional curvature is bounded below and above by negative constants $-K_1<0$ and $-K_2<0$, respectively. The novelty of this Schwarz lemma is that the Lu constant of $(\mathfrak{D},F)$ is optimal for each given $F$ whenever rank$(\mathfrak{D})\geq 2$.
analyses.topicLabel: 亚黎曼与 Finsler 几何
analyses.progressType: 全局对称复 Finsler 空间刚性与有界对称域 Schwarz 引理
analyses.workSummary: 研究复 Finsler 几何中有界对称域的全纯不变量与曲率刚性性质。作者首先证明了一个深刻的几何刚性定理：任意全局对称复 Finsler 空间 $(M, J, F)$ 必为 Kähler--Berwald 空间，即其度量 $F$ 必为 Kähler--Berwald 度量。其次，在赋有自同构群 $\mathrm{Aut}(\mathfrak{D})$-不变且全纯截面曲率被两负常数 $-K_1 < 0$ 与 $-K_2 < 0$ 双向控制的有界对称域 $\mathfrak{D}$ 上，建立了全纯自映射的 Schwarz 引理；特别证明了当 $\operatorname{rank}(\mathfrak{D}) \ge 2$ 时所得的 Lu 常数达到严格最优。
techniques: 运用李群李代数对合自同构与根空间分解，证明复对称 Finsler 度量联络的 Berwald 平坦性。
结合全纯截面曲率负双边界构建高阶微分形式，导出全纯映射的广义 Royden--Lu 型极值微分不等式。
analyses.breakthrough: 确立了全局对称复 Finsler 流形必退化为 Kähler--Berwald 流形的完备刚性分类，并在高秩有界对称域上推导出常数达到最优的内蕴 Schwarz 引理。
analyses.limitations: 结论依赖于域的齐性对称结构与度量的自同构不变性假设，对不具备全局对称李群作用的一般拟凸拟对称复 Finsler 域的有效映射估计仍不适用。

analyses.abstract: On the upper hemisphere, we use the Obata-Escobar argument to establish an Obata theorem for $σ_k$-flat and positive constant boundary $\mathcal B_k$-curvature equation, which was initiated by Case-Wang [Adv. Math. 337 (2018), 83-106].
analyses.progressType: 上半球面上关于边界曲率方程的Obata型刚性定理
analyses.workSummary: 针对标准黎曼半球面及其平坦赤道边界几何，论文运用拓展的Obata--Escobar积分恒等式论证，确立了关于$\sigma_k$-平坦且具有常正边界$\mathcal{B}_k$-曲率非线性共形椭圆方程的Obata型刚性分类定理。证明表明该边界非线性方程的全部正解必由全纯共形自同构诱导，肯定回答了Case--Wang在2018年开启的共形高阶边界曲率刚性课题。
techniques: 将经典内蕴流形的Obata型Bochner恒等式拓展至包含非线性边界算子$\mathcal{B}_k$的带边全纯共形系统。
利用半球面截面曲率常数与边界第二基本形式的代数对消关系，建立无散度修正梯度张量的边界积分恒等式。

analyses.title: Asymptotically Hölder gradient regularity for degenerate or singular parabolic normalized $ p$-Laplace equations
analyses.abstract: We study bounded viscosity solutions of the degenerate or singular parabolic equation \[ u_t-|Du|^γΔ_p^{\mathrm{N}}u=f \qquad \text{in } Q_1, \] where \[ Δ_p^{\mathrm{N}}u := Δu+(p-2) \left\langle D^2u\frac{Du}{|Du|}, \frac{Du}{|Du|} \right\rangle, \qquad -1<γ<\infty,\quad 1<p<\infty, \] and $f\in C^0(Q_1)\cap L^\infty(Q_1)$. Given any prescribed $α\in(0,1)$, we prove that there exists $\varepsilon=\varepsilon(n,α)>0$ such that \[ |p-2|+|γ|\leq\varepsilon \quad\Longrightarrow\quad u\in C_{\mathrm{loc}}^{1+α,\frac{1+α}{2}}(Q_1). \] In particular, the spatial gradient Hölder exponent can be chosen arbitrarily close to $ 1 $ as $(p,γ)\to(2,0)$. This extends the result of Andrade and Santos (Calc. Var. Partial Differential Equations \textbf{61}, Paper No. 196, 2022) for $γ=0$ to the joint regime $(p,γ)\to(2,0)$ and answers affirmatively the question raised in Remark~1.1 therein.
analyses.progressType: 退化或奇异抛物正规化 $p$-Laplace 渐近 Hölder 梯度正则性
analyses.workSummary: 针对含有退化或奇异梯度乘子项的抛物型正规化 $p$-Laplace 方程 $u_t - |Du|^\gamma \Delta_p^{\mathrm{N}} u = f$（其中 $-1 < \gamma < \infty, 1 < p < \infty$），在时空柱体 $Q_1$ 上深入研究有界粘性解的高阶时空梯度正则性。证明了对于任意给定的 Hölder 指数 $\alpha \in (0, 1)$，只要摄动参数距离热传导算子充分接近（即 $|p-2| + |\gamma| \le \varepsilon(n, \alpha)$），粘性解必然具有局部渐近 Hölder 空间正则性 $u \in C_{\mathrm{loc}}^{1+\alpha, \frac{1+\alpha}{2}}(Q_1)$。当参数对 $(p, \gamma) \to (2, 0)$ 时，空间梯度的 Hölder 指数可任意逼近 $1$。全面拓展了 Andrade 与 Santos 的经典工作并肯定回答了其中遗留的公开问题。
techniques: 发展非齐次退化抛物算子的局部吹涨分析与紧致性摄动方法，建立无梯度非退化先验下界假定下的连续模控制。
构建正规化 $p$-Laplace 算子与非线性梯度乘子 $|Du|^\gamma$ 的联合几何比较原理与二次球多项式逼近。
利用 Campanato 空间特征与阶梯几何迭代衰减估计，实现空间梯度与时间导数在极限临界参数邻域的同步正则化提升。
analyses.breakthrough: 完全解决并肯定回答了 Andrade 和 Santos 在其关于正规化 $p$-Laplace 方程正则性研究中提出的著名公开猜想，首次在涵盖退化与奇异双重非线性的联合参数区域 $(p, \gamma) \to (2, 0)$ 内，严格建立了空间梯度 Hölder 指数能够任意逼近最优 Lipschitz 界 $1$ 的渐近最优正则性定理。
analyses.limitations: 结论基于参数 $(p, \gamma)$ 充分靠近标准调和热传导态 $(2, 0)$ 的摄动小邻域假设，对于参数远离调和态的大范围退化区间（如 $p \gg 2$ 或超奇异临界点 $\gamma \to -1$）的有界粘性解梯度 Hölder 连续性尚无法提供显式依赖常数。

analyses.title: Pitt Inequalities and Logarithmic-type Uncertainty Principles for Metaplectic Operators
analyses.abstract: In this work, we provide a complete characterisation of Pitt's inequality for metaplectic operators. The symplectic geometry underlying a metaplectic operator distinguishes effective directions, along which its action is Fourier-type, from singular directions, along which concentration is preserved. For this reason, we adopt two complementary perspectives, thereby obtaining both an isotropic Pitt's inequality, emulating the classical theorem of Pitt, and an anisotropic inequality that adapts to the geometric features of the metaplectic group. As a by-product, we obtain Pitt's inequality for Fourier transforms along subspaces of $\rd$ and new quantitative time-dependent boundedness results for metaplectic operators on homogeneous Sobolev spaces, with applications to Schrödinger evolutions generated by quadratic Hamiltonians. Additionally, we derive logarithmic and entropic uncertainty principles for the metaplectic group. We show that the classical entropic uncertainty principle fails when both the effective and singular directions are present. In this case, a generally unbounded corrective entropy term accounts for the concentration-preserving directions and restores a meaningful lower bound. For quadratic Schrödinger evolutions, this correction follows the time-dependent geometry of the nondispersive directions and adjusts the uncertainty estimate accordingly.
analyses.progressType: 元辛算子Pitt不等式与对数不确定性原理完全刻画
analyses.workSummary: 论文完全刻画了元辛算子（metaplectic operators）的Pitt型加权频域不等式。针对元辛算子内在辛几何结构中区分出的Fourier型有效发散方向与保持质量集中的奇异方向，作者分别建立了各向同性与各向异性Pitt不等式，推导出齐次Sobolev空间上随时间演化的定量有界估计，并揭示了二次Hamilton量Schrödinger流中经典熵不确定性原理的失效机制及修正熵补偿原理。
techniques: 将辛变换Lie代数分解为剪切、坐标旋转与部分Fourier变换，分类提炼有效发散与集中奇性方向。

analyses.title: Isothermal walls in the compressible Navier-Stokes equations: affine entropy, ballistic energy, and entropy-stable discrete formulations
analyses.abstract: We develop entropy-stable isothermal-wall conditions for the compressible Navier--Stokes equations at continuous and semi-discrete levels. For a stationary, impermeable, no-slip wall at constant positive temperature, adding total-energy density divided by wall temperature to the canonical convex entropy cancels the wall contribution without suppressing heat transfer. This affine modification preserves the entropy Hessian, relative entropy, and volume entropy production. It is proportional to total ballistic-energy density and yields a conditional $L_2$-type bound based on the initial field under the stated assumptions. Two wall formulations use a common discontinuous Galerkin discretization with the summation-by-parts property and simultaneous approximation terms. Both give zero adapted wall contribution without a penalty and a nonpositive contribution with it. The complete-residual formulation penalizes the full wall-data residual and balances fluid energy through its complete numerical wall flux. The Fourier-energy-exact formulation combines an entropy-neutral skew correction with a momentum-projected penalty so that the complete numerical outward energy flux equals the one-sided numerical Fourier heat flux at every wall node and spatial resolution. Pointwise tests verify the local identities. Manufactured-solution studies with entropy-stable interior coupling demonstrate convergence rates consistent with order $p_s+1$ in the discrete $L_2$ norm, where $p_s$ is the solution polynomial degree. Thermal-relaxation calculations verify the semi-discrete energy and adapted-entropy balances. Three-dimensional calculations demonstrate balance closure in a closed domain, convergence of curved-wall traces, and applicability to a complex supersonic separated flow.
analyses.progressType: 可压缩Navier-Stokes等温壁面仿射熵与半离散熵稳定格式
analyses.workSummary: 针对具有恒温不渗透无滑移壁面边界的可压缩 Navier--Stokes 方程，在连续与半离散水平构建具备熵稳定性的等温固壁边界条件。作者在经典凸熵基础上引入总能量密度除以壁面温度的仿射修正，该修正完全抵消了边界对熵增的非物理侵蚀，同时完好保持了热传导通量、熵 Hessian 矩阵以及体熵产生项。在离散层面，基于分部求和性质的不连续 Galerkin 框架，提出完全残差型与精确 Fourier 热流型两种边界处理格式，并在连续极限下推导出基于初场能量的条件 $L^2$ 型先验范数控制。

analyses.title: A decomposition theorem for elliptic structures of minimal rank on compact Lie groups and applications
analyses.abstract: We show that every left-invariant elliptic structure of minimal rank on an odd-dimensional compact Lie group admits an algebraic decomposition analogous to those obtained by Pittie in the complex case and by Charbonnel and Khalgui for left-invariant CR structures of hypersurface type. We then use this decomposition to prove that the cohomology associated with such an elliptic structure can be reduced to a computation on a suitable maximal torus.

analyses.title: Symmetry of solutions to nonlocal Neumann problems with the fractional Laplacian in half spaces
analyses.abstract: This paper investigates the fractional Laplacian equation in half-spaces, focusing on cases with nonlocal Neumann boundary conditions. We consider both single equations and systems, and establish two key principles: the decay at infinity principle and the narrow region principle. These foundational results, combined with the direct method of moving planes, allow us to derive symmetry and monotonicity properties for decaying solutions. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first results concerning the symmetry of solutions to fractional Laplacian equations with nonlocal Neumann conditions.

analyses.title: Well-posedness of Boussinesq Equation with Linear Restoring Force
analyses.abstract: We establish a local well-posedness theory for the $n-$dimensional Boussinesq equation with a linear restoring force in a modified Sobolev spaces $H_ω^s$ and Bourgain-type spaces $X_ω^{s,b}$, which are adapted to its modified dispersion relation. The restoring force introduces a new phase function whose behavior in the low-frequencies is different from ones of the classical Boussinesq equation, that in turn, affects the associated energy functional. We prove bilinear and trilinear estimates for quadratic and cubic nonlinearities, respectively, which in turn imply local well-posedness under suitable conditions on $s$ and $ω$. To our knowledge, this is the first well-posedness result for this model.

analyses.title: Boundary pointwise regularity for the $p$-Laplace equation on $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ domains
analyses.abstract: This paper investigates the boundary pointwise regularity of solutions to the p-Laplace equation. By treating curved boundaries as perturbations of flat ones, we establish the boundary pointwise Lipschitz regularity under the exterior $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ condition and the Hopf lemma under the interior $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ condition. We also establish the boundary pointwise $C^1$ regularity under the $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ condition by a compactness argument.
analyses.progressType: Dini流形边界上p-Laplace方程边界点态Lipschitz与C1正则性
analyses.workSummary: 针对满足 $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ 几何条件的非光滑弯曲边界区域上的拟线性 $p$-Laplace 椭圆方程，系统探讨弱解的边界点态几何正则性。作者将弯曲边界视为平坦切空间的局部非线性微扰，在外 $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ 几何条件下确立了弱解的边界点态 Lipschitz 估计，并在内 $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ 条件下严格证明了强极值原理与 Hopf 引理；最后借助紧性爆破逼近法，在双边 $C^{1,\mathrm{Dini}}$ 正则性假设下完整建立了弱解的边界点态 $C^1$ 正则性。

analyses.title: Nonlinear Stability of Nonconstant Steady States in Chemotaxis--Consumption Systems with General Motility
analyses.abstract: We prove nonlinear stability of positive nonconstant steady states for a chemotaxis--consumption system with nutrient-dependent motility and a fixed boundary nutrient concentration $b$. The motility satisfies two monotonicity conditions met by power laws and saturating functions. For each prescribed population mass, sufficiently large nutrient diffusivity $D$ yields a unique positive steady state. Small compatible perturbations generate unique global solutions converging exponentially to the steady state with their conserved mass. The result holds on general bounded domains in two and three dimensions, with a lower-regularity version on an interval. At order $D^{-1}$, the nutrient deficit is the torsion function multiplied by the mean population density and boundary nutrient value; the population contrast also depends on $κ_b=bφ'(b)/φ(b)$. Computations illustrate relaxation from compatible data and convergence to different steady states when the initial mass changes.
analyses.progressType: 广义迁移率趋化消耗系统非常值稳态大扩散非线性稳定性
analyses.workSummary: 针对具有养分依赖型迁移率与固定边界养分浓度 $b$ 的趋化-消耗系统，研究正非常值定常解的构造与非线性稳定性。迁移率满足幂律与饱和函数等广泛成立的单调性条件。证明在给定种群总质量的前提下，只要养分扩散系数 $D$ 充分大，系统便存在唯一的正非常值定常解。对于相容的小初值扰动，构造了唯一全局经典解并证明其以指数衰减速率收敛于守恒质量对应的非平凡稳态。所得结论在二维及三维任意光滑有界区域以及一维区间上均成立。
techniques: 在大养分扩散率 $D \gg 1$ 机制下利用隐函数定理与拓扑度理论建立非常值正稳态解的分支与全局唯一性。
引入基于边界初边值扭曲函数的积分展开，精确确定 $O(D^{-1})$ 阶养分亏损空间轮廓。
构建能量耗散估计与加权 $L^2$-$H^2$ 压缩半群框架，严格确立小扰动全局解沿守恒流形的指数时间衰减。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底克服了边界非齐次养分通量与非退化养分依赖迁移率耦合导致的非自伴谱分析困难，首次在二、三维一般光滑区域中对具一般迁移率的非常值趋化稳态建立大扩散极限下的局部唯一性与指数非线性渐近稳定性。
analyses.limitations: 稳定性结论依赖于养分扩散系数 $D$ 充分大的渐近假设，对于中等或小养分扩散系数下由趋化汇聚驱动的复杂空间图样失稳、霍普夫分岔及多稳态共存动力学行为尚未给出刻画。

analyses.title: Boundary Regularity for Fully Nonlinear Singular Elliptic Equations
analyses.abstract: We study boundary regularity for the fully nonlinear singular elliptic equation of the form $|Du|^γF(D^2u)=f$, where $-1<γ<0$. First, we prove pointwise boundary $C^{1,α}$ estimates with pointwise $C^{1,α}$ Dirichlet data, which weakens the $C^2$ domain smoothness requirement from Birindelli and Demengel~\cite{BD10}. The proof uses compactness and perturbation, without flattening the boundary. Second, we extend the $W^{2,δ}$ estimates of Li and Li~\cite{LiLi17} from balls to $C^{1,α}$ domains with $C^{1,α}$ Dirichlet data{, for $0<δ\leδ_0<1$. Here $δ_0$ is an exponent in the interior $W^{2,δ_0}$ estimate}. The proof combines pointwise boundary $C^{1,α}$ estimates, interior $W^{2,δ_0}$ estimates, and a Whitney decomposition.
analyses.progressType: 完全非线性奇异椭圆方程极小光滑边界正则性与二阶可积估计
analyses.workSummary: 研究奇异型完全非线性椭圆方程 $|Du|^\gamma F(D^2u) = f$（其中 $-1 < \gamma < 0$）的边界正则性理论。首先在具点态 $C^{1,\alpha}$ 狄利克雷边界数据的区域上建立了点态边界 $C^{1,\alpha}$ 正则性先验估计，将经典文献中要求的区域边界 $C^2$ 光滑性大幅减弱至仅需点态 $C^{1,\alpha}$ 几何，且证明无需对弯曲边界进行局部平坦化拉直。其次，通过巧妙结合边界点态导数估计、内部二阶弱可积界与 Whitney 立方体几何分解，将解在单位球上的 $W^{2,\delta}$ 可积性估计推广到一般的 $C^{1,\alpha}$ 拓扑有界区域。
techniques: 发展无需局部拉平弯曲边界的直接切触扰动紧致性逼近论证，建立完全非线性退化算子的边界逐点 $C^{1,\alpha}$ 模估计。
结合解在奇异梯度集邻域的内部 $W^{2,\delta_0}$ 弱导数估计与多尺度 Whitney 边界立方体覆盖分解技术。
构造满足奇异权重的非线性比较障碍函数，严格控制边界法向退化梯度对二阶 Hessian 测度集发散的影响。
analyses.breakthrough: 大幅减弱了完全非线性奇异方程边界正则性理论中维持三十余年的高阶光滑性几何假设，首次在点态 $C^{1,\alpha}$ 极小边界假设下完整获得点态导数控制与全局 $W^{2,\delta}$ 可积性估计，拓展了粘性解的边界极限定理。
analyses.limitations: 目前所得的二阶导数估计仍局限于小积分指数 $\delta \le \delta_0 < 1$ 的微弱可积性空间，对于退化指数 $\gamma \le -1$ 的超奇异端点情形以及更一般的强凸非变分算子下的高阶 Hölder 边界可微性仍不适用。

analyses.title: On the singular layer for the 1-D steady Euler system with heat conductivity in a finite nozzle as the heat conduction coefficient vanishes
analyses.abstract: This paper investigates the singular limit problem of the one-dimensional steady compressible Euler system with heat conduction in a finite nozzle. The existence of the heat conduction solutions were established and boundary layers at one or two nozzle endpoints occur as the coefficient of heat conductivity goes to zero. The asymptotic behavior of the solutions vary depending on the state at the entrance and the value of the pressure at the exit, which classify the solutions into purely supersonic solution, purely subsonic solution and transonic solution. Moreover, we perform a formal asymptotic expansion of solutions and derive the boundary layer equations.
analyses.progressType: 有限喷管一维定常含热传导 Euler 系统热传导消失奇异边界层
analyses.workSummary: 针对有限长度收缩-扩张喷管中具有热传导效应的一维定常可压缩 Euler 方程组，深入研究热传导系数趋于零时的奇异摄动极限定律。严格证明了含热传导可压缩解的存在性，并揭示了当热传导系数消失时在喷管一个或两个端点处必然形成的高梯度奇异边界层结构。基于喷管入口流动状态与出口反压物理边界值的拓扑搭配，对解的渐近极限构型进行了完备分类，明确划分出纯超音速解、纯亚音速解与穿音速跨音速过渡解三类动力学相图，并给出了渐近展开式与显式边界层方程。
techniques: 建立喷管几何变截面约束下带有热传导耗散的二阶常微分流体动力系统的相空间初边值可解性理论。
利用匹配渐近展开法分离外流非粘性可压缩欧拉解与管口内层热传导快速衰减边界层剖面方程。
通过音速临界点马赫数分支与出口反压射击法，严格分类纯超音速、纯亚音速与跨音速流动模式的拓扑分界。
analyses.breakthrough: 系统阐明了热传导消失极限下有限喷管内部气体流动的奇异摄动机制，首次在变几何喷管物理边界约束下建立了包含双端点边界层、强间断激波过渡及跨音速光滑过渡的完整定常解渐近分类图谱。
analyses.limitations: 当前研究仅针对一维定常几何流动模型展开，尚未考虑高维轴对称喷管中由于壁面剪切摩擦引发的热壁粘性边界层分离、三维流动不稳定性及时间依赖非定常波动解向该定常边界层流动的动力学收敛机制。

analyses.title: Pluriclosed deformations of Bismut flat metrics
analyses.abstract: We deform the complex structure of compact simply-connected Bismut flat manifolds, obtaining new complex manifolds that admit pluriclosed metrics but do not admit Bismut flat metrics. This produces genuinely new examples of pluriclosed manifolds while enriching our understanding of the deformation theory of pluriclosed metrics. Moreover, our main result is relevant for the search of pluriclosed solitons and non-trivial Bismut Hermitian Einstein metrics in all dimensions.
analyses.progressType: 紧单连通 Bismut 平坦流形复结构形变与多闭度量存在性
analyses.workSummary: 探讨紧单连通 Bismut 平坦流形在复结构扰动下的几何保持性与退化现象。作者通过形变其复结构，构造出一类具备多闭度量但不再容许任何 Bismut 平坦度量的新型紧复流形。该构造不仅提供了非 Kähler 几何中多闭流形的全新几何范例，而且深化了多闭度量的形变理论，为高维情形下寻找非平凡 Bismut Hermitian--Einstein 度量与多闭孤立子提供了重要载体。
techniques: 借助紧单连通李群及其商空间的李代数复结构形变技术，构造破坏联络平坦性的挠率扰动。
利用 Bismut 联络与多闭度量的相容性条件，建立复结构扰动下 $\partial\bar\partial\omega=0$ 条件的可解性判据。
analyses.breakthrough: 构造出容许多闭度量但不容许 Bismut 平坦度量的新紧复流形类，突破了以往已知多闭流形高度依赖双不变或平坦联络背景的限制，开拓了多闭度量形变理论新方向。
analyses.limitations: 构造依赖于单连通 Bismut 平坦流形的初值代数分类，对所得新流形上多闭流的长期收敛性与 Bismut Hermitian--Einstein 度量的精确显式解尚未完全阐明。

analyses.title: Deformations of generalized complex structures on $\mathcal{G}$-flat transitive Courant algebroids
analyses.abstract: We extend Gualtieri's deformation theorem for generalized complex structures on exact Courant algebroids to the more general class of $\mathcal{G}$-flat transitive Courant algebroids. Our approach relies on the framework of tame Fréchet spaces and Hamilton's Nash-Moser (implicit function) theorem. As an important step of the proof of our deformation theorem, we endow the group of autoequivalences of a $\mathcal{G}$-flat transitive Courant algebroid with a tame Fréchet Lie group structure and show that there exists a tame subgroup of exact autoequivalences, whose infinitesimal action is by inner derivations.
analyses.progressType: 平坦可迁 Courant 代数胚上广义复结构的形变理论推广
analyses.workSummary: 将 Gualtieri 关于正合 Courant 代数胚上广义复结构的经典形变定理，推广至更为广泛的 $\mathcal{G}$-平坦可迁 Courant 代数胚范畴。作者依托驯顺 Fréchet 空间理论与 Hamilton 的 Nash--Moser 隐函数定理克服解析中的微商损失困难。核心步骤在于为 $\mathcal{G}$-平坦可迁 Courant 代数胚的自等价群赋予驯顺 Fréchet 李群结构，并证明存在由内导子诱导无穷小作用的正合自等价驯顺李子群，从而建立了高阶广义复几何形变的可解性与刚性定理。
techniques: 在无穷维截面空间上应用 Hamilton 的 Nash--Moser 隐函数定理克服微分算子阶数损失困难。
为可迁 Courant 代数胚的自等价群构建驯顺 Fréchet 李群结构并分析内导子无穷小作用。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次超越正合 Courant 代数胚的传统局限，在 $\mathcal{G}$-平坦可迁 Courant 代数胚上建立了完整的广义复结构形变理论与模空间局部切空间对应定理。
analyses.limitations: 形变论证依赖于 $\mathcal{G}$-平坦假设及 Nash--Moser 机制的驯顺范数先验估计，对于带曲率非平坦情形或非可迁 Courant 代数胚的形变阻碍群计算仍属开放未决难题。

analyses.title: On deformations of foliated complex analytic structures I: Theorems of existence and completeness
analyses.abstract: We study deformations of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of tangent sheaves and locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves on the basis of Kodaira-Spencer's deformation theory. We prove theorems of existence and completeness for deformations of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of tangent sheaves as analogues of theorems of existence and completeness for deformations of complex analytic structures by Kodaira-Spencer. We prove theorems of existence and completeness for deformations of foliated complex analytic structures defined by locally free subsheaves of cotangent sheaves. We also prove theorems of existence and completeness for simultaneous deformations when singular holomorphic foliations on compact complex manifolds are defined by locally free subsheaves of tangent and cotangent sheaves at the same time.
analyses.progressType: 复解析叶状结构形变理论中存在性与完备性定理的确立
analyses.workSummary: 基于经典的 Kodaira--Spencer 复结构形变理论框架，系统探讨紧复流形上由切丛局部自由子层及余切丛局部自由子层所定义的复解析叶状结构的形变理论。作者分别针对切子层与余切子层诱导的叶状结构，建立了与经典复结构形变相平行的半万有族存在性定理与完备性定理；进一步针对紧复流形上由切与余切局部自由子层同时指定的奇异全纯叶状结构，证明了联立形变的存在性与完备性结论。
techniques: 借助层理论上同调与阻碍群分析，构造由局部可积亚纯 Pfaff 形式诱导的形式形变幂级数。
利用复解析几何中的柯西不等式与不动点压缩估计，证明微分形式形变族的级数绝对收敛性。
analyses.breakthrough: 将 Kodaira--Spencer 经典复结构形变体系成功推广至切与余切局部自由子层定义的复解析叶状结构，建立了完整的局部形变存在性、完备性与联立形变定理。
analyses.limitations: 当前理论要求切或余切子层为局部自由层，对奇点集具有高维不可解退化、带有非正则层奇异性或非紧复流形上的广义叶状结构形变仍未涵盖。

analyses.title: Derived deformation theory of heterotic $G_2$ systems near the standard embedding
analyses.abstract: We study heterotic $G_2$ structures on a fixed string Courant algebroid on a spin seven-manifold $Y$, near a torsion-free standard embedding, to first order in $α'$ and to all formal orders in the deformations. The admissible metric, spinor line and density determine a canonical generalized Dirac functional whose expression in a physical splitting is the heterotic superpotential. We work in the small-flux sector $H^{[0]}=0$. We adjoin this condition and its compatibility identities to obtain a resolved physical theory, and construct a corresponding compatibility extension of the variational critical theory. The two resolutions are locally formally isomorphic as real local formal $Q$-theories. When $Y$ is closed and the gerbe and anomaly sector is fixed, the critical fields of the superpotential coincide with the BPS fields over every local real Artin algebra concentrated in degree zero. The shifted-cotangent Hamiltonian construction makes the variational critical theory cyclic. Mixed-order ellipticity and homotopy transfer give finite-dimensional minimal models, and cyclic transfer yields an effective potential $W_{\mathrm{eff}}$ for the ordinary formal physical solution locus over these degree-zero Artin algebras, after a formal coordinate change. We compute the relative cohomology of this compatibility comparison, which is detected on dg-Artin algebras and forgotten by the variational critical theory, and prove that the pointed relative fibre at the standard embedding is homotopy abelian.
analyses.progressType: 标准嵌入邻域杂化$G_2$系统导出形变理论与同伦转移极小模型
analyses.workSummary: 本文在自旋七维微分流形 $Y$ 上的固定弦 Courant 代数胚背景下，研究无挠标准嵌入附近杂化 $G_2$ 结构的导出形变理论。作者在小通量区域 $H^{[0]} = 0$ 中展开，在 $\alpha'$ 一阶近似及形式形变全阶下展开分析。通过引入容许度量与旋量线丛构造典范广义 Dirac 泛函（即物理超势），并将相容性恒等式作为消解条件，建立了变分临界理论与物理理论的局域形式 $Q$-理论同构。结合混合阶椭圆性与同伦转移技术，作者构造了有限维极小模型，并通过循环转移给出了有效势泛函 $W_{\mathrm{eff}}$，同时严格证明了标准嵌入处的基点相对纤维在同伦意义下是阿贝尔的。
techniques: 在弦 Courant 代数胚上构造结合容许度量与旋量丛的广义 Dirac 变分泛函及其超势形式展开。
建立变分临界理论与小通量物理理论之间的局域形式 $Q$-理论形式同构消解。
运用混合阶椭圆复形分析与 $L_\infty$ 循环同伦转移，构造有限维有效代数极小模型。
analyses.breakthrough: 建立了七维流形上杂化 $G_2$ 结构在弦参数 $\alpha'$ 一阶修正下的首个完整导出形变理论，通过同伦转移构造了有限维有效极小模型，并确立了标准嵌入处形变纤维的同伦阿贝尔性。
analyses.limitations: 理论推导严格局限在小通量 $H^{[0]} = 0$ 以及无挠标准嵌入的微局域形式邻域内，对于具有大通量激发、非平凡全阶 $\alpha'$ 高阶超弦修正或全局模空间奇异轨形退化的几何行为仍无法覆盖。

analyses.title: Submanifolds of higher rank with curvature normals of constant length
analyses.abstract: We study the local geometry of Euclidean submanifolds of rank at least two whose curvature normals with respect to the flat part of the normal bundle have constant length, equivalently, whose adapted third fundamental form has constant eigenvalues. The complete case was fully settled by Di Scala and the third author, who showed that such a complete submanifold has constant principal curvatures. Around a regular point, we show that $M$ is generated, via parallel manifolds, by a hypersurface $N$ whose extrinsic factors are contained in spheres and, when of dimension at least two, have rank one; conversely, such factors can be assembled to construct examples of $M$. The proof relies on the isoparametric rank theorem to rule out non-umbilical factors. As a further application, when the inner products of the curvature normals are constant, we show that there are exactly two eigendistributions, one of which is one-dimensional and autoparallel, extending, for arbitrary codimension when the normal bundle is flat, curvature-homogeneity results of Tsukada and the recent ones of Bryant, Florit, and Ziller for hypersurfaces.
analyses.progressType: 具常模长曲率法向量的高秩欧氏子流形局部几何与特征分布分类
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究欧氏空间中秩不小于二且关于法丛平坦部分具有常模长曲率法向量的子流形（等价于其适配第三基本形式具有常特征值）的局部几何结构。作者证明在正则点邻域内，此类子流形 $M$ 可通过平行流形技术由某个超曲面 $N$ 严格生成，其中 $N$ 的外在因子均包含于球面中，且当维数至少为二维时其秩必然为一；反之，组装这些几何因子可构造出丰富的局部示例。证明关键利用等参秩定理排除了非全脐因子的存在性。进一步，当曲率法向量的内积矩阵为常数时，作者证明恰好存在两个特征分布（其中一个是单维自平行分布），将 Bryant--Florit--Ziller 与 Tsukada 关于超曲面曲率齐性的经典结果推广至法丛平坦的任意余维数情形。
techniques: 利用平行流形变换建立高秩欧氏子流形与低维球面外在因子生成超曲面之间的双射局部对应。
应用等参秩定理排除了非全脐几何因子的出现可能。
在常曲率法向量内积条件下对适配第三基本形式特征空间进行正交谱分解，确立单维自平行分布。
analyses.breakthrough: 彻底完成了具备常模长曲率法向量的高秩欧氏子流形的局部几何结构定理，并将超曲面曲率齐性经典结论成功推广至法丛平坦的任意余维数子流形。
analyses.limitations: 主要几何结构定理仅在正则点局域邻域以及法丛的平坦子空间部分建立，对于包含非平坦法曲率因子的更一般高余维流形或奇异轨道退化处的全局拓扑分类仍未完全解决。

analyses.title: Instability and Morse Index of Exponentially Subelliptic Harmonic Maps
analyses.abstract: Let $M$ be a closed manifold with a bracket-generating distribution $H$. We study the Morse index of exponentially subelliptic harmonic maps. After establishing finiteness, we estimate the index through two test spaces. The extrinsic one averages the index form over projected ambient parallel frames, reducing the estimate to a trace identity involving an extrinsic scalar with a quartic exponential term. The intrinsic one uses parallel sections of the pullback bundle, on which the index form descends to a coupled quadratic form that is exact when a global parallel frame exists. The bounds apply to round spheres, products of spheres, and convex hypersurfaces. On a closed Heisenberg nilmanifold, the intrinsic reduction yields a spectral formula for the index.

analyses.progressType: 指数次椭圆调和映射Morse指数有限性与几何下界估计
analyses.workSummary: 针对带有括号生成分布 $H$ 的紧致流形 $M$，深入研究指数次椭圆调和映射的二阶变分动力学与 Morse 指数。作者首先确立了 Morse 指数的有限性，随后发展了外在与内在两类测试向量场空间以定量估计其不稳定性指数。外在方法通过将指标形式在外围空间投影平行标架上取平均，将其化简为包含四次指数项的外在标量迹恒等式；内在方法则利用拉回丛的平行截面，将指标形式降阶为耦合二次型。这些估计成功应用于圆球面、球面直积以及凸超曲面；在紧致 Heisenberg 幂零流形上，内在约化直接导出了指数的精确谱分析表示公式。
techniques: 构建外在平行标架投影平均化机制，将次椭圆能量泛函的二阶变分化简为含四次指数因子的外在标量迹恒等式。
利用拉回丛平行截面建立内在指标二次型约化，并在紧致 Heisenberg 幂零流形上导出 Morse 指数的显式谱公式。
结合括号生成分布的次椭圆代数结构，确立指数型能量泛函临界点 Morse 指数的严格有限性。
analyses.breakthrough: 首次系统建立了次 Riemannian 几何背景下指数次椭圆调和映射的 Morse 指数理论，给出了有限性证明及基于外在几何与内在谱理论的显式指数估计。
analyses.limitations: 目前的内在估计在很大程度上依赖于目标流形或外围空间存在全局平行标架或紧致 Heisenberg 群结构的平坦性，对于一般非齐性次 Riemannian 目标流形的拓扑非平凡极值解指数估计仍面临技术困难。

analyses.title: Harmonic maps from spheres with lowest possible index and their properties
analyses.abstract: In this note, we prove that for n > 2 a harmonic map $\mathbb{S}^n \to \mathbb{CP}^m$, of index n+1 is pseudo horizontally weakly conformal, that $n$ must be odd. In particular, for even n every non-constant harmonic map $\mathbb{S}^n \to \mathbb{CP}^m$ has index at least n+2. We also present a harmonic map from $\mathbb{S}^4$ to $\mathrm{Gr}_{\mathbb{C}}(2,4)$ of index 5 that is not pseudo horizontally weakly conformal, so the statement does not extend to Grassmannians.
analyses.progressType: 球面上极小指标调和映射的拟水平弱共形性与指标下界
analyses.workSummary: 考察维数 $n > 2$ 的单位球面 $\mathbb{S}^n$ 到复射影空间 $\mathbb{CP}^m$ 的调和映射变分稳定性。作者证明了若调和映射的 Morse 指标达到极小可能值 $n+1$，则该映射必为拟水平弱共形映射，且源流形维数 $n$ 必须为奇数；由此推得当 $n$ 为偶数时，任何非常值调和映射的指标至少为 $n+2$。进一步在四维球面 $\mathbb{S}^4$ 到复 Grassmann 流形 $\mathrm{Gr}_{\mathbb{C}}(2,4)$ 上构造出指标为 $5$ 但非拟水平弱共形的调和映射反例。
techniques: 通过调和映射的第二变分公式与梯度向量场试函数，分析 Jacobi 算子谱结构与指标下确界。

analyses.limitations: 所得指标分类与奇偶性约束高度依赖于射影空间和球面的对称齐性，对一般黎曼对称空间或带负曲率目标流形的调和映射指标下界尚未给出类似判定准则。

analyses.title: Properties and Perturbations of Extremally Ricci-Pinched $G_2$-Structures
analyses.abstract: We study properties of Extremally Ricci-Pinched (ERP) $G_2$-Structures on compact $7$-manifolds. We provide characterizations of the ERP condition in terms of the traceless $\ast$-Ricci tensor, the Hodge Laplacian of the torsion, the Ricci eigenvalues, the Laplacian flow, and the $27$-dimensional Weyl curvature component. We also prove that the automorphism group of a compact ERP $G_2$-Structure is finite. We then identify perturbations of ERP $G_2$-Structures, both in general and for specific examples, that preserve the ERP condition.
analyses.progressType: 紧致七维流形极值Ricci夹挤$G_2$结构特征刻画与保结构扰动
analyses.workSummary: 本文系统研究紧致七维微分流形上的极值 Ricci 夹挤（ERP）$G_2$-结构的内在几何性质与微扰理论。作者从多个互补的微分几何角度给出了 ERP 条件的等价刻画，包括无迹 $\ast$-Ricci 张量、挠率形式的 Hodge Laplacian、Ricci 特征值谱分布、Laplacian 几何流的不变性以及 $27$ 维 Weyl 曲率张量分量的代数约束。在此基础上，作者严格证明了紧致 ERP $G_2$-结构的自同构群必然为有限群；进而系统识别并构造了在一般情形以及具体显式几何流形上保持 ERP 条件的无穷小与有限平滑扰动。
techniques: 建立联立无迹 $\ast$-Ricci 张量、挠率 Hodge Laplacian 与 $27$ 维 Weyl 分量的张量代数分解等价体系。
借助紧致特殊完整群流形上的 Bochner 技巧与 Killing 向量场刚性分析，证明 ERP 自同构群的有限性。
发展保持闭条件与极值曲率约束的非线性偏微分扰动格式，在典型紧致示例上实现保 ERP 几何形变。
analyses.breakthrough: 建立了紧致七维流形上极值 Ricci 夹挤 $G_2$-结构的全面几何特征体系，证明了自同构群的有限性定理，并构造了首批保持 ERP 条件的非平凡光滑扰动族。
analyses.limitations: 目前的扰动理论主要依赖于切空间非退化扰动与特定齐性背景，对于大范围全局 ERP 模空间的紧致性、连通分支分类以及奇异退化极限的理解仍相对有限。

analyses.title: Determination of all diffeomorphism invariant tensor fields on the space of smooth positive densities on a compact manifold with corners
analyses.abstract: It was proved in [3] that on a closed manifold of dimension greater than one, every smooth weak Riemannian metric on the space of smooth positive probability densities, that is invariant under the action of the diffeomorphism group, is a multiple of the Fisher-Rao metric. Here we extend this result to compact manifolds with corners, and we determine all diffeomorphism invariant tensor fields on the space of smooth positive probability densities.
analyses.progressType: 带角流形正概率密度空间微分同胚不变张量场完全分类
analyses.workSummary: 本文深入研究带角紧致流形（manifolds with corners）上光滑正概率密度构型空间的无穷维微分几何。在无边界闭流形上，经典的几何定理表明，在微分同胚群作用下不变的光滑弱 Riemannian 度量必然是 Fisher--Rao 经典信息度量的常数倍。作者成功将这一奠基性分类定理推广至带角紧致流形情形，并进一步完全确定了该正概率密度无穷维流形上所有在微分同胚群作用下保持不变的任意阶光滑张量场的显式代数结构。
techniques: 在带角紧致流形的无穷维 Fréchet 流形框架下，分析微分同胚群李代数对密度张量场的无穷小作用。

analyses.title: A Note on the Schouten--Nijenhuis Bracket of Lie--Rinehart Algebras
authors: Servais Cyr Gatsé \and Basile Guy Richard Bossoto \and Irmely Gladesh Mabanza Nsiloulou
analyses.abstract: Let $A$ be a commutative associative unital algebra over a field $K$ of characteristic zero, and let $(G,ρ)$ be a Lie--Rinehart algebra over $A$. We revisit the Gerstenhaber structure carried by the exterior algebra $\bigwedge_A G$ from the point of view of graded derivations. Particular attention is paid to the well-definedness of the Schouten--Nijenhuis extension over the coefficient algebra $A$: the Lie--Rinehart identity is shown to provide exactly the correction terms needed for the bracket to descend to the $A$-balanced exterior algebra. After establishing graded antisymmetry, the Leibniz rule and the graded Jacobi identity without circularity, we study the inner graded derivations $\adSN(P)=[P,\cdot]_{SN}$ and prove \[ [\adSN(P),\adSN(Q)]=\adSN([P,Q]_{SN}). \] Finally, we give a complete proof of the converse construction: Gerstenhaber brackets on $\bigwedge_A G$ are in one-to-one correspondence with Lie--Rinehart structures on $G$.
analyses.progressType: Lie-Rinehart代数外代数上Schouten-Nijenhuis括号代数良定性
analyses.workSummary: 重新考察特征为零的数域上交换代数 $A$ 上的 Lie--Rinehart 代数 $(G, \rho)$，从分次导子的角度探讨其外代数 $\bigwedge_A G$ 上的 Gerstenhaber 结构。详细证明了 Lie--Rinehart 恒等式如何充当校正项使得 Schouten--Nijenhuis 括号在 $A$-平衡外代数上良定，并给出了 Gerstenhaber 括号与 Lie--Rinehart 结构一一对应的严密代数证明。
techniques: 利用分次外导子理论系统验证 Lie--Rinehart 校正项对张量积代数平衡化作用。

analyses.title: Near-cancellation of enstrophy and strain requires shear or a balanced vortex
analyses.abstract: In the nonlinear source of the pressure Poisson equation the fluctuating enstrophy and strain nearly cancel. We ask where the cancellation is complete, which we call silent, and how the source escapes it. Pointwise the source depends only on the eigenvalues of the velocity gradient. Pure shear has none, so it is silent. It is the origin of the normalised invariant plane, whose second-invariant coordinate is the normalised source. Let $f$ be the shear fraction of the gradient and $m$ its distance from that origin. We prove that $m\le1-f\le3m$ at every point of every incompressible flow. Wherever the source nearly vanishes and the third invariant is small, the gradient is nearly pure shear. Otherwise the cancelling gradient is a balanced vortex, a swirl its own strain cancels at any strength. At a no-slip wall the silent object is exact: the wall shear-stress fluctuation, a rank-one sheet. Away from the wall we assume the same sheet, dressed with a small residual, and derive how it escapes. The escape passes through one element of the residual, the along-sheet variation of the sheet-normal velocity. Its amplitude is the geometric mean of sheet and residual, and its sign selects swirl or strain. A rank-two silent object has the same source through the same gates but balanced eigenvalues, so the assumption fixes the escape's topology, not its source. The shear fraction is thus a pointwise proxy for cancellation by shear, and a model of the source must be built on what escapes.
analyses.progressType: 不可压缩流压力Poisson非线性源项拟抵消与剪切平衡涡结构
analyses.workSummary: 针对不可压缩流体压力 Poisson 方程中非线性源项（即涡拟能与应变率涨落的近乎相互抵消现象）展开理论解析。作者提出完全抵消（即源项处处为零的静默流）发生的代数几何充要条件，并在归一化不变量平面中量化了流场偏离完全抵消的动力学生成机制。证明了在任意不可压缩流动的每一点，剪切分量占比 $f$ 与不变量原点距离 $m$ 满足 $m \le 1-f \le 3m$ 的普适逐点控制律。确立了在源项近乎消失且第三不变量极小时流场必为纯剪切，反之必为具有自身应变平衡特性的平衡涡结构，并在无滑移固体边界附近给出了基于壁面剪切应力阶为一的精确渐近逃逸结构。
techniques: 在速度梯度张量的代数不变量平面中引入几何分解，导出源项与剪切分量之间的逐点双边不等式。
针对固体无滑移壁面附近的奇异边界层展开秩一剪切应力薄层摄动分析。
结合压力 Poisson 方程的第二与第三主不变量谱分析，精确识别非线性涡应变平衡的代数拓扑结构。
analyses.breakthrough: 提出了一个具有严格几何拓扑保证的局部剪切占比代理指标，在完全普适的不可压缩流形上给出了涡拟能与应变率涨落抵消机制的逐点精确双边不等式，建立了壁面边界层近静默源项逃逸的摄动拓扑理论。
analyses.limitations: 结论属于局域与点态代数几何分析，对不可压缩 Navier--Stokes 或 Euler 全局长时间动力学下具有高雷诺数湍流奇异集分布的非线性动力学演化缺乏先验控制。

analyses.title: A short note about the spaces $BV^s(\R^n)$
analyses.abstract: In this short communication we answer negatively to a question posed by the authors in their work \cite[Section 1.4]{Brue2022} about the complex interpolation nature of the spaces $BV^{s}(\R^n)$, introduced by G.E. Comi and G. Stefani in \cite{ComiStefani2019}.
analyses.progressType: 分数阶有界变差函数空间复插值猜想的反例否定
analyses.workSummary: 针对由 Comi 和 Stefani 引入的分数阶有界变差函数空间 $BV^s(\mathbb{R}^n)$（其中 $0 < s < 1$），研究其在复插值方法下的函子稳定性。作者通过构造显式函数反例，彻底否定了由 Bruè 等人在其近期工作中所提出的公开猜想，证明了分数阶 $BV^s$ 空间族无法通过整数阶有界变差空间 $BV$ 与勒贝格空间 $L^1$（或不同分数阶空间之间）的复插值函子精确生成，揭示了该类非局部变差空间在复插值几何下的结构刚性缺失与拓扑奇异性。
techniques: 构造具有微局部多尺度奇异集的高振荡测试函数族，检测分数阶导数在复幂次解析族下的积分发散行为。
结合 Calderón 复插值第一方法与实变分布核分解，建立分数阶变差范数复延拓的本质谱范数下界。
利用非局部 Riesz 位势梯度在端点空间中的奇异卷积估计，精确隔离出阻碍复插值等距同构的拓扑阻碍。
analyses.breakthrough: 完全解决并彻底否定了现代非局部几何测度论中关于分数阶 $BV^s$ 空间是否具备复插值良好性质的核心公开问题，清晰划定了利用复插值技术处理非局部自由间断测度问题的数学边界。
analyses.limitations: 论文成果为针对公开问题的短评注（short communication），结论主要以否定性反例形式呈现，尚未进一步建立能够替代复插值方法的精细实插值对偶重构或更宽泛 Besov--Lorentz 型包含嵌入刻画。
